These principles exhibit substantial theoretical synergy with contemporary economics and offer viable solutions for the pressing challenges facing Muslim societies today.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过系统分析古兰经、圣训和先知传记等伊斯兰原始文献，重新解读循环经济（CE）在先知穆罕默德（愿主福安之）传统中的深厚根基，发现CE的三大核心要素（设计消除废物、资源循环、自然系统再生）在先知西拉（Sīrah）中被广泛且连贯地体现，归纳为十大轴心，并与现代经济学理论（行为经济学、制度经济学、博弈论、信号理论、伊斯兰金融）形成结构性协同；在此基础上提出六条面向当代穆斯林社会的战略路径。
AI.research_question: 循环经济的基本原则如何在先知穆罕默德的教导与实践（Sīrah）中被系统性地体现？这些先知传统原则与现代经济理论在结构上是否兼容？如何从这些传统中提取当代穆斯林社会可行的政策路径？
AI.motivation: 循环经济已被视为应对当代环境危机和自然资源有限性的根本回应，但其在前现代宗教和伦理传统——特别是先知穆罕默德（PBUH）的教导和Sīrah——中的深层根源很少被系统化、方法论严格地研究。现有文献存在这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以循环经济理论为核心框架，整合行为经济学（克服现时偏差）、制度经济学（奥斯特罗姆公共资源治理设计原则）、博弈论（未来阴影与超自然制裁）、信号理论（缓解逆向选择）、伊斯兰金融（资产支撑融资与风险共担）等多重经济学理论视角。
AI.method: 质性研究中的指导性内容分析（directed content analysis），从古兰经、权威圣训集和主要Sīrah原始文献中系统收集数据并进行分类编码。
AI.findings: （1）CE的核心要素——设计消除废物、保持资源流通、再生自然系统——在先知Sīrah中被广泛且连贯地体现，归纳为十大轴心，包括通过设计预防废物、资源循环、自然系统再生、可持续水管理、基于团结的资本循环、Ḥimā、Ḥaram、Anfāl、Mubāḥāt、Mushtarakāt法律制度和商业伦理；（2）这些先知基础与现代经济理论存在显著的结构性协同，涵盖行为经济学、制度经济学、博弈论、信号理论和伊斯兰金融五个维度。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次以系统化和方法论严格的方式对循环经济在先知传统中的根基进行学术重读，证明CE并非现代外来的强加概念，而是先知Sīrah中十四世纪前已被制度化嵌入的可持续文明支柱；建立了先知传统与多种当代经济学理论之间的结构性协同框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出六条可操作的战略路径：通过伊斯兰工具为CE转型融资、基于先知规范进行可持续水管理、复兴Ḥisbah制度、将清真寺重新设计为地方CE枢纽、通过Qarḍ Ḥasan赋权贫困群体、运用Lā Ḍarar（无害）原则进行环境保护，为当代穆斯林社会面临的紧迫挑战提供可行解决方案。

title:
Who Writes the Read:
 Liability Doctrine as Verification Design

detail.title:
Who Writes the Read:
 Liability Doctrine as Verification Design
detail.abstract: Whether an audit answers for its strongest advertised competence or its weakest relevant one is a choice made by pleading standards, not by nature-and the two readings generate opposite theories of verification. This paper puts the choice on a dial, mixing the two kernels with weight α, and maps the road between the convex and non-convex worlds its companions charted separately. Two boundaries are theorems and do not coincide: belief-convexity, and with it the programme's silence guarantee, holds exactly when α ≥ 1 2-landing precisely on the additive kernel-while the gap that decides whether the profession flattens or sharpens is exactly α-1 4. Between them the honest violation vanishes early over partitions but, once a type's mass may split across branches, runs to the convexity line exactly-so the apparent safe band between the two measures the disclosure language rather than the doctrine. The catastrophe of weakest-link liability turns out to be a single point: the kernel's zero set retracts to the origin under any positive reliance weight, so a pinch of reliance kills the master key, and pure engagement-quality doctrine is dominated outright, raising deterrence and capability together. But every further use of the dial presupposes the pen. A cell supported on the diagonal is priced identically by every doctrine, and a sender free to choose its own disclosure walks into that refuge: past a threshold its experiment, its truth, and the deterrence it yields are exactly invariant in the law. The reform is not resisted; it is unpriced. The same refuge is an evidence blackout, so a regulator that has ceded disclosure authority cannot estimate the doctrine it operates-while a designer-written specialist register reads the dial well, its emptiness certifying the convex side of the knife from report frequencies alone. Deterrence and measurement, however, trade off, and a sophisticated market relieves the sender and conceals the evidence in one motion. Rational inference is finally shown to change character on the dial only where the kernel can see the margin a certificate sheltersa third threshold, near the weakest-link corner. Doctrine is a powerful instrument and identification a real one; both are downstream of a procedural instrument that looks too small to matter, which is who writes the report.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个权重为α的"拨盘"框架，将审计核心理念（最强广告能力vs最弱相关能力）置于连续谱系中统一分析，揭示了信仰凸性、弱环节责任灾难、披露庇护所、证据黑箱与理性推断转变等多个关键阈值，最终指出"谁撰写报告"这一程序性工具决定了所有治理效果。
AI.research_question: 审计究竟应基于其最强被宣传的能力还是最弱相关能力进行验证？两种解读如何通过一个连续参数统一，并分别对验证理论、威慑、识别与披露激励产生何种影响？
AI.motivation: 审计验证理论中，最强能力（凸世界）与最弱能力（非凸世界）两种解读产生截然相反的验证理论，但已有研究分别单独处理这两种情形，缺乏统一的连续分析框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信念凸性理论、较弱环节责任理论、机制设计/披露理论、博弈论与信息经济学
AI.method: 理论建模：以权重α混合两种核心理念（kernel），通过分析不同α取值下的定理边界（α=1/2信念凸性、α=1/4差距阈值、弱环节核零集退缩等），推导出各阈值下的行为与制度含义。
AI.findings: （1）信念凸性恰在α≥1/2时成立，落在加性核上；（2）决定行业"平坦化vs尖锐化"的差距恰好是α-1/4；（3）弱环节责任的灾难是一个单点：任何正依赖权重下核零集退缩到原点；（4）纯参与质量学说被完全支配；（5）对角线支撑的单元格在所有学说下定价相同，形成披露庇护所；（6）庇护所即证据黑箱，监管者无法估计自己操作的学说；（7）理性推断在第三个阈值（近弱环节角落）改变性质。
AI.theory_contributions: 统一了凸世界与非凸世界两种验证理论的分离研究，揭示了α=1/2、α=1/4、第三阈值三个关键理论边界，证明庇护所与证据黑箱的双重身份，表明学说识别依赖于程序性设计而非学说本身。
AI.practical_contributions: 证明改革不会被抵抗而是"无定价"的——庇护所使得立法者无法通过市场信号评估学说效果；建议设计师编写的专家登记簿可从报告频率读取拨盘位置；警示成熟市场在缓解sender同时也会隐藏证据。

title: Development of an Integrated Open Innovation-based Knowledge Management Framework in Telecommunication Organization
affiliations: Asia e University (AeU), Open University of Sri Lanka

detail.title: Development of an Integrated Open Innovation-based Knowledge Management Framework in Telecommunication Organization
detail.abstract:
Open innovation based knowledge management is significant for the competitive performance of any organization. The role of an intellectual capital and absorptive capacity is not considered in open innovation based knowledge management literature. ABC Telecom currently faces a significant gap in open innovation based knowledge management. This study investigates the current state of open innovation based knowledge management and develops an integrated OIKM framework to improve the open innovation based knowledge management process at ABC Telecom.

Initially, a pilot study was conducted to confirm the knowledge management and open innovation gap at ABC Telecom A qualitative case study was conducted to address this challenge. Maximum variation sampling was used to select the participants for the study, and semi-structured face-to-face interviews were used to collect data from different ABC Telecom stakeholders and employees. Qualitative data analysis done with QDA miner 5.0 and Wordstat 8.0 software.

The results indicated that the open innovation processes not in practice at ABC Telecom; the knowledge management process is not standardized at ABC Telecom, and the role of intellectual capital and absorptive capacity is not defined at ABC Telecom. On this basis, recommended developing an integrated framework for open innovation based knowledge management with intellectual capital and absorptive capacity to improve the existing practice at ABC Telecom. With the support of the literature, the researcher developed an open innovation based knowledge management (OIKM) framework with contextual factors : open innovation processes incorporated with the knowledge management process; intellectual capital associates with knowledge storage; absorptive capacity associated with knowledge acquisition; knowledge distribution and knowledge application; open innovation outside-in process associated with absorptive capacity; open innovation inside-out process associated with intellectual capital.

This study provides guidelines to practice open innovation based knowledge management for ABC Telecom and emphasizes the importance of developing the organization's absorptive capacity and managing intellectual capital inside the organization. The integrated OIKM framework developed in this study can help practitioners and researchers better understand and evaluate the role of intellectual capital and absorptive capacity in open innovation based knowledge management.

AI.tldr: 本研究针对ABC电信公司在开放式创新知识管理方面的缺口，通过定性案例研究（最大变异抽样、半结构化访谈、QDA miner 5.0和Wordstat 8.0分析），发现其开放式创新流程未实践、知识管理流程未标准化、智力资本与吸收能力角色未定义。基于此，研究开发了整合智力资本与吸收能力的开放式创新知识管理（OIKM）综合框架，以改善该公司的知识管理实践。
AI.research_question: ABC电信公司开放式创新知识管理的现状如何？如何开发一个整合智力资本与吸收能力的OIKM框架来改善其开放式创新知识管理流程？
AI.motivation: 开放式创新知识管理对组织竞争力至关重要，但现有文献未考虑智力资本和吸收能力在这一过程中的角色；ABC电信公司目前在开放式创新知识管理方面存在显著缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放式创新理论、知识管理理论、智力资本理论、吸收能力理论
AI.method: 定性质性案例研究：先进行初步试点研究确认缺口，采用最大变异抽样选择参与者，通过半结构化面对面访谈收集数据，使用QDA miner 5.0和Wordstat 8.0软件进行定性数据分析。
AI.findings: （1）ABC电信公司未实践开放式创新流程；（2）知识管理流程未标准化；（3）智力资本和吸收能力的角色未定义。基于文献支持，开发了整合智力资本与吸收能力的OIKM框架，其中开放式创新流程与知识管理流程融合，智力资本与知识存储相关联，吸收能力与知识获取、知识分配和知识应用相关联，外部流入的开放式创新与吸收能力相关，内部流出的开放式创新与智力资本相关。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）将智力资本和吸收能力整合进开放式创新知识管理框架，填补了该领域文献空白；（2）明确了智力资本与知识存储、吸收能力与知识获取/分配/应用之间的理论关联；（3）区分了开放式创新外部流入（inside-out）与内部流出（outside-in）过程分别与吸收能力和智力资本的对应关系。
AI.practical_contributions: （1）为ABC电信公司提供了实践开放式创新知识管理的指南；（2）强调组织发展吸收能力和管理内部智力资本的重要性；（3）综合OIKM框架可帮助实践者和研究者更好理解和评估智力资本与吸收能力在开放式创新知识管理中的作用。

title: Capitalism Without Prices
affiliations: Chess Ed and University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Capitalism Without Prices
detail.abstract: Beckert argues that capitalism was global from the start, that it was built by an alliance of merchants and armed states rather than by markets, and that coercion was constitutive rather than incidental. The evidence is formidable and the decentering of Europe is a real advance. The causal argument is weaker than the descriptive one. Our central claim is that the book has written a thirteen-hundred-page history of land rent without a theory of rent. Read against Ricardo, it documents capture at the extensive margin but never separates transfer from creation. Read against Henry George, it misidentifies its own defendant, since much of what it calls capitalism is landlordism, and George supplies both the mechanism and the remedy that Beckert's conclusion gropes for. Read against Veblen, it narrates the structure of pecuniary claims without the accounting system in which those claims are denominated. Read against Keynes, it has a state without expectations and crises without demand. Mises and Hayek supply the computational function of prices that the book cannot represent, and are in turn embarrassed by its evidence on how titles were made. The book also has no theory of credit, which costs it the debt contract underlying its own merchant-state alliance and the discount rate that converts rents into land values. White supplies the theory of networks that Beckert's own unit of analysis requires and lacks, and with it a price theory that fits his evidence better than the neoclassical one he declines to use. Acemoglu supplies the formal version of Beckert's own thesis and the persistence evidence that undercuts it. The residual difficulty is identification. The treatment is near universal, the sample is selected on the outcome, and the definition of capitalism is elastic enough to admit almost any case. The book is best used as an atlas, not as a proof.

AI.tldr: 本文是对Beckert关于资本主义全球起源著作的批判性书评。作者承认该书在描述性方面（资本主义从起源即具有全球性、由商人与武装国家联盟构建、强制力具有构成性作用）具有坚实证据和去欧洲中心化的贡献，但认为其因果论证弱于描述性论证。核心批评是：该书写了一千三百页的地租史却没有地租理论——它记录了外延边际的攫取，却未能区分转移与创造；同时缺乏信用理论、价格计算理论、网络理论等，导致其论证在识别上存在根本困难。作者建议该书最好作为"地图集"而非"证明"来使用。
AI.research_question: Beckert关于资本主义全球起源的历史叙事在理论层面是否成立？具体而言，该书对资本主义的因果解释（而非描述）是否经得起经济理论（李嘉图、亨利·乔治、凡勃伦、凯恩斯、米塞斯、哈耶克等）的检验？
AI.motivation: Beckert的著作提供了大量关于资本主义全球起源的历史证据，并产生了重要影响，但其核心因果论证的理论基础存在严重缺陷。作者希望通过与该书对话的多个理论传统（古典政治经济学、新古典经济学、制度经济学等）进行对照，揭示该书的深层理论盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文的理论框架涵盖了多个经济学流派：李嘉图的地租理论（区分转移与创造）、亨利·乔治的地租税理论（区分资本主义与地主制）、凡勃伦的制度经济学（货币索取权与会计体系）、凯恩斯的宏观理论（预期与需求）、米塞斯和哈耶克的奥地利学派价格计算理论、怀特的社会网络与价格理论、阿西莫格鲁的制度经济学形式模型。
AI.method: 本文采用理论对照与批判性书评的方法，将Beckert的实证叙事分别置于李嘉图、亨利·乔治、凡勃伦、凯恩斯、米塞斯、哈耶克、怀特和阿西莫格鲁等理论框架下进行逐层检验，揭示其理论盲区并评估其论证有效性。
AI.findings: （1）Beckert的著作在描述层面证据坚实，去欧洲中心化是真正的进步；（2）但其因果论证弱于描述性论证，缺乏地租理论——记录了外延边际的攫取却未区分转移与创造；（3）该书将地主制误认为资本主义，亨利·乔治提供了其结论所欠缺的机制与补救方案；（4）缺乏信用理论，丧失了支撑其商人与国家联盟的债务契约以及将地租转化为土地价值的贴现率；（5）缺乏价格计算理论与网络理论；阿西莫格鲁提供了其论点的正式版本，但持久性证据又削弱了该论点；（6）存在根本的识别困难：处理效果接近普适、样本按结果选择、资本主义定义过于弹性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文的理论贡献在于：通过将宏观历史叙事与多个经济学理论传统进行系统对照，明确了"描述性历史"与"因果性理论"之间的边界；指出地租理论（区分转移与创造）对理解资本主义起源的必要性；论证了信用、价格计算与网络理论在理解资本主义形成中的不可替代作用；揭示了缺乏理论框架的历史叙事在识别上的根本局限。
AI.practical_contributions: 本文的实践贡献在于：为读者提供了如何"使用"Beckert著作的指导——将其作为历史地图集而非因果证明；表明亨利·乔治的地租理论可为当代土地与资本问题提供政策补救框架；提示了在历史研究中进行因果识别（应对普适处理、样本选择和概念弹性问题）的方法论警示。

title: Institutionalizing SDG 17: Strategic Sustainability Reporting and the Governance of Transnational Academic Partnerships
affiliations: and

detail.title: Institutionalizing SDG 17: Strategic Sustainability Reporting and the Governance of Transnational Academic Partnerships

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article is a conceptual contribution based on published, peer-reviewed literature. It involved no human participants, no animal subjects and no primary data collection, and ethical approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Sustainable Development Goal 17 asks institutions to build partnerships and to report on them. Two bodies of scholarship give opposite readings of what that reporting accomplishes. Accounting research on SDG disclosure finds a persistent distance between what organisations claim and what they do, treating reports as legitimacy work. Partnership-governance research treats monitoring and disclosure as the missing discipline that would make collaboration answerable. Both readings rest on real evidence, and neither has been worked out for transnational academic partnerships, where universities report partnership activity to rankings and sustainability reports while the partnerships themselves remain largely ungoverned. This paper develops a conceptual architecture specifying when reporting on partnerships governs them. Four conditions are proposed: the partnership rather than the institution is the unit of account; disclosure runs reciprocally between partners rather than only outward to external audiences; the terms of exchange, including funding shares, decision rights, data ownership and authorship, are disclosed alongside activity counts; and reported information carries consequences for approval, renewal and termination. A fifth condition sets a boundary, since reporting demands calibrated without regard to institutional capacity reproduce the asymmetry they are meant to correct. Five propositions state these conditions in testable form. The argument reframes the symbolic-substantive debate: reporting is neither inherently cosmetic nor inherently disciplining, and its governance value rests on an architecture that current university SDG disclosure does not supply.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个概念架构，阐明何时大学对跨国学术伙伴关系的报告能够真正发挥治理作用，而非仅具象征意义。文章提出四个条件（伙伴关系为单位、互惠披露、实质性条款披露、后果机制）和一个边界条件，并以五个可检验命题呈现。
AI.research_question: 在什么条件下，对跨国学术伙伴关系的报告能够真正治理这些伙伴关系，而不是仅仅作为合法性装饰？
AI.motivation: 可持续发展目标17要求机构建立伙伴关系并进行报告。但两类学术文献对此给出了截然相反的解读：会计文献认为SDG披露存在言行差距，报告只是合法性工作；伙伴治理文献则认为监测和披露是让合作负责任的必要纪律。这两种解读各有证据支持，但都未针对跨国学术伙伴关系的具体情况展开——大学向排名和可持续发展报告汇报伙伴关系活动，而伙伴关系本身却缺乏治理。本文旨在弥合这一理论与实践缺口。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了会计领域关于SDG披露的合法性理论（象征性-实质性辩论）与伙伴治理理论（问责、监测与披露）两大理论传统，在此基础上提出条件性治理架构。
AI.method: 概念性论文（conceptual paper），通过理论整合与逻辑推演提出四个治理条件、一个边界条件和五个可检验命题。
AI.findings: 提出报告治理伙伴关系的四个条件：(1)以伙伴关系而非机构为核算单位；(2)披露在伙伴之间互惠进行，而非仅向外部受众单向输出；(3)交换条款（资金份额、决策权、数据所有权、署名权）与活动数量一同披露；(4)报告信息对批准、续签和终止产生实际后果。第五个条件设定边界：不考虑机构能力的报告要求会复制它们本应纠正的不对称。
AI.theory_contributions: 重构了象征性-实质性辩论：报告既非天生装饰性也非天生纪律性，其治理价值取决于特定的架构安排。为SDG披露研究和伙伴治理研究提供了整合性的中间路径，并首次将这一辩论系统应用到跨国学术伙伴关系情境。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大学和资助机构设计更有意义的伙伴关系报告制度提供了具体的操作性标准（四个条件加一个边界条件），有助于改进SDG 17的落实情况，使报告从合规性装饰转变为真正的治理工具。

title: Sports Arbitration and EU Law

detail.title: Sports Arbitration and EU Law

declarations.funderStatement: The research was supported by the ICT and Societal Challenges Competence Centre of the Humanities and Social Sciences Cluster of the Centre of Excellence for Interdisciplinary Research, Development and Innovation of the University of Szeged. The author is a member of the “Law and competitiveness” research group.

detail.abstract:
The CJEU has dealt with the sports industry in a series of cases covering different aspects of its regulation, with the first milestone being Bosman and more recently including the three companion cases European Super League, International Skating Union (ISU), and Royal Antwerp Football Club. Until recently, however, the Court had not specifically addressed the legality of arbitration before the Court of Arbitration for Sport (CAS), which is a cornerstone of the international organization of sports, or the required standards of judicial review. In ISU, the CJEU examined for the first time the mandatory and exclusive nature of CAS arbitration, but only in the context of EU competition law, addressing the arbitration mechanism as a reinforcing factor of a standalone competition-law infringement and without ruling on the legality of sports arbitration as such.

It was against this background that RFC Seraing reached the Court, raising questions concerning the legal status and effects of CAS awards and, indirectly, the validity of FIFA arbitration, criticized for its mandatory and self-enforcing character, as well as for restricting access to national courts and, consequently, limiting the reach of EU law. Although RFC Seraing arose from a technical issue caused by an idiosyncratic rule of Belgian procedural law, it afforded the CJEU an opportunity to explore general compatibility issues of sports arbitration. The ruling clarifies that the circumstances identified in ISU as reinforcing factors do not constitute preconditions of legality. The judgment further clarifies the EU-law requirements applicable to the review of CAS awards rendered outside the EU and suggests that many procedural and institutional concerns could be mitigated if, in intra-EU disputes, the seat of CAS arbitration were located within the EU.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了欧盟法院在RFC Seraing案中对体育仲裁（特别是CAS仲裁）合法性的首次审查，澄清了ISU案中认定的强化因素并非合法性前提，并探讨了CAS裁决的司法审查标准及仲裁地设在欧盟境内对程序保障的可能影响。
AI.research_question: 欧盟法院在RFC Seraing案中如何界定CAS体育仲裁的合法性标准及其与欧盟法律（尤其是欧盟竞争法和基本权利保护）的关系？
AI.motivation: 欧盟法院此前在ISU案中仅在竞争法语境下间接涉及CAS仲裁的强制性和排他性，但未直接审查体育仲裁本身的合法性。CAS仲裁作为国际体育组织的重要基石，其强制性、自我执行性质及对国内法院管辖权的限制引发广泛争议，亟需明确其与欧盟法律的兼容性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟竞争法（TFEU第101、102条）；欧盟基本权利保护（尤其是获得有效司法救济的权利）；欧盟法律自主性原则；CAS仲裁机制的法律性质理论。
AI.method: 案例分析法，对欧盟法院在RFC Seraing案中的判决进行评析，并与Bosman、European Super League、ISU、Royal Antwerp等系列先例进行比较分析。
AI.findings: （1）ISU案中认定的强化因素并非裁决合法性的前提条件；（2）法院澄清了针对在欧盟境外作出的CAS裁决所适用的欧盟法律审查要求；（3）如果欧盟内部争议的CAS仲裁地设在欧盟境内，许多程序和机构方面的顾虑可以得到缓解。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次系统性地明确欧盟法院对体育仲裁（CAS仲裁）合法性的审查标准，填补了ISU案之后关于CAS仲裁与欧盟法律兼容性问题的理论空白，并对体育仲裁制度与欧盟法律自主性原则的关系提供了新的理论阐释。
AI.practical_contributions: 为FIFA等体育组织的仲裁条款设计提供指引，建议在欧盟境内设立仲裁地以增强程序保障；为运动员和俱乐部在面临CAS仲裁时主张欧盟法律保护提供了法律依据；为体育仲裁制度的改革方向提供了司法层面的参考。

title: Federal Money, State Administration: The Incentive Misalignment Behind U.S. Welfare Waste

detail.title: Federal Money, State Administration: The Incentive Misalignment Behind U.S. Welfare Waste

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no personal or financial relationships with other people or organizations that could have influenced, or be perceived to have influenced, this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study is a theoretical and institutional analysis based on publicly available data and secondary sources. It does not involve human participants, patients, or primary data collection requiring ethics approval.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The author conducted the study independently.

detail.abstract: This paper analyzes a persistent source of improper payments in major U.S. means-tested programs, particularly Medicaid and the Supplemental Nutrition Assistance Program (SNAP): the separation of funding authority from administrative responsibility. Under the Federal Medical Assistance Percentage (FMAP) system, the federal government finances a large share of program costs while states retain primary control over eligibility determination and verification. Drawing on a principal-agent framework, the paper shows that this arrangement creates systematic incentives for states to expand program scale beyond the social optimum and to under-invest in monitoring effort. Complementary institutional features-including limited exit mechanisms, cross-cutting program design, and high administrative costs-reinforce these distortions. The paper evaluates two polar institutional responses (full federal centralization and complete fiscal localization) and discusses operational measures that could improve integrity under either arrangement, including independent professional audits, technology-assisted verification, federal access to individual-level data, and structured policy review.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了美国主要的经济状况调查型福利项目（尤其是Medicaid和SNAP）中持续的违规支付问题，其根源在于资金授权与行政责任的分离。在联邦医疗援助百分比（FMAP）制度下，联邦政府承担大部分项目成本，而各州掌握资格认定和核实的主要控制权。基于委托代理框架，本文论证了这一安排为各州创造了系统性激励，使其倾向于扩大项目规模超过社会最优水平，并在核实监督方面投资不足。互补性的制度特征——包括有限的退出机制、跨领域项目设计和较高的行政成本——进一步强化了这些扭曲。文章评估了两种对立的制度回应（完全联邦集权化和彻底财政地方化），并讨论了在任何一种安排下都能提升项目完整性的操作性措施。
AI.research_question: 美国主要经济状况调查型福利项目（Medicaid和SNAP）中持续存在的违规支付问题的制度根源是什么？不同的制度安排（联邦集权与财政地方化）如何影响项目完整性？
AI.motivation: 美国重大福利项目中违规支付问题持续存在且规模可观，而现有分析往往聚焦于行政执行层面，缺乏对深层制度结构——即资金授权与行政责任分离这一制度安排的系统性理论分析。本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 委托代理理论（principal-agent framework）
AI.method: 理论分析：运用委托代理框架构建制度激励机制分析，结合对Medicaid和SNAP制度特征的案例分析，并对两种极化制度方案（联邦集权化与财政地方化）进行比较制度评估。
AI.findings: 1）FMAP制度下资金与行政责任的分离，为各州创造了扩大项目规模和减少核实投入的系统性激励；2）有限的退出机制、跨领域项目设计和行政成本高等互补性制度特征强化了这些激励扭曲；3）完全联邦集权化和完全财政地方化各有优劣；4）独立专业审计、技术辅助核实、联邦获取个体层面数据和结构化政策审查等措施可在任何一种制度安排下改善项目完整性。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文将委托代理框架应用于福利项目治理研究，系统阐释了资金授权与行政责任分离这一制度结构如何产生系统性激励扭曲，为理解公共项目中"花钱者"与"管钱者"分离的制度后果提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国Medicaid和SNAP等福利项目的制度改革提供了可操作的改进方案，包括独立专业审计、技术辅助核实、联邦数据获取权限和结构化政策审查等具体措施，并比较了两种极化制度安排的优劣，为政策制定者提供了制度选择的决策参考。

title: The Price of Bank Funding Behind Private Credit: Evidence from Business Development Companies
affiliations: Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: The Price of Bank Funding Behind Private Credit: Evidence from Business Development Companies

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Private credit is often described as credit provided outside the banking system. In many cases, this description is accurate: private credit lenders originate loans directly to firms, hold those loans on their balance sheets, and do not rely on deposits in the way banks do. But private credit is not fully separate from banks.

AI.tldr: 本文指出私人信贷通常被描述为银行体系之外的信贷，但事实上私人信贷与银行并非完全分离，二者之间存在密切联系。
AI.research_question: 私人信贷与银行体系之间的关系是什么？私人信贷是否完全独立于银行系统？
AI.motivation: 已有文献通常将私人信贷简单描述为银行体系之外的信贷提供方式，但这一描述并不完全准确，因为私人信贷与银行之间存在紧密联系。
AI.theoretical_framework: 私人信贷与银行体系关系的理论框架
AI.method: 概念性分析/论述性研究
AI.findings: 私人信贷并非完全独立于银行体系。虽然私人信贷机构直接向企业发放贷款、将贷款保留在资产负债表上，且不像银行那样依赖存款，但私人信贷与银行存在密切关联。
AI.theory_contributions: 修正了将私人信贷视为完全独立于银行系统的传统认知，指出私人信贷与银行体系存在内在联系。
AI.practical_contributions: 提醒研究者和政策制定者关注私人信贷与银行之间的关联性，避免将两者视为完全割裂的体系。

title: Organizational Complexity, Climate Risk, and Loan Pricing
affiliations: Southern Illinois University - Department of Economics & Finance, Kent State University and Southern Illinois University Edwardsville - Department of Economics & Finance

detail.title: Organizational Complexity, Climate Risk, and Loan Pricing
detail.abstract: We investigate the impact of organizational complexity on the pricing of climate risk in the credit markets. We show that climate risk is positively associated with bank loan spreads. We also find that organizational complexity, proxied by the number of bank subsidiaries, mitigates the adverse impact of climate risk on loan pricing, while being negatively related to loan spreads. Furthermore, we identify information advantage and diversification as two underlying economic mechanisms underpinning such effect. The baseline result is stronger in bank-dependent firms and firms that are neither green nor brown, and when lenders are in areas with greater climate concerns.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了组织复杂性对信贷市场中气候风险定价的影响。研究发现气候风险与银行贷款利差正相关，而组织复杂性（以银行子公司数量衡量）能够缓解气候风险对贷款定价的不利影响，且与贷款利差负相关。信息优势和分散化是两种潜在的经济机制。基准结果在银行依赖型企业、非绿色非棕色企业以及位于气候关注度更高地区的贷款方中更为显著。
AI.research_question: 组织复杂性如何影响信贷市场中气候风险的定价？
AI.motivation: 气候风险日益成为信贷市场定价的重要因素，但组织复杂性（如银行子公司数量）如何影响银行对气候风险的定价能力尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于信息优势理论和分散化理论，探讨组织复杂性缓解气候风险定价影响的机制。
AI.method: 实证分析，使用银行贷款利差数据、气候风险指标和银行子公司数量作为组织复杂性的代理变量。
AI.findings: 1）气候风险与银行贷款利差正相关；2）组织复杂性缓解了气候风险对贷款定价的负面影响，且与贷款利差负相关；3）信息优势和分散化是两种经济机制；4）基准结果在银行依赖型企业、非绿色非棕色企业和气候关注度较高地区的贷款方中更强。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织复杂性引入气候风险定价研究，丰富了气候金融与组织理论交叉领域的文献，识别出信息优势和分散化作为机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为银行管理层和监管者提供关于组织设计（如子公司布局）如何影响气候风险管理与贷款定价的实践启示。

title: Past-Time References and Analysts' Underreaction to Past Information
affiliations: The Hong Kong Polytechnic University - School of Accounting and Finance, Hong Kong Polytechnic University and Nanyang Business School, Nanyang Technological University

detail.title: Past-Time References and Analysts' Underreaction to Past Information
detail.abstract: The psychology literature suggests that speakers of strong past-time reference (PTR) languages are more likely to perceive the past as separated from the present and therefore assign less weight to past information in current decision-making. We examine whether PTR influences analysts' processing of information. Exploiting the diverse origins of analysts covering U.S.listed firms, we find that analysts originating from strong-PTR language backgrounds (i.e., strong-PTR analysts) exhibit greater underreaction to past earnings information. Our further tests show that strong-PTR analysts are less likely to ask past-oriented and past-tense questions during earnings conference calls, consistent with their lower reliance on past information. Our main results are robust to controlling for other linguistic features (including future-time reference and perfect tense marking) and a wide range of cultural dimensions. The results also hold in a subsample of analysts from China, Japan, Korea, and Vietnam, countries that share broad East Asian and Confucian cultural influences but differ in PTR strength. Among analysts of weak-PTR origin, those educated in strong-PTR languages in their early years exhibit greater underreaction to past earnings information than those who are not. Finally, we show that PTRrelated underreaction to past information is associated with poor analyst career outcomes. Overall, our findings document that analysts' underreaction to past information is associated with language-based psychological traits.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了分析师母语的过去时间参照（PTR）强度是否影响其对过去信息的处理。研究发现，来自强PTR语言背景的分析师对过去的盈利信息反应不足程度更高，在电话会议中更少提出面向过去的问题，且这种语言驱动的心理特质与较差的职业表现相关。
AI.research_question: 分析师的母语过去时间参照（PTR）强度是否影响其对过去信息的处理，具体表现为对过去盈利信息的反应不足？
AI.motivation: 心理学文献表明，强PTR语言的使用者更倾向于将过去与现在分离，从而在决策中给予过去信息较少权重。这一语言层面的心理特质是否会影响金融分析师这一关键信息中介的信息处理行为，目前尚不清楚。
AI.theoretical_framework: 语言相对论（Sapir-Whorf假说）相关理论；过去时间参照（PTR）与时间感知的心理学理论；分析师信息处理与有限注意力理论。
AI.method: 利用覆盖美国上市公司的分析师母语来源多样性，构建分析师PTR强度变量，回归分析PTR与分析师的盈利预测偏差（对过去信息的反应不足）之间的关系，并辅以电话会议提问内容分析等补充测试。
AI.findings: （1）来自强PTR语言背景的分析师对过去盈利信息的反应不足程度更高；（2）强PTR分析师在电话会议中更少提出面向过去和过去时态的问题；（3）结果在控制其他语言特征和文化维度后依然稳健；（4）在东亚儒家文化圈国家分析师的子样本中结论成立；（5）年轻时接受强PTR语言教育的弱PTR分析师也表现出更强的反应不足；（6）PTR相关的反应不足与较差的职业结果相关。
AI.theory_contributions: 将语言学中的语言相对论引入金融领域，首次揭示语言结构特征（PTR）通过影响时间感知进而影响分析师的信息处理行为，拓展了分析师行为偏差的语言学根源研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和市场参与者理解分析师预测偏差的来源提供新视角；提示机构和分析师自身认识语言背景对信息处理偏见的潜在影响，有助于改进预测质量。

reference: Environmental Defense Fund Economics Discussion Paper Series, EDF EDP 26-06, August 2026
title: Unearthing Future Orphans: Evaluating End-of-Life Well Risk in Alberta
affiliations: Environmental Defense Fund and Environmental Defense Fund

detail.title: Unearthing Future Orphans: Evaluating End-of-Life Well Risk in Alberta

publicationDetails.detailsText: Environmental Defense Fund Economics Discussion Paper Series, EDF EDP 26-06, August 2026

detail.abstract: Alberta's population of orphaned wells (those without a solvent owner able to pay for end-of-life closure) has grown in dramatic leaps in recent years, driven by operator bankruptcies. We develop a framework to estimate future cost and revenue streams, and to quantify the scale of wells at structural risk of being orphaned. Production curves were projected for over 129 thousand oil and gas wells; Monte Carlo simulation was used to estimate an expected net present value (NPV) through 2050 for each well. Combined with a simple proxy of operator financial health, we categorize a third of these wells as at risk of orphaning, and more than another third as at risk of transfer to a less solvent operator.  This adaptable modeling framework is intended to help jurisdictions proactively plan for emerging well liability, and may be further refined and adapted to support decision-makers in Canada and beyond.

AI.tldr: 本研究开发了一个评估框架，用于预测阿尔伯塔省废弃油井（orphaned wells）的未来成本和收入流，并量化面临结构性弃井风险的油井规模。通过预测超过12.9万口油气井的生产曲线，结合蒙特卡洛模拟估算每口井到2050年的预期净现值（NPV），再以运营商财务健康状况为代理指标，将三分之一的油井归类为存在弃井风险，另有超过三分之一面临转移给财务实力较弱的运营商的风险。
AI.research_question: 如何量化阿尔伯塔省面临结构性弃井风险的油井规模，并评估其未来成本和收入流？
AI.motivation: 阿尔伯塔省废弃油井数量近年来因运营商破产而急剧增长，缺乏能够承担封井费用的有偿付能力的所有者，需要前瞻性工具来规划和应对日益增长的井负债问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于净现值（NPV）的经济评估框架，结合生产曲线预测和蒙特卡洛模拟方法。
AI.method: 对超过12.9万口油气井进行生产曲线投影，使用蒙特卡洛模拟估算每口井到2050年的预期净现值（NPV），并结合运营商财务健康状况的简单代理指标进行分类。
AI.findings: 约三分之一的油井被归类为存在弃井风险，另有超过三分之一的油井面临转移给偿付能力较弱的运营商的风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个可适应的建模框架，用于前瞻性地规划新兴的井负债问题，可推广到加拿大及其他地区。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法管辖区（jurisdictions）和决策者提供了量化和管理弃井风险的实用工具，有助于提前规划和应对油井负债带来的环境和经济挑战。

title:
Designing Generative Relational Academic Infrastructure
A Protocol Framework for Collaborative Knowledge Evolution and Propagation

detail.title:
Designing Generative Relational Academic Infrastructure
A Protocol Framework for Collaborative Knowledge Evolution and Propagation
detail.abstract: Scholarly communication transmits finished artefacts and discards the trajectory that produced them. This paper takes that discard as a design problem and specifies the requirements on an infrastructure that would retain the trajectory. The argument proceeds from one observation about the present condition: an artefact carried evidence of a producer’s capacity because producing it was costly in a way that discriminated between producers, and the collapse of production cost removes the discrimination while leaving the artefact in place. Attention then moves to the record of how an understanding changed, which raises a second problem, since a record is as cheaply fabricated as the artefact whose function it inherits. The credibility of a trajectory record therefore rests on its distribution across parties who did not coordinate, and that is a matter for a protocol in place of a platform. The paper states the historical precedent for the displaced layer, concedes the substantial prior art in open research platforms, provenance standards and rationale-capture systems, identifies capture cost as the documented cause of the failure of the last of these, and derives sixteen requirements on any protocol that would succeed where they did not. It closes with an overview of an architecture satisfying those requirements, layered over existing repositories and specified in a companion paper.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将学术交流中"被丢弃的研究轨迹"视为设计问题，论证了需要一种协议而非平台来保留研究轨迹的可信记录，并推导出16项要求，最后概述了满足这些要求的架构。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种基础设施来保留学术成果产生过程中的研究轨迹，并确保其可信度？
AI.motivation: 学术交流只传播最终成品而丢弃了产生轨迹；同时，生产成本的大幅下降削弱了成果作为生产者能力的判别信号，使得保留可信的研究轨迹变得必要且困难。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信号理论（生产成本作为能力信号）、分布式信任/去中心化信任机制、协议与平台的区分框架。
AI.method: 概念性论证与分析：从现状观察出发，依次分析轨迹保留的可信度问题，回顾历史先例与既有文献（开放研究平台、溯源标准、理由捕获系统），诊断其失败原因，推导协议要求，并概述架构设计。
AI.findings: 轨迹记录的可信度依赖于其在未协调各方之间的分布；理由捕获系统的失败根因是捕获成本过高；据此推导出16项协议要求，并提出了叠加于现有仓储之上的满足这些要求的架构。
AI.theory_contributions: 将"轨迹丢弃"重新框定为设计问题；提出用协议替代平台来保障轨迹记录可信度的理论立场；系统化了轨迹保留基础设施的要求框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为学术交流基础设施的设计提供16项具体协议要求；提出可叠加于现有仓储的架构方案，为后续实现提供蓝图。

title: Examining the Sensitivity of Regional Banks to Macroeconomic Shocks
affiliations: , Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System, Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System and Board of Governors of the Federal Reserve System

detail.title: Examining the Sensitivity of Regional Banks to Macroeconomic Shocks

publicationDetails.journalName: Board of Governors: Finance & Economics Discussion Series (Topic)

detail.abstract: Following the Global Financial Crisis (GFC), banking supervision and regulation became more stringent for largest banks, particularly systemically important institutions and those with at least $100 billion in consolidated total assets. However, the 2023 stress period following the default of the Silicon Valley Bank (SVB) highlighted that problems at regional banks, which we define as banks between $10 billion and $100 billion in assets, may also cause broader banking system stress.

AI.tldr: 本文关注金融危机后监管对大型银行（特别是系统重要性银行和资产超1000亿美元的银行）更为严格，但2023年硅谷银行事件揭示了资产在100亿至1000亿美元之间的区域性银行也可能引发更广泛的银行体系压力。
AI.research_question: 区域性银行（资产在100亿至1000亿美元之间）是否也可能引发更广泛的银行体系压力，从而需要更严格的监管关注？
AI.motivation: 金融危机后监管主要针对大型银行，但2023年硅谷银行违约事件表明，区域性银行的问题同样可能导致整个银行体系的不稳定，现有监管框架可能存在盲区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 银行监管与系统性风险理论，涉及系统重要性金融机构的识别与监管框架。
AI.method: 基于2023年硅谷银行违约事件作为案例背景，对区域性银行（资产100亿至1000亿美元）的系统性风险进行概念性分析。
AI.findings: 区域性银行虽然规模小于大型银行，但仍可能在压力时期引发广泛的银行体系系统性压力，现有以资产规模为主要门槛的监管框架可能不足以覆盖此类风险。
AI.theory_contributions: 扩展了系统性风险的理论边界，挑战了以资产规模作为唯一系统性风险衡量标准的传统观点，将区域性银行纳入系统性风险分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构提供了关于区域性银行监管必要性的依据，建议监管框架应超越单纯的资产规模门槛，关注中等规模银行的系统性风险传导渠道。

title: Strategic Entrepôts at Global Maritime Chokepoints: Imperial Design, Autonomy, and Great-power Succession

detail.title: Strategic Entrepôts at Global Maritime Chokepoints: Imperial Design, Autonomy, and Great-power Succession
detail.abstract: Paul Lalovich is an industrial economist and organizational strategist based in Dubai, UAE, with a multidisciplinary academic background that includes a PhD in Applied Economics, an MSc in Industrial Economics Management, and a Postgraduate Diploma in Digital Business from Columbia Business School. His professional and scholarly pursuits converge around strategy execution, organizational effectiveness, change management, and the increasingly critical nexus between economic principles, digital transformation, and emergent technologies. Currently serving as Partner and Global Lead at Agile Dynamics in Abu Dhabi, he has counseled a wide array of prominent clients across Europe, Asia, and the Middle East—among them Aramco, ENEC, Sadara Chemical Company, du, Gazprom, Mercer Consulting, Oliver Wyman, and Ooredoo—offering deep expertise in organizational design, performance enhancement, and large-scale institutional change. He is also co-author of *From Cubicle to Tribe*, a forward-looking book that explores shifting organizational paradigms and the evolving nature of work in a post-industrial era. More recently, Lalovich has expanded his focus to include blockchain and Web3 infrastructure, actively contributing to Layer-1 platforms that emphasize technological sovereignty and the strategic deployment of foreign direct investment within developing and frontier markets. Through this body of work, he continues to bridge classical economic thinking with the architectural demands of decentralized digital ecosystems, offering actionable insights for both public and private sector leaders navigating uncertain and rapidly shifting landscapes.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍的是Paul Lalovich——一位位于迪拜的工业经济学家和组织战略家，其研究与实践聚焦于战略执行、组织效能、变革管理，以及经济学原理与数字化转型、新兴技术（特别是区块链和Web3基础设施）之间的交叉融合。
AI.research_question: 如何将经典经济学思想与去中心化数字生态系统（区块链、Web3）的架构需求相结合，为公共和私营部门领导者在不确定环境中提供战略洞察。
AI.motivation: 在快速变化的全球格局中，组织面临数字化转型和新兴技术带来的挑战，需要弥合传统经济学理论与去中心化数字经济之间的鸿沟。
AI.theoretical_framework: 应用经济学、工业经济学管理、组织战略理论、战略执行与组织效能理论、变革管理理论，以及区块链/Web3经济学。
AI.method: 基于跨学科理论与实践经验，结合对中东、欧洲和亚洲大型企业的咨询案例，以及著作《From Cubicle to Tribe》和Layer-1区块链平台参与经验。
AI.findings: 经典经济学原理可以有效地与去中心化数字生态系统的设计相结合；组织范式正在向后工业时代的新形态演变；区块链基础设施可为发展中市场提供技术主权与外商直接投资的战略部署机会。
AI.theory_contributions: 将传统经济学框架与区块链/Web3经济学相融合，为组织设计和技术主权提供跨学科理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Aramco、ENEC、Gazprom等大型企业提供组织设计和大型机构变革的实践建议，并为公共和私营部门领导者提供可操作的战略洞察。

title: The Settlement-Latency Paradox

detail.title: The Settlement-Latency Paradox
detail.abstract: Status and scope. This paper develops an original theoretical framework and evaluates it against public institutional evidence from the United States, euro area, India, and Brazil. The theoretical propositions are proved within the model. The empirical sections are deliberately described as validation, calibration, and falsifiable evidence rather than as definitive causal proof where bank-level microdata are unavailable. Novelty claims are therefore framed narrowly: the contribution is the integration of settlement latency, reserve-demand geometry, balance-sheet policy, and crisis-speed dynamics into a single macro-financial state-variable framework.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个原创的理论框架，利用美国、欧元区、印度和巴西的公共制度证据进行验证。理论命题在模型内得到证明，实证部分被谨慎地描述为验证、校准和可证伪证据。论文的核心贡献在于将结算延迟、准备金需求几何、资产负债表政策和危机速度动态整合到一个统一的宏观金融状态变量框架中。
AI.research_question: 如何将结算延迟、准备金需求几何、资产负债表政策与危机速度动态整合为一个统一的宏观金融状态变量框架？
AI.motivation: 现有文献缺乏一个能够同时整合结算延迟、准备金需求几何、资产负债表政策和危机速度动态的统一宏观金融框架，本文旨在填补这一理论空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观金融状态变量框架，整合了结算延迟理论、准备金需求几何理论、资产负债表政策理论和危机速度动态理论。
AI.method: 理论建模（在模型内证明理论命题）与多国制度证据验证（美国、欧元区、印度、巴西），实证部分采用验证、校准和可证伪证据方法，而非银行层面微观数据的因果推断。
AI.findings: 理论命题在模型内得到证明；基于四国公共制度证据的验证结果支持该框架；但实证证据被谨慎定位为验证性而非确定性的因果证明。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于首次将结算延迟、准备金需求几何、资产负债表政策和危机速度动态四大维度整合到单一的宏观金融状态变量框架中，提供了一个统一的宏观金融分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了跨经济体（美国、欧元区、印度、巴西）可比较的制度证据分析框架，有助于理解不同制度环境下宏观金融政策的传导机制。

title: Closing an Open Form: An Explicit Series Solution of the CRESH Cost Function
affiliations: University of Turku - Turku School of Economics

detail.title: Closing an Open Form: An Explicit Series Solution of the CRESH Cost Function

declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical/mathematical study with no human participants, patient data, or personal data of any kind.

detail.abstract: Hanoch's (1971) CRESH production function generalizes the CES by letting Allen-Uzawa elasticities of substitution differ across factor pairs while their ratios stay fixed. Its cost function, however, was derived only implicitly: the marginal-cost kernel 𝜆(𝑝) is defined by an implicit equation (Hanoch's Appendix B), and to our knowledge no explicit solution has been presented since. This note closes that form. We show that 𝜆(𝑝) admits an explicit series representation whose coefficients are closed-form ratios of Gamma functions, prove the formula by Lagrange-Bürmann inversion, and recover the CES cost function exactly as the equalexponent degeneration. With 𝜆(𝑝) explicit, the unit cost function and the factor demands follow in closed form, making the entire CRESH cost side operational; as a one-line corollary the price elasticities of the kernel reproduce Hanoch's own shadow-price response formula exactly. All results are machine-verified: symbolically to third order on three exponent configurations, numerically to forty digits with irrational exponents, and end-to-end against the costminimization first-order conditions with residuals below 10-40. We map the convergence geography honestly and quantitatively: each of the 𝑛 reference charts converges where its factor's weight dominates and diverges at balanced points-covering roughly four fifths of a moderate log-uniform price experiment for a strongly heterogeneous test technology-in line with the discriminant-amoeba description of hypergeometric root series. As a first continuation step we derive a CES-anchored expansion in the dispersion of the exponents around their weightaveraged mean, exact through second order, which lands within one percent at the very balanced point where all reference charts fail; its full development, and global continuation generally, are left open. The underlying mathematics is classical (Mellin; Birkeland; A-hypergeometric series); the contribution is its application to a fifty-five-year-old open form in production theory.

AI.tldr: 本文为Hanoch (1971)提出的CRESH生产函数成本侧提供了完全显式化解。通过Lagrange-Bürmann反演，作者证明了边际成本核λ(p)具有显式级数表示，其系数为Gamma函数的闭式比率，并在等指数退化情形下精确恢复CES成本函数。这使得单位成本函数和要素需求均获得闭式形式，使CRESH成本侧完全可操作。算法经符号与数值验证，收敛区域覆盖约五分之四的典型价格实验空间。
AI.research_question: 如何为Hanoch (1971)的CRESH生产函数成本侧提供一个显式的解析解，特别是对边际成本核λ(p)的隐式定义给出闭式表达？
AI.motivation: CRESH生产函数自1971年提出以来，其成本函数仅以隐式方式给出（λ(p)由隐式方程定义），五十多年来未获得显式解，严重制约了该函数在实际应用中的可操作性。闭合这一形式是该领域长期悬而未决的问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 经典数学框架包括：Mellin变换、Birkeland级数、A-超几何级数（discriminant-amoeba描述）、Lagrange-Bürmann反演公式，以及生产理论中的对偶性理论。
AI.method: (1) 利用Lagrange-Bürmann反演推导λ(p)的显式级数表示；(2) 推导系数为Gamma函数闭式比率；(3) 验证等指数退化恢复CES；(4) 符号验证至三阶（三种指数配置）、数值验证至40位精度（无理指数）、端到端验证成本最小化一阶条件残差低于10^-40；(5) 分析收敛地理（判别式-变形虫图像）；(6) 推导以CES为锚的指数离散度展开（精确至二阶）。
AI.findings: (1) λ(p)可表示为显式级数，系数为Gamma函数闭式比率；(2) 等指数退化精确恢复CES成本函数；(3) 价格弹性核的一行推论精确再现Hanoch的影价响应公式；(4) 每个参考图在其要素权重占优时收敛，在平衡点发散，覆盖约五分之四的中等对数均匀价格实验；(5) CES锚定展开在平衡点处误差低于1%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为五十多年前的生产理论开放问题提供了首次显式解；将经典的超几何级数理论（Mellin/Birkeland/A-超几何）成功应用于经济学中的CRESH成本函数求解；建立了收敛区域与判别式-变形虫结构之间的系统对应关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 使CRESH成本函数、单位成本函数和要素需求均获得闭式表达，使CRESH函数在实际生产和实证分析中完全可操作；所有结果经机器验证（符号+数值），精度达40位以上，可直接用于计算；收敛区域的诚实量化映射为实际应用中的数值稳定性提供了明确指南。

title: Who Fails the Filter? Size, Verification and the Incidence of an Unchecked Minimum Capital Requirement

detail.title: Who Fails the Filter? Size, Verification and the Incidence of an Unchecked Minimum Capital Requirement

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author has no competing interests to declare that are relevant to the content of this article.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. The study uses public administrative records of legal entities and involves no human subjects.
declarations.funderStatement: No funding was received for conducting this study.

detail.abstract: Europe dismantled its private-company minimum capital requirements on the ground that they fail creditors. Its other defence, that a minimum filters the unserious, was settled by assertion: against a European income it excludes nobody. Size and verification are separable parameters; four enacted regimes are read here on both. A floor large enough to exclude a recognisable class is cheap only where the registry does not look: looking means paying for the exclusion one refusal at a time. Where both were set high, it was the size that was given up. The evidence here is on one such floor. Brazil's single-owner limited-liability form required paid-in capital of one hundred minimum wages, unverified. What it asked follows from legislated numbers alone: the floor stood at 1.0 to 1.6 times the maximum annual revenue the law allowed those firms in the regime they were leaving, and was a stock, not a flow. In a register of 69.1 million firms, two populations under no requirement, five to nine years apart, declare the same nominal median against floors of R\$78,800 and R\$121,200. The unchecked floor bound anyway, through the filing offices: declarations of a 2020 revision ran four to six times above background two days after its announcement, seventeen days before it was law. It rationed a stock that had to survive later examination, sorting the few who reached the rung rather than holding many off it. Three common, cheaply reversible features of registry design decide whether such a reform can be evaluated at all

AI.tldr: 本文利用巴西69.1百万家公司的注册数据，研究私人公司最低资本要求的过滤功能。研究发现，尽管巴西的最低资本要求未被核实（无验证机制），它仍然通过备案系统的公告效应约束了进入者：2020年修订公告发布后两天，申报金额立即跃升至背景水平的4-6倍，而该修订在17天后才成为法律。最低资本要求像一个"门槛"筛选出少数能够达到该水平的公司，而非阻止多数人进入。论文还指出注册系统的三个常见且易于逆转的设计特征决定了此类改革能否被评估。
AI.research_question: 被废除前的私人公司最低资本要求是否具有"过滤不严肃经营者"的功能？具体而言，在无验证机制的情况下，最低资本门槛是否仍能约束公司行为，以及其筛选机制究竟如何运作？
AI.motivation: 欧洲以"最低资本要求无法保护债权人"为由废除了私人公司的最低资本要求，但其另一项辩护理由——最低资本要求可以过滤不严肃的经营者——仅靠断言论证，缺乏实证检验。本文通过巴西的独特数据对这一未经验证的论点进行实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文区分了"规模"与"验证"两个独立参数，提出最低资本要求的过滤功能取决于两个条件：门槛足够高以排除可识别的公司类别，以及注册机构是否实际核查。理论框架涉及公司法的门槛设计、注册制度的信息功能以及制度约束的行为效应。
AI.method: 利用巴西69.1百万家企业的注册数据，比较在无资本要求（对照组）与有资本要求（处理组）两种制度下企业的名义申报中位数，并利用2020年资本要求修订公告前后两天的数据，采用事件研究方法分析公告的即时效应。此外结合法律规定的算法（最低工资与营业收入上限比例），分析门槛设定的经济含义。
AI.findings: （1）巴西单人有限责任公司要求实缴资本100个最低工资（未验证），该门槛相当于企业离开原制度时法定最大年收入的1.0-1.6倍，且是存量而非流量；（2）在无要求的两个人口群体中，相隔5-9年申报的同一名义中位数，面对78,800雷亚尔和121,200雷亚尔两个不同门槛；（3）未被核查的门槛通过备案系统仍然具有约束力：2020年修订公告发布后两天，申报金额跃升至背景水平的4-6倍，而该修订17天后才成为法律；（4）门槛的筛选机制是"配给"一个必须通过后续审查才能存活的存量，筛选出少数能达到门槛的公司，而非阻挡多数公司进入。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文首次提供了最低资本要求"过滤功能"的系统性实证证据，挑战了欧洲废除该制度时基于断言而非证据的决策基础。论文揭示了最低资本要求即使在无验证机制下仍能通过注册系统的信息传播效应发挥约束作用，区分了"规模"与"验证"两个独立参数，为公司法中资本门槛设计的理论提供了新维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 论文指出三个常见且易于逆转的注册系统设计特征决定了此类改革能否被评估，为政策制定者提供了最低资本要求制度设计（特别是注册机构的信息发布与核查机制）的实践指导，也为各国评估和设计公司注册制度改革提供了方法论参考。

title: Geochemical and Thermodynamic Screening for CO 2 Storage in Tight Gas Reservoirs: The Yucal-Placer Case

detail.title: Geochemical and Thermodynamic Screening for CO 2 Storage in Tight Gas Reservoirs: The Yucal-Placer Case

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This study does not involve human subjects, animal testing, or restricted biological materials.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract:
High native carbon dioxide (CO 2) concentrations pose significant operational and environmental challenges in tight natural gas development. In the context of global net-zero targets and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) compliance, contaminated gas fields offer a prime opportunity for co-located geological carbon screening. This study presents a first-order integrated geochemical, thermodynamic, and material selection screening for CO 2 storage in the giant Yucal-Placer tight gas field (Eastern Venezuelan Basin), utilizing representative tight-gas recovery and saturation parameters (R f , S wi , S gr) within a probabilistic SPE-SRMS capacity framework. By reinterpreting legacy, previously unanalyzed gas molecular compositions and stable carbon isotope data (δ 13 C-CO 2 and δ 13 C-CH 4) from 15 wells, we demonstrate that carbon isotope fractionation (α c ≈ 1.036) reflects inorganic CO 2 decarbonation in severe thermodynamic disequilibrium. Thermodynamic phase modeling via the Soave-Redlich-Kwong equation of state maps dense supercritical CO 2 densities ranging from 393.8 kg/m 3 in shallow hydrostatic sands (4,762 ft) to 577.3 kg/m 3 in deep overpressured sands (8,631 ft), quantifying a 19.5% density reduction caused by a regional 400 • F geothermal anomaly. Wellbore material selection is evaluated using international partial pressure threshold standards (NACE SP0775 / NORSOK M-001), demonstrating that native partial pressures in the Northeastern sector (pCO 2 ≈ 150 bar) exceed high-risk thresholds 75-fold, mandating 13% Cr/Duplex Corrosion Resistant Alloys (CRAs) as confirmed by produced water chemistry in well 16E (pH 4.30, 10,000 mg/L Fe). Overall, this work
demonstrates how legacy exploration datasets can be repurposed to establish
subsurface baselines for asset transformation without requiring speculative
extrapolations.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过对委内瑞拉东部盆地Yucal-Placer致密气田进行综合地球化学、热力学和材料选择的一阶筛选，评估其作为CO2地质封存场所的潜力。研究利用15口井的遗留分子组成和碳同位素数据，结合Soave-Redlich-Kwong状态方程进行热力学相建模，并依据NACE/NORSOK国际标准评估井筒材料选择，展示了如何将遗留勘探数据重新用于地下封存基线的建立。
AI.research_question: 如何利用遗留勘探数据对高含天然CO2的致密气田进行CO2地质封存潜力的综合筛选评估？
AI.motivation: 高天然CO2浓度给致密天然气开发带来严重的运营和环境挑战。在全球净零排放目标和ESG合规背景下，受污染气田为协同开展地质碳封存提供了重要机会，但缺乏系统的筛选评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 碳同位素分馏理论（αc≈1.036反映无机CO2脱碳作用）、Soave-Redlich-Kwong状态方程（热力学相建模）、SPE-SRMS容量评估框架、NACE SP0775/NORSOK M-001国际腐蚀标准。
AI.method: 综合采用地球化学分析（重新解释15口井的气体分子组成和稳定碳同位素数据）、热力学相建模（SRK状态方程计算超临界CO2密度）、材料选择评估（基于国际偏压阈值标准），并结合概率性SPE-SRMS容量框架。
AI.findings: 碳同位素分馏αc≈1.036反映无机CO2脱碳作用且处于严重热力学非平衡状态；超临界CO2密度范围从浅部静水压砂岩的393.8 kg/m3到深部超压砂岩的577.3 kg/m3，区域400°F地热异常导致19.5%的密度降低；东北区块天然CO2偏压（约150 bar）超过高风险阈值75倍，需采用13% Cr/双相耐蚀合金（CRAs）。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了遗留勘探数据集（包括此前未分析的气体分子组成和碳同位素数据）可以重新用于建立地下封存基线，而无需进行推测性外推，为致密气田CO2封存筛选提供了方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Yucal-Placer致密气田的资产转型提供了一阶筛选依据，明确了CO2封存容量估算参数、超临界CO2密度分布特征以及井筒材料选择的腐蚀风险等级，为后续深入评估和工程决策奠定基础。

title: Financial Literacy among Secondary School Students: A Comprehensive Global Assessment with Special Reference to Bangladesh

detail.title: Financial Literacy among Secondary School Students: A Comprehensive Global Assessment with Special Reference to Bangladesh
detail.abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive assessment of financial literacy levels among secondary school students, synthesizing evidence from global frameworks, regional initiatives, and country-specific studies with particular focus on Bangladesh. Drawing upon the OECD/PISA Financial Literacy Framework, systematic literature reviews, and empirical studies from developing and developed economies, the research reveals that financial literacy among secondary students remains critically low worldwide, with pronounced deficits in developing countries. Bangladesh mirrors this global pattern, with only 9.74% of students demonstrating adequate financial knowledge. The study identifies key determinants including urban-rural disparities, gender gaps, financial socialization patterns, and the distinction between financial access and financial capability. Evidence from Pakistan, Cambodia, Papua New Guinea, and Nigeria provides comparative insights for curriculum reform. The research concludes with evidence-based recommendations for policymakers, educators, and researchers, emphasizing the need for systematic, age-appropriate financial education integrated across all academic streams.

AI.tldr: 本文综合评估了中学生金融素养水平，基于OECD/PISA金融素养框架、系统性文献综述及多国实证研究，聚焦孟加拉国案例。研究发现全球中学生金融素养普遍偏低，发展中国家尤其严重；孟加拉国仅9.74%的学生具备充分金融知识。论文识别了城乡差距、性别差异、金融社会化模式等关键影响因素，并提出系统化金融教育改革建议。
AI.research_question: 中学生金融素养水平如何？其关键影响因素是什么？如何通过教育改革提升金融素养（重点关注孟加拉国）？
AI.motivation: 全球范围内中学生金融素养普遍偏低，发展中国家问题尤为突出，但缺乏系统性的综合评估和跨国家比较研究，特别是针对孟加拉国的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: OECD/PISA金融素养框架、金融社会化理论、金融获取与金融能力区分理论
AI.method: 系统性文献综述，综合全球框架、区域倡议、国家研究及跨国比较实证分析（覆盖巴基斯坦、柬埔寨、巴布亚新几内亚、尼日利亚等国）
AI.findings: 中学生金融素养全球普遍偏低，发展中国家赤字显著；孟加拉国仅9.74%学生具备充分金融知识；城乡差距、性别差距、金融社会化模式及金融获取与金融能力差异是关键决定因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合多元理论框架，提出金融获取与金融能力区分的重要性，为理解发展中国家金融素养教育提供系统的理论比较视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者、教育者和研究者提供循证建议，强调跨学科整合、适龄化、系统化的金融教育课程改革方向。

title: ACTOF: An Adaptive Cognitive Telecom Operations Framework for AI-Driven Incident Management, Workforce Optimization, and Explainable Network Operations

detail.title: ACTOF: An Adaptive Cognitive Telecom Operations Framework for AI-Driven Incident Management, Workforce Optimization, and Explainable Network Operations

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or animal subjects. Therefore, ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Modern telecommunications operations must coordinate heterogeneous network technologies, stringent service-level commitments, geographically distributed engineering resources, and increasingly complex operational data. Existing tools often address prediction, prioritization, workforce dispatch, optimization, and explainability as separate functions. This paper proposes the Adaptive Cognitive Telecom Operations Framework (ACTOF), a vendor-neutral conceptual decision-support framework that integrates AI-assisted operational analytics with dynamic incident prioritization, engineer suitability assessment, adaptive scheduling, explainable recommendations, human approval, and controlled learning. ACTOF is organized around a five-layer reference architecture and an eight-stage adaptive decision cycle. Its analytical core combines the Dynamic Incident Priority Index (DIPI), Engineer Suitability Score (ESS), and Adaptive Cognitive Incident Scheduling Algorithm (ACISA). DIPI prioritizes incidents using business impact, remaining SLA time, predicted failure risk, network criticality, and recurrence. ESS evaluates candidate engineers using technical competency, certification, historical performance, availability, proximity, and workload. ACISA integrates these scores within a constrained multi-objective assignment process that can be recalculated when operational conditions change. The study follows a Design Science Research orientation and presents ACTOF as a conceptual artifact rather than an empirically validated production system. A conceptual evaluation matrix is therefore proposed for future expert review, prototype testing, case studies, and comparative experiments. The contribution is the architectural integration of prioritization, workforce intelligence, adaptive optimization, explainability, and human accountability into one traceable telecom incident-management lifecycle.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了自适应认知电信运营框架（ACTOF），这是一个供应商中立的决策支持概念框架，通过五层参考架构和八阶段自适应决策周期，将AI辅助运营分析、动态事件优先级排序、工程师能力评估、自适应调度、可解释推荐、人工审批和受控学习整合到一个可追踪的电信事件管理生命周期中。
AI.research_question: 如何将预测、优先级排序、人力调度、优化和可解释性整合到一个统一的、供应商中立的电信运营决策支持框架中，以应对异构网络技术、严格服务水平承诺和复杂运营数据的挑战？
AI.motivation: 现有电信运营工具将预测、优先级排序、人力调度、优化和可解释性作为独立功能分别处理，缺乏一个统一的、集成的决策支持框架来协调这些功能，无法有效应对现代电信运营中异构网络技术、严格SLA承诺、地理分布工程资源和复杂运营数据带来的挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学研究（Design Science Research）方法论框架
AI.method: 遵循设计科学研究导向，提出ACTOF概念框架，包含五层参考架构和八阶段自适应决策周期。分析核心由三个组件构成：动态事件优先级指数（DIPI）、工程师适宜性评分（ESS）和自适应认知事件调度算法（ACISA）。提出概念评估矩阵用于未来专家评审、原型测试、案例研究和比较实验。
AI.findings: 提出了一个集成的概念框架ACTOF，将优先级排序、人力资源智能、自适应优化、可解释性和人类问责整合到一个可追踪的电信事件管理生命周期中。该框架目前作为概念性人工制品提出，尚未经过实证验证。
AI.theory_contributions: 理论贡献在于架构层面整合了多个原本分离的功能领域（事件优先级排序、人力资源智能、自适应优化、可解释性、人类问责），形成了一个统一的电信事件管理生命周期框架，为后续实证研究提供了概念基础和评估矩阵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为电信运营商提供了一个供应商中立的、可追踪的事件管理决策支持框架参考架构，包含具体的计算指标（DIPI、ESS、ACISA）和自适应决策流程，可用于指导实际系统的设计与开发。

title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Strategic Human Resource Management in Indian Public Sector Enterprises

detail.title: Artificial Intelligence as a Catalyst for Strategic Human Resource Management in Indian Public Sector Enterprises
detail.abstract: While substantial literature explores the adoption of Artificial Intelligence (AI) within private-sector organizations, limited empirical attention has been given to understanding its strategic impact on Human Resource Management (HRM) within Public Sector Enterprises (PSEs). This study addresses this critical gap by examining AI as a catalyst for strategic HRM transformations within the complex, bureaucratic environment of Indian PSEs. Utilizing a survey-based empirical approach, this research examines respondents' perceptions regarding AI applications across key HR functions, including recruitment, employee development, workforce management, employee experience, and organizational decision-making. The empirical findings indicate that respondents hold a highly positive perception of AI, recognizing its significant potential to optimize resource utilization, reduce administrative workloads, and improve operational accuracy. Specifically, AI was perceived as highly beneficial in candidate screening during recruitment, personalized employee development, and data-driven workforce planning. However, the study also highlights critical structural bottlenecks to successful deployment, including prominent concerns regarding algorithmic bias, data privacy, security, and potential employment displacement. The research concludes that AI acts as a powerful collaborative tool rather than a replacement for human talent. Long-term integration success depends directly on balancing technical innovation with robust ethical governance, organizational readiness, and human oversight.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过问卷调查，考察了印度公共部门企业（PSEs）中人工智能（AI）对战略人力资源管理（HRM）转型的影响。研究发现受访者对AI持高度积极态度，认为其在招聘筛选、个性化员工发展和数据驱动的劳动力规划方面具有显著价值，但同时也面临算法偏见、数据隐私、安全和就业替代等结构性障碍。研究结论认为AI是强大的协作工具而非人类才能的替代品，长期整合成功取决于技术创新与伦理治理、组织准备度和人类监督之间的平衡。
AI.research_question: AI在印度公共部门企业中对战略人力资源管理转型具有怎样的影响？AI在关键人力资源职能中的应用感知、其感知收益以及部署中的结构性瓶颈是什么？
AI.motivation: 已有大量文献探讨了私营部门组织中AI的采用，但对公共部门企业中AI对人力资源管理战略影响的实证关注有限。本研究旨在填补这一关键研究空白，聚焦于印度复杂官僚环境下的公共部门企业。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本研究基于战略人力资源管理理论，将AI视为推动HRM战略转型的催化剂，并结合技术采纳与组织变革的相关理论视角，考察AI在官僚化公共部门环境中的整合路径。
AI.method: 采用基于问卷调查的实证研究方法，考察受访者对AI在招聘、员工发展、劳动力管理、员工体验和组织决策等关键HR职能中应用的感知。
AI.findings: （1）受访者对AI持有高度积极感知，认可其在优化资源利用、减少行政工作量、提高运营准确性方面的潜力；（2）AI在招聘候选筛选、个性化员工发展、数据驱动劳动力规划方面被认为高度有益；（3）同时存在关键结构性瓶颈，包括算法偏见、数据隐私、安全问题和潜在就业替代等突出关切。
AI.theory_contributions: 拓展了AI与战略人力资源管理交叉领域的实证研究，将研究情境从私营部门延伸至公共部门企业，揭示了在官僚化环境中AI作为协作工具而非替代品的战略定位，丰富了关于公共部门技术采纳与伦理治理的理论讨论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度公共部门企业及类似官僚化组织提供AI部署的实践指导，强调AI在招聘、员工发展和劳动力规划中的具体应用价值，同时警示算法偏见、数据隐私和就业替代等风险，建议在技术创新与伦理治理、组织准备度和人类监督之间取得平衡。

title: The Digital Ruble as a Monetary Policy Tool of the Bank of Russia: Operational Aspects and Macroeconomic Implications

detail.title: The Digital Ruble as a Monetary Policy Tool of the Bank of Russia: Operational Aspects and Macroeconomic Implications
detail.abstract: This article examines the digital ruble as a promising monetary policy tool for the Bank of Russia. It first describes the operational architecture of the platform, which is based on a two-tier retail model (the so-called Model D), in which the Bank of Russia acts as both issuer and platform operator, while commercial banks retain the role of intermediaries. It then analyzes the theoretical rationale for incorporating central bank digital currencies into the system of money forms and shows how the transmission mechanism of monetary policy changes once a new form of the ruble appears. Particular attention is paid to the risk of disintermediation-the outflow of funds from banks to the regulator's platform. To determine which of these effects are realistic, this study conducts a comparative analysis of international experience using the examples of the digital currencies of the central banks of China (e-CNY) and Nigeria (eNaira), and uses scenario modeling to assess the potential macroeconomic consequences of the widespread adoption of the digital ruble. The results show that the benefits and risks of the project largely depend on how carefully its parameters-limits, remuneration, and the pace of rollout-are calibrated; it is this fine-tuning that determines whether financial stability is preserved.

AI.tldr: 本文研究数字卢布作为俄罗斯央行货币政策工具的可行性，分析了其基于双层零售模式（Model D）的运营架构，探讨了引入央行数字货币对货币传导机制的影响，并通过国际比较（中国e-CNY和尼日利亚eNaira）及情景建模评估了广泛采用数字卢布可能带来的宏观经济后果。研究发现，该项目的收益和风险很大程度上取决于参数（限额、报酬、推出节奏）的精准校准。
AI.research_question: 数字卢布能否作为俄罗斯央行有效的货币政策工具？其广泛采用将如何影响货币传导机制和金融稳定？
AI.motivation: 随着全球央行数字货币（CBDC）兴起，俄罗斯需要评估引入数字卢布对货币政策和金融体系的影响，特别是中间化风险（资金从商业银行流向央行平台）这一核心挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币形态理论、货币政策传导机制理论、金融脱媒（disintermediation）理论
AI.method: 规范分析（制度架构描述）、比较案例分析（中国e-CNY和尼日利亚eNaira）、情景建模（scenario modeling）评估宏观经济后果
AI.findings: 数字卢布的收益与风险高度依赖于限额、报酬和推出节奏等参数的精细校准；适当的参数设置可以维护金融稳定。
AI.theory_contributions: 将CBDC纳入货币形态体系进行分析，阐明了新货币形式出现后货币政策传导机制的变化，并对金融脱媒风险提供了理论分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为俄罗斯央行在数字卢布的参数设计（限额、报酬、推出节奏）上提供政策建议，并为其他考虑实施CBDC的央行提供国际比较经验参考。

Logistical Attrition, The JNIM-FLA Alignment, and The Reshaping of Security Dependencies as of 26 July 2026

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study did not involve human participants, patients, personal data, or animal subjects. Ethics approval was therefore not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Mali’s July 2026 military campaign shifted the conflict’s centre of gravity. The coordinated attacks of 4 July against Aguelhoc, Anefis, Gao, Sevare, and Kenioroba dispersed the Malian armed forces and their partners. On 18 July, the Tabrichat ambush against a convoy travelling from Anefis to Gao confirmed that retaining a position no longer ensures control over its lines of communication. The precise casualty count remains contested, but deaths, captures, and material losses are established at a level that makes the episode a major operational setback. This paper develops the concept of corridor sovereignty to describe a configuration in which the state retains administrative nodes, air assets, and strike capacity while having to militarise movement between its own positions. The JNIM-FLA alignment increases this vulnerability while their political projects remain distinct. Online footage apparently showing surrendered soldiers, followed by United Nations allegations of torture and killing, adds a crisis of law and evidence to the military crisis. Rapprochement with Algeria, continuing Russian support, and the prospect of U.S. involvement point to plural security dependence rather than recovered autonomy. The most likely short-term course combines airstrikes, large escorts, diversified external support, and persistent attrition. Restoring continuous sovereignty requires a logistics doctrine, verifiable public information, political differentiation among adversaries, and renewed regional mediation.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分析马里2026年7月军事行动（特别是7月4日针对多个地点的协同攻击与7月18日的塔布里查特伏击），提出"走廊主权"概念，用以描述国家保留行政节点、空中资产与打击能力，但必须在其自身据点之间实行军事化调动的状态。文章还探讨了JNIM-FLA联盟带来的脆弱性、军队危机引发的法律与证据危机，以及多元化安全依赖的前景。
AI.research_question: 马里2026年7月军事行动如何改变冲突重心？在此背景下，国家主权呈现何种新形态（"走廊主权"）？
AI.motivation: 马里2026年7月的军事行动显著改变了冲突格局，传统据点控制已无法保障交通线的安全，需要新概念来理解这一变化中的国家主权形态与冲突动态。
AI.theoretical_framework: 走廊主权（corridor sovereignty）概念——区别于连续主权（continuous sovereignty），描述国家仅在节点保有控制权、而节点间移动须军事化的主权形态。
AI.method: 对2026年7月马里军事行动的事件分析，包括对战斗经过、伤亡及损失、网络影像证据、联合国指控及国际关系动态的综合考察。
AI.findings: 马里军队在7月战斗中遭受重大作战挫折；JNIM-FLA联盟虽政治目标各异但加剧了马里脆弱性；投降士兵影像与联合国对其酷刑及处决的指控构成法律与证据危机；与阿尔及利亚的和解、俄罗斯持续支持及美国可能介入导致多元安全依赖而非恢复自主；短期内最可能路径是空袭、大规模护卫、多元外部支持与持续消耗相结合。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"走廊主权"概念，为理解弱国家在保有节点控制但与丧失区域连续控制之间的主权形态提供了新的理论工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 指出恢复连续主权需要后勤条令、可验证的公共信息、对敌对势力的政治区分以及重新启动区域调解，为相关各方政策调整提供参考。

title: Nowcasting Ghana's Quarterly GDP using Hybrid Econometric and Machine Learning Algorithms
affiliations: , Wits Business School and University of the Witwatersrand

detail.title: Nowcasting Ghana's Quarterly GDP using Hybrid Econometric and Machine Learning Algorithms

declarations.declarationOfInterest: There are no financial relationships.
declarations.ethicsApproval: The study did not involve participants, hence there was no need for written consent. However, secondary data was appropriately collected for the study.
declarations.funderStatement: The study was funded by the authors.

detail.abstract: This study develops an explainable artificial intelligence (XAI)-driven hybrid econometricmachine learning framework for nowcasting and forecasting Ghana's quarterly GDP, addressing the absence of a robust real-time forecasting system for macroeconomic policymaking. Using quarterly data from 2000Q1-2024Q4, the study develops and evaluates 29 standalone and hybrid econometric and machine learning models. Feature engineering and selection were applied to 30 high-frequency domestic and international indicators, identifying the 10 most significant predictors of GDP growth. The proposed FAVAR-XGBoost model emerged as the best-performing algorithm, achieving a Root Mean Square Error (RMSE) of 0.845 and an " # of 0.932, outperforming all benchmark econometric and standalone machine learning models. To address the "black-box" challenge associated with artificial intelligence, the study employs SHapley Additive exPlanations (SHAP) to quantify the contribution of each predictor to GDP forecasts, thereby enhancing model transparency and supporting evidencebased policy decisions. The study contributes to the literature by demonstrating the superiority of hybrid econometric-machine learning models for GDP nowcasting in data-constrained economies, developing a scalable framework for real-time macroeconomic surveillance, and advancing the application of explainable AI in macroeconomic forecasting. The findings suggest that hybrid models can substantially improve the accuracy, interpretability, and policy relevance of GDP nowcasts. It is recommended that the Bank of Ghana, the Ministry of Finance, and other central banks adopt the proposed FAVAR-XGBoost framework to strengthen real-time GDP monitoring and support timely monetary and fiscal policy decisions.

AI.tldr: 本文开发了一个基于可解释人工智能（XAI）的混合计量经济学-机器学习框架，用于加纳季度GDP的即时预测和预测，提出了FAVAR-XGBoost混合模型，在29个基准模型中表现最优（RMSE为0.845，R²为0.932），并通过SHAP方法增强模型可解释性，为数据受限经济体的实时宏观经济监测提供了可扩展的政策支持框架。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一个准确、可解释且具政策相关性的人工智能驱动的混合计量经济学-机器学习框架，用于数据受限经济体（以加纳为例）的季度GDP即时预测与预测？
AI.motivation: 加纳缺乏稳健的实时GDP预测系统，宏观经济政策制定面临数据滞后和信息不充分的挑战，需要开发更准确的预测模型为货币政策与财政政策决策提供及时支持。
AI.theoretical_framework: 可解释人工智能（XAI）、因子增强向量自回归（FAVAR）模型、极端梯度提升（XGBoost）算法、SHAP（SHapley Additive exPlanations）可解释性理论、混合计量经济学-机器学习方法论。
AI.method: 使用2000Q1-2024Q4的加纳季度数据，对30个高频国内与国际指标进行特征工程和选择，识别出10个最重要的GDP增长预测因子。构建并评估29个独立及混合的计量经济学与机器学习模型，其中FAVAR-XGBoost为最优混合模型，并采用SHAP量化各预测因子对GDP预测的贡献。
AI.findings: FAVAR-XGBoost混合模型表现最优，RMSE为0.845，R²为0.932，超越所有基准计量经济学模型和独立机器学习模型；SHAP分析成功识别出10个最重要的GDP增长预测因子并量化其贡献，增强了模型透明度和可解释性。
AI.theory_contributions: 证明了混合计量经济学-机器学习模型在数据受限经济体的GDP即时预测中具有显著优越性；提出了一个可扩展的实时宏观经济监测框架；推进了可解释人工智能（XAI）在宏观经济预测领域的理论应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为加纳银行、财政部及其他中央银行提供了可直接采用的FAVAR-XGBoost预测框架，以加强实时GDP监测，支持及时的货币与财政政策决策，同时通过SHAP提升模型透明度以支持基于证据的政策制定。

title: The Reverse Acquihire as Governance Failure: A Transactional-Value Diagnosis of the AI-Era M&A Wave

detail.title: The Reverse Acquihire as Governance Failure: A Transactional-Value Diagnosis of the AI-Era M&A Wave
detail.abstract: Between March 2024 and early 2026, a new class of merger transaction emerged in the artificial-intelligence sector — the reverse acquihire — in which a large incumbent firm pays a substantial sum to license a startup's technology and to hire its founders and key engineering staff, while leaving the formal corporate entity nominally intact. Microsoft-Inflection, Google-Character.AI, Amazon-Adept, Google-Windsurf, and at least a dozen related transactions deployed this structure to acquire approximately twenty billion dollars of AI-sector capabilities while substantially reducing regulatory exposure. The deals have drawn investigation from the U.S. Federal Trade Commission and Department of Justice, the German Federal Cartel Office, the UK Competition and Markets Authority, and U.S. Senate inquiry. Public reporting suggests that several of the deals have also produced characteristic post-transaction failures: stranded startups, demoralized remaining staff, partial technology transfer, and high founder turnover at the acquirer within months of deal closure. The pattern is sufficiently widespread that several leading firms have publicly walked back the acquihire model in early 2026 in favor of more conventional acquisition structures. This paper argues that the reverse acquihire is best understood not as a regulatory-arbitrage innovation but as a governance-structure failure, predictable in advance by the transactional-value framework of Zajac and Olsen (1993) and the virtual-institution model of Olsen (1997). The structure attempts to use a market-equivalent governance mode (licensing) for transactions whose proximity to the firms' nexus of intellectual assets places them firmly in the supplementary category, where Olsen (1997) predicts hierarchical governance is uniquely capable of protecting both parties' competitive position. The transactional-value loss is empirically observable in the post-deal trajectories of the documented cases. The paper develops the diagnosis through the formal ENPV decision rule, identifies four design failures that characterize the reverse-acquihire structure, and offers four prescriptions for M&A practitioners and AI founders confronting the same class of transaction.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了2024年3月至2026年初在人工智能领域出现的新型并购交易——"反向收购雇佣"（reverse acquihire），即大型在位企业支付高额费用获取初创公司技术许可并雇佣其创始人和核心工程人员，但名义上保留该初创公司的法人实体。论文认为这种结构并非监管套利创新，而是一种治理结构失败，可以通过Zajac和Olsen（1993）的交易价值框架及Olsen（1997）的虚拟制度模型提前预测。
AI.research_question: 反向收购雇佣（reverse acquihire）作为一种新兴AI并购交易结构，其本质是什么？为何会导致交易后失败？
AI.motivation: 至少十几起此类交易涉及约200亿美元的AI能力收购，虽减少了监管暴露，但引发了多国监管机构调查，且多起交易出现交易后失败（搁浅的初创公司、士气低落的留守员工、部分技术转移、收购方创始人高流动率），多家头部企业已在2026年初公开放弃该模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. Zajac和Olsen（1993）的交易价值框架（transactional-value framework）；2. Olsen（1997）的虚拟制度模型（virtual-institution model）；3. ENPV（扩展净现值）决策规则。
AI.method: 理论诊断与案例实证分析：通过正式ENPV决策规则进行形式化诊断，识别反向收购雇佣结构的四个设计缺陷，并基于已记录案例的交易后轨迹进行经验观察。
AI.findings: 反向收购雇佣试图使用市场等价治理模式（许可）来处理与公司知识产权核心资产紧密相关的交易，而这些交易属于补充性（supplementary）类别，Olsen（1997）预测只有在层级治理下才能保护双方的竞争地位。交易价值损失在已记录案例的交易后轨迹中可被经验观察。
AI.theory_contributions: 将反向收购雇佣重新框定为治理结构失败而非监管套利创新，扩展了交易价值框架和虚拟制度模型在AI并购领域的适用性，并通过ENPV决策规则提供了形式化的诊断工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 识别了反向收购雇佣结构的四个设计失败，并为并购从业者和AI创始人面对同类交易提供了四条处方建议。

title: Fact-Law Confusion
affiliations: Washington University in St. Louis - School of Law

detail.title: Fact-Law Confusion
detail.abstract:
“This is a question of fact for the jury.” “That is a question of law for the judge.” Such statements are ubiquitous in our law, and their ubiquity suggests a commonly understood meaning. But what do they actually mean? The answer is not as clear as it might seem. The statements could mean that questions of fact must be decided by juries and questions of law by judges. Or they could mean that questions of fact (law) may be decided by a jury (judge). Or they could signal something between must and may—that questions of fact (law) are ordinarily or usually or presumptively for juries (judges) to decide. What, then, is the connection between the nature of a question (factual  or legal) and the choice of decider (jury or judge)? The common catchphrases leave the answer ambiguous.

The purpose of this Article is to clarify that ambiguity in the context of civil cases and to correct the confusions it causes among courts and commentators. The proper understanding of the two catchphrases, I contend, is asymmetric. “That is a question of law for the judge” means that questions of law must be decided by a judge whereas “this is a question of fact for the jury” means that questions of fact may be decided by a jury, which is to say that questions of fact may also be decided by a judge in the appropriate case. Specifically, a judge may decide a question of fact when its answer is sufficiently clear.

A corollary of this thesis is that in American federal civil litigation, there are no questions that are always for juries to decide. Nor, I will show, is there such a thing as a question that is usually for juries. That idea sounds reasonable and is often repeated, but it is in fact dangerously misleading.

By disentangling the issue of the nature of the question (factual or legal) from the issue of who decides it (jury or judge), and by elucidating the proper relationship between the two, I contribute to caselaw and scholarly commentary across a variety of substantive fields. Clearer apprehension of how the nature- of-the-question question affects the who-decides question can help better understand how the Seventh Amendment weighs in on judge-jury allocation. It can improve summary judgment practice in a variety of substantive fields when questions such as ascertaining a person’s state of mind or assessing the reasonableness of a person’s conduct are at issue. It can inform scholarly discourse on patent reform and copyright fair use. It can set Ninth Circuit copyright law straight after decades of ruinous error. And it can help the Supreme Court avoid similar errors in a trademark case to be decided next Term.

AI.tldr: 本文澄清了美国民事诉讼法中"事实问题由陪审团裁决"和"法律问题由法官裁决"这两句常见短语的模糊含义，提出两者具有不对称性：法律问题必须由法官裁决，而事实问题可以由陪审团裁决，也可以由法官在答案足够清晰时裁决。因此，在美国联邦民事诉讼中，不存在总是或通常由陪审团裁决的问题。
AI.research_question: "事实问题由陪审团裁决"和"法律问题由法官裁决"这两句常见法律短语的实际含义是什么？问题的性质（事实或法律）与裁决者（陪审团或法官）的选择之间存在怎样的正确关系？
AI.motivation: 这两句短语在美国法律中无处不在，但其含义模糊不清——既可理解为"必须"，也可理解为"可以"或"通常"。这种模糊性在法院和学者中造成了混淆，迫切需要澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 美国宪法第七修正案关于陪审团审判权的规定；事实问题与法律问题的性质区分理论；法官-陪审团权力分配理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析，通过逻辑推理和法律解释来澄清法律短语的含义，并结合美国联邦民事诉讼的实践进行论证。
AI.findings: 这两句短语的含义是不对称的："法律问题由法官裁决"意味着法律问题必须由法官裁决，而"事实问题由陪审团裁决"意味着事实问题可以由陪审团裁决，但在答案足够清晰时也可由法官裁决。因此，美国联邦民事诉讼中不存在总是或通常由陪审团裁决的问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了法律中两个核心短语的真实含义，解开了问题性质与裁决者选择之间的概念混淆，为理解第七修正案下法官与陪审团的权力分配提供了更清晰的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 改善各实体法领域的即决判决实践（如涉及人的心理状态或行为合理性的问题）；为专利改革和版权合理使用的学术讨论提供信息；纠正第九巡回法院在版权法上的长期错误；帮助最高法院避免在商标案件中重犯类似错误。

title: Public Trader Identity: Adverse Selection and Return Predictability

detail.title: Public Trader Identity: Adverse Selection and Return Predictability
detail.abstract: Informed traders are supposed to need anonymity: they profit by hiding among the uninformed. A decentralized exchange now publishes the counterparty. Every committed order, cancellation, rejection, and fill carries a persistent pseudonymous wallet address. We reconstruct the full-depth limit order book from a record of 17.1 billion messages and 14.3 million aggressive orders by 147,113 wallets, covering $84.3 billion in taker notional. We report three findings. First, informativeness is a persistent wallet attribute. Wallets ranked by the price movement following their aggressive orders retain that ordering across adjacent ten-day windows, with a rank correlation of 0.52. Second, the ranking predicts returns. Adding the live activity of the highest-ranked wallets to a standard anonymous benchmark of prices, quotes, and order flow raises the out-of-sample R² for one-second returns to 12.31%, a 13.2% gain (t = 9.2) that is 1.6 times the largest of 200 activity-matched placebo cohorts. Third, measured at realized trades rather than at every sampled moment, the increment grows from 1.43 to 2.47 percentage points of R². Public wallet histories therefore carry short-horizon price information that anonymous order-book data leave unmeasured.

AI.tldr: 本文利用去中心化交易所（DEX）公开的持久化假名钱包地址数据，重构了完整的限价订单簿（17.1亿条消息、1430万笔激进订单、147,113个钱包、843亿美元成交额），发现交易者的信息优势是钱包层面的持久属性，且公开的钱包历史记录包含了匿名订单簿数据无法捕捉的短期价格信息。
AI.research_question: 去中心化交易所公开的持久化假名钱包地址是否携带匿名订单簿数据无法观测的短期价格信息？交易者的信息优势是否是一种可预测、可交易的持久属性？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为知情交易者依赖匿名性获利（隐藏在不知情交易者之中），但去中心化交易所（DEX）的交易记录中每笔委托、取消、拒绝和成交都携带持久化的假名钱包地址，这为研究知情交易者的可识别性和信息优势的持续性提供了前所未有的数据机会。
AI.theoretical_framework: 市场微观结构理论中的知情交易理论（informed trading）、信息不对称与价格发现理论，以及交易者异质性/持久性假说。
AI.method: 利用DEX（去中心化交易所）的17.1亿条订单簿消息数据重构全深度限价订单簿，识别14.3百万笔激进订单和147,113个钱包的持仓行为。通过钱包激进订单后的价格变动对交易者信息优势进行排序，使用相邻10天窗口的秩相关检验持久性（Spearman秩相关系数0.52），并用样本外R²回归检验最高排名钱包实时活动的预测能力（含基线匿名基准和200个活动匹配的安慰剂队列对照）。
AI.findings: 第一，信息优势是钱包的持久属性：按激进订单后价格变动排序的钱包排名在相邻10天窗口间秩相关系数为0.52。第二，排名能预测收益：将最高排名钱包的实时活动加入标准匿名基准（价格、报价和订单流）后，1秒收益的样本外R²提高到12.31%，提升13.2%（t=9.2），是200个活动匹配安慰剂队列中最大效果的1.6倍。第三，按实际成交而非逐笔采样衡量时，R²增量从1.43个百分点增至2.47个百分点。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了知情交易者必须匿名的传统假设，表明即使交易者的身份以假名形式公开，其信息优势仍然持续存在。将知情交易者的识别从"交易行为特征"拓展到"钱包身份持久属性"，为市场微观结构理论中信息不对称的度量提供了基于公开链上数据的新视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为DEX交易者提供了可操作的参考策略：通过追踪历史表现优异钱包的实时活动来预测短期价格走势。为监管者和市场参与者在去中心化金融市场中进行市场监控、风险管理和价格预测提供了新的数据方法和实证基础。

title: The Endogenous Elasticity of Substitution: Verification Cost, Task Interaction, and the Baumol Bottleneck
affiliations: University of Exeter

detail.title: The Endogenous Elasticity of Substitution: Verification Cost, Task Interaction, and the Baumol Bottleneck
detail.abstract: When tasks are gross complements, the expenditure share of the task set that cannot be cheaply checked rises to one and the return to improving the rest vanishes. Research effort must move toward verification. I show that a decentralised economy makes that move at roughly the right time and in the wrong proportions. Verification divides into raising performance on unverifiable tasks, which is embodied in withheld model weights, and constructing checkers, which must be disclosed to be relied upon and legible to be sound. The market under-supplies construction by a factor of 1.6 to 11, depending on an appropriability ratio that disclosure behaviour signs but does not size. The paper's general result concerns the elasticity of substitution itself. If the production function is an envelope over techniques, complementarity survives aggregation only when the best techniques are best at everything: substitution consists of switching to a specialist, and general capability leaves nothing to switch to. Frontier models are general in exactly this sense, and the condition is measurable. Verification cost is a decreasing power of the elasticity, so relative elasticities are recoverable from machine-checked proof records; and once interaction density is a design choice, the elasticity is a price ratio-marginal verification cost over marginal return to integration. Cheaper verification therefore buys tighter coupling and strengthens the bottleneck it was meant to relieve, so the efficient instrument pays for checkers rather than for cheaper checking.

AI.tldr: 本文研究当任务为完全互补时，不可廉价验证的任务集的支出份额趋近于1，其余任务的回报趋近于0，因此研究努力必须转向验证领域。作者证明去中心化经济在验证转向的时间上大致正确，但在比例上存在偏差：验证分为提升不可验证任务表现（体现为不公开的模型权重）和构建检查器（必须公开且可读才能被依赖），市场对检查器构建的供给不足1.6至11倍。论文的普适结论涉及替代弹性：若生产函数是技术的包络，只有当最优技术在各方面都最优时，互补性才能在加总中幸存；前沿模型正是这种意义上的通用技术。验证成本是弹性的递减幂函数，相对弹性可从机器检查的证明记录中恢复；一旦交互密度成为设计选择，弹性即为价格比率（边际验证成本对边际集成回报）。更便宜的验证反而会强化瓶颈，因此有效的工具应补贴检查器构建而非降低检查成本。
AI.research_question: 在任务完全互补（gross complements）的生产环境中，去中心化经济是否以及在多大程度上会最优地分配资源以进行验证相关的研究努力？具体而言，市场在构建检查器（checkers）与提升不可验证任务表现之间的资源配置是否存在系统性偏差？
AI.motivation: 当任务为完全互补时，不可廉价验证的任务集成为瓶颈，支出份额趋近于1，其余任务的回报趋近于0，研究投入必须转向验证。但去中心化经济中验证努力（分为模型权重体现的表现提升与必须公开的检查器构建）的配置比例是否有效率，以及弹性本身是否可测、验证成本与弹性之间的关系，都是待解决的重要问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 任务互补性与替代弹性理论；生产函数的包络（envelope）理论；去中心化经济下的激励与appropriability（可占有性）理论；验证经济学的成本-收益框架。
AI.method: 理论建模与推导。论文通过构建生产函数加总框架，分析任务互补条件下的支出份额动态，推导市场化的验证资源配置均衡，并利用披露行为对appropriability比率进行符号识别。同时通过包络生产函数分析替代弹性的可测性，利用机器检查的证明记录恢复相对弹性，并将交互密度作为设计选择来推导弹性的价格比率表达式。
AI.findings: (1) 去中心化经济转向验证的时机大致正确，但配置比例错误：市场对检查器构建的供给不足1.6至11倍（取决于appropriability比率）；(2) 互补性在加总层面能否幸存取决于最优技术是否在各方面都最优——只有通用型技术（如前沿模型）才能保持互补性，且该条件可测；(3) 验证成本是弹性的递减幂函数，相对弹性可从机器检查的证明记录中恢复；(4) 当交互密度成为设计选择时，弹性等于边际验证成本与边际集成回报的价格比率；(5) 更便宜的验证会导致更紧耦合，强化原本意图缓解的瓶颈，因此有效工具应补贴检查器构建而非降低检查成本。
AI.theory_contributions: (1) 将验证问题系统性地引入任务互补与生产函数加总理论，揭示验证作为独立生产要素的经济学含义；(2) 严格证明了互补性在加总中幸存的条件（最优技术须在各方面最优），为替代弹性的加总理论提供了新条件；(3) 建立了验证成本与替代弹性之间的幂函数关系，使弹性可通过机器检查的证明记录进行实证恢复；(4) 提出交互密度作为设计选择时弹性的价格比率表达式，将抽象弹性概念与可观测的价格比率联系起来。
AI.practical_contributions: (1) 为验证资源配置提供了量化基准：指出市场对检查器构建的供给不足需要1.6至11倍的干预；(2) 指出有效的政策工具应补贴检查器构建而非降低检查成本，因为更便宜的验证反而会强化瓶颈；(3) 提供了一种利用机器检查证明记录来恢复相对替代弹性的实证方法；(4) 对AI模型权重开放与验证政策的讨论提供了经济学框架——模型权重作为不可验证任务的体现，检查器需要公开可读才能被依赖。
