detail.title: Amicus Brief of Antitrust Law, Economics, and Business Professors in Support of Plaintiffs - US v. Google D.C Circuit

declarations.funderStatement: All parties consented to the filing of this brief. No party’s counsel authored this brief in whole or in part, no party or their counsel contributed money intended to fund the preparation or submission of this brief, and no person other than Amici Curiae or their counsel contributed money that was intended to fund preparing or submitting the brief. Amici have no financial interests in the outcome of this litigation.

detail.abstract:
Amici curiae are dozens of professors of law, economics, and business who have researched and published extensively on antitrust issues. Though our work spans a range of methodologies, we share an interest in ensuring that U.S. antitrust law is coherent and effective in both condemning legal violations and

implementing effective remedies.

We write to explain that this case presents an important opportunity for this Court to: (I) affirm that Google’s monopoly power and exclusionary conduct gave rise to a quintessential Sherman Act § 2 violation; and (II) reverse and remand the lower court’s remedial decision insofar as it declined to terminate Google’s exclusionary conduct, a choice that departed from governing precedent and sound antitrust policy.

AI.tldr: 本文是一份法庭之友（Amici curiae）意见书，由数十位反垄断领域的法学、经济学和商学教授联合撰写。他们指出本案为最高法院提供了重要机会，以确认谷歌的垄断势力与排他性行为构成典型的《谢尔曼法》第2条违法行为，同时请求法院推翻下级法院在救济裁决中未终止谷歌排他性行为的决定，认为该决定偏离了先例和健全的反垄断政策。
AI.research_question: 谷歌的垄断势力与排他性行为是否构成《谢尔曼法》第2条的典型违法行为？下级法院拒绝终止谷歌排他性行为的救济裁决是否偏离了先例和健全的反垄断政策？
AI.motivation: 本案为最高法院提供了重要机会，以澄清和强化美国反垄断法的连贯性与有效性，确保其既能有效认定违法行为，又能实施有效的救济措施。作者们认为下级法院在救济阶段的裁决存在缺陷，偏离了既有法律先例和合理政策。
AI.theoretical_framework: 《谢尔曼法》第2条（Sherman Act § 2）反垄断法律框架，涉及垄断势力（monopoly power）的认定、排他性行为（exclusionary conduct）的法律标准，以及反垄断救济（antitrust remedies）的原则。
AI.method: 法律分析法（legal analysis），通过法庭之友意见书的形式，基于对反垄断法律先例、学术研究和政策原则的系统梳理，对案件的违法性认定和救济裁决进行法律论证。
AI.findings: 1. 谷歌的垄断势力与排他性行为构成《谢尔曼法》第2条的典型违法行为；2. 下级法院在救济裁决中拒绝终止谷歌排他性行为的决定偏离了既有先例和健全的反垄断政策，应当被推翻并发回重审。
AI.theory_contributions: 澄清了《谢尔曼法》第2条下垄断势力与排他性行为的认定标准在数字平台语境中的适用，并强调了反垄断救济必须有效终止违法排他性行为的原则。
AI.practical_contributions: 为最高法院提供了学术界的反垄断专业视角，主张对谷歌的排他性行为实施有效救济（终止排他性行为），对数字平台反垄断执法具有重要的政策指导意义。

title: Null-Validated Topological Signatures of Financial Market Dynamics

detail.title: Null-Validated Topological Signatures of Financial Market Dynamics

publicationDetails.detailsText: Communications in Nonlinear Science and Numerical Simulation, 2026[10.1016/j.cnsns.2026.110630]

detail.abstract: Financial markets exhibit temporal organization that is not fully captured by volatility measures or linear correlation structure. We study a null-validated topological approach for quantifying financial market complexity using Bitcoin daily log returns and the S&P 500 index as examples of cryptocurrency and broad U.S. equity market dynamics. The analysis uses the L 1 norm of the persistence landscapes computed from sliding-window delay embeddings. This quantity comoves strongly with stochastic volatility during periods of market stress, but the strength and form of this relationship vary over time and differ between the two markets. Surrogate-based null models provide statistical validation of these observations. Rejection of shuffle surrogates rules out explanations based on marginal distributions alone, while departures from phase randomized surrogates indicate sensitivity to nonlinear and phase-dependent temporal organization beyond linear correlations. These results demonstrate that persistence landscape norms provide complementary information about market dynamics across market conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于持续景观范数的零假设验证拓扑方法（TDA）来量化金融市场复杂性，以比特币日对数收益率和标普500指数为例，发现该指标在压力期与随机波动率强相关但关系随时间和市场而变化，并通过替身数据验证其捕捉线性相关之外的相位依赖非线性结构。
AI.research_question: 如何利用零假设验证的拓扑方法量化金融市场的复杂性？持续景观范数能否提供超越波动率和线性相关的互补信息？
AI.motivation: 金融市场表现出时间组织性，但现有的波动率指标和线性相关性结构无法充分捕捉这种复杂性，需要新的方法论来刻画市场的动态结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: 持续同调（Persistent Homology）与持续景观（Persistence Landscapes）、滑动窗口时滞嵌入（Sliding-Window Delay Embeddings）、随机波动率模型、替身数据检验（Surrogate-based null models）
AI.method: 对比特币日对数收益率和标普500指数进行滑动窗口时滞嵌入，计算持续景观的L1范数作为复杂性度量；与随机波动率进行比较分析；采用洗牌替身和相位随机化替身进行统计验证。
AI.findings: （1）持续景观L1范数与市场压力期随机波动率强共振；（2）该关系的强度和形式随时间变化且在不同市场间存在差异；（3）洗牌替身的拒绝排除了仅由边际分布解释的可能性；（4）相位随机化替身的偏离表明该方法对线性相关之外的相位依赖非线性结构敏感。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将零假设验证的拓扑数据分析框架系统应用于金融市场复杂性度量，证明了持续景观范数能捕捉线性相关性之外的时间组织信息，为计算拓扑方法在金融领域的应用提供了理论支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种新的市场状态监测指标，可帮助投资者和监管者在不同市场条件下（尤其是压力期）更全面地理解市场动态，辅助风险管理决策。

title: MuSE: a multiple macro-financial scenario simulation engine for stress testing
affiliations: , , European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), , European Central Bank (ECB) and European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: MuSE: a multiple macro-financial scenario simulation engine for stress testing
detail.abstract: We design an econometric framework to simulate multiple adverse macro-financial scenarios that can be used in top-down stress tests. First, we create a financial stress index informed by shocks generated via a non-parametric copula estimated on a large dataset of daily financial indicators. Second, we simulate the joint dynamics of macroeconomic indicators conditional on the copula-based financial shocks in a large multi-country Bayesian VAR model. This framework,which we refer to as the Multiple macro-financial stress scenario Simulation Engine, MuSE, allows us to replicate thousands of macro-financial stress scenarios where adverse shocks generated in the financial sector propagate into the overall economy, triggering significant macroeconomic fluctuations. We demonstrate its functionality by generating a large number of scenarios inspired from past crises capturing stress stemming from financial markets, sovereign debt, and geopolitical tensions. Using a top-down solvency stress test model, based on recent EU-wide stress tests, we project the capital depletion for euro area banks and find that adverse scenarios triggered by stock market and sovereign shocks appear to threaten the resilience of the euro area banking sector the most at this juncture.

AI.tldr: 本文设计了一个计量经济学框架（MuSE），用于模拟多种不利的宏观金融压力情景，并将其应用于自上而下的压力测试，以评估欧元区银行业的资本充足性。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个能够模拟多种不利宏观金融压力情景的计量框架，并将其应用于自上而下的银行压力测试？
AI.motivation: 现有压力测试框架在生成多种宏观金融压力情景方面存在局限，难以充分捕捉金融冲击向实体经济的传导效应，需要更灵活、数据驱动的模拟方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非参数copula模型、贝叶斯向量自回归（BVAR）模型、宏观金融传导理论
AI.method: 首先利用大规模日度金融指标数据集，通过非参数copula估计生成金融压力指数及其冲击分布；其次，在大规模多国贝叶斯VAR模型中，以copula生成的金融冲击为条件，模拟宏观经济指标的联合动态。
AI.findings: 基于历史危机的场景模拟发现，股票市场冲击和主权债务冲击所引发的压力情景对欧元区银行业资本充足性的威胁最大。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将copula方法与多国BVAR模型相结合的新型压力情景模拟框架（MuSE），丰富了宏观金融压力测试的方法论工具箱。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和监管机构提供了一种可操作的、能够生成大量宏观金融压力情景的模拟工具，有助于评估银行业在多种不利情景下的资本韧性。

detail.abstract: Status: This is an explicitly speculative research alpha. It converts the petroleum model's physical-risk probabilities into illustrative price and household-cost distributions using disclosed judgmental priors. It is not an official inflation forecast, investment advice, or a claim that the coefficients have already been econometrically estimated.

AI.tldr: 本文是一个明确标注为推测性的研究alpha，将石油模型的物理风险概率转化为说明性的价格和家庭成本分布，使用已公开的判断性先验。它不是官方通胀预测、投资建议，也未声称系数已经过计量经济学估计。
AI.research_question: 如何将石油模型的物理风险概率转化为说明性的价格分布和家庭成本分布？
AI.motivation: 需要探索石油物理风险对价格和家庭成本的影响，但由于该研究性质的推测性，需要明确说明其局限性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 石油模型的物理风险概率框架，结合判断性先验（judgmental priors）进行推断。
AI.method: 使用公开披露的判断性先验，将石油模型的物理风险概率转化为说明性的价格和家庭成本分布。
AI.findings: 该研究处于推测性阶段，尚未完成计量经济估计，输出仅为说明性分布而非官方预测。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供了一个将物理风险概率转化为经济影响分布的推测性分析框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为观察物理风险向价格和家庭成本传导提供说明性参考，但明确非官方预测或投资建议。

title: Financial frictions across the production network and the transmission of monetary policy
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank, European Central Bank (ECB) and

detail.title: Financial frictions across the production network and the transmission of monetary policy
detail.abstract: We show that monetary policy transmission is shaped not only by a sector’s own financial frictions but also by those prevailing in the broader production network. The latter, indirect frictions amplify the output and price effects of monetary policy and empirically dominate the direct ones. The amplification results from a downstream demand channel, as customers respond to tighter policy by purchasing fewer inputs. This is partly offset by an upstream cost channel, reflecting that suppliers raise prices to protect margins when financing costs rise. We inspect the mechanism in a multi-sector general equilibrium model with input-output linkages and working-capital constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文发现货币政策传导不仅受部门自身金融摩擦影响，还受生产网络中其他部门金融摩擦的间接影响，且间接摩擦在经验上主导直接摩擦，通过下游需求渠道放大货币政策对产出和价格的影响。
AI.research_question: 生产网络中的金融摩擦如何影响货币政策传导？直接摩擦与间接摩擦之间哪个在经验上占主导地位？其背后的机制是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有文献通常只关注部门自身金融摩擦对货币政策传导的影响，忽略了生产网络中上下游部门金融摩擦的溢出效应，需要更全面地理解货币政策在行业间传导的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 多部门一般均衡模型，包含投入-产出关联和营运资本约束的金融摩擦理论。
AI.method: 构建包含投入产出联系与营运资本约束的多部门一般均衡模型，并利用经验数据进行实证检验。
AI.findings: （1）生产网络中其他部门的间接金融摩擦会放大货币政策的产出和价格效应，且在经验上主导部门自身直接摩擦；（2）放大效应源于下游需求渠道（客户在紧缩政策下减少投入品购买）；（3）上游成本渠道部分抵消放大效应（供应商在融资成本上升时提高价格以保护利润率）。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融摩擦引入生产网络框架，揭示货币政策通过投入产出关联的溢出传导机制，区分了直接与间接金融摩擦的相对重要性，识别出下游需求渠道和上游成本渠道两个相互抵消的传导机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为中央银行和监管者理解货币政策的行业异质性影响提供新视角，提示政策制定者需要考虑生产网络结构对货币政策传导强度的影响，有助于更精准地评估和设计货币政策。

title: Prohibition of monetary financing: an economic perspective
affiliations: European Central Bank (ECB)

detail.title: Prohibition of monetary financing: an economic perspective
detail.abstract: This paper analyses the European prohibition of monetary financing from an economic perspective. The prohibition seeks to safeguard central bank independence in setting monetary policy to maintain price stability, and to preserve fiscal discipline, thereby preventing monetary policy from becoming constrained or hindered by fiscal policies. Imposing a prohibition on financing public deficits helps to ensure a clear separation of responsibilities between monetary policy and fiscal policy and is consistent with a range of macroeconomic theories, including monetarism and the fiscal theory of the price level. The current EU-wide ban is more stringent than those in place in Europe before the start of Economic and Monetary Union and also than those prevailing in other major currency areas of the world. Tasked with monitoring compliance with the prohibition among European national central banks, the European Central Bank (ECB) has developed certain standards over time, informed by definitions contained in EU regulations and by cases that have arisen over the years. Over the three decades since its introduction, the prohibition in general has been well respected, although a few actual or potential conflicts with the prohibition have required national central banks to take corrective action. Recent economic crises in Europe have given rise to academic proposals to reinterpret or circumvent the ban, notably during the COVID-19 pandemic. These suggestions have included central banks handing out “helicopter money” to the public and cancelling part of the government debt held by European central banks. In general, these proposals would seem to jeopardise the prohibition of monetary financing and ultimately weaken price stability and sound public finances.

AI.tldr: 本文从经济视角分析欧洲禁止货币融资的规定，探讨其理论基础、实施机制及近年来面临的理论挑战，认为该禁令对维护物价稳定和财政纪律至关重要。
AI.research_question: 欧洲禁止货币融资的规定在经济上有何理论依据？其实施效果如何？近期危机背景下的相关学术提案会带来什么影响？
AI.motivation: 欧洲货币融资禁令已实施三十余年，但在近年欧洲经济危机（尤其是COVID-19大流行）中，学术界出现了重新解释或规避该禁令的提案，有必要从经济视角系统评估这些提案的潜在影响。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币主义、物价水平的财政理论（FTPL）
AI.method: 经济理论分析结合制度与实证回顾：分析EU法规定义、ECB监督标准、历史案例及近期学术提案。
AI.findings: 该禁令比EMU成立前及世界其他主要货币区的规定更为严格；过去三十年间总体遵守良好，少数冲突案例已获纠正；近年"直升机撒钱"和债务取消等提案可能危及货币融资禁令，进而削弱物价稳定和公共财政健康。
AI.theory_contributions: 从经济理论视角系统论证了禁止货币融资的合理性，明确了货币政策与财政政策分离的理论基础，并对近年来挑战该禁令的学术提案进行了理论批判。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ECB及各国央行监督和执行货币融资禁令提供了理论与历史经验参考，警示政策制定者注意规避禁令的提案对物价稳定和财政纪律的潜在危害。

title: Macro-at-Risk in the euro area Expert Group on Macro-at-Risk Time-Series Workstream
affiliations: , Banque de France, European Central Bank, Bank of Estonia, European Central Bank, European Central Bank (ECB), European Central Bank (ECB), Banco de España, European Central Bank, , Bank of Greece, , Bank of Italy,  and Deutsche Bundesbank

detail.title: Macro-at-Risk in the euro area Expert Group on Macro-at-Risk Time-Series Workstream
detail.abstract: This paper introduces reduced-form macroeconometric tools, emphasising quantile regression models, to identify key risk drivers for the euro area economy and assess risks around the baseline ECB/Eurosystem staff macroeconomic projections for the euro area inflation and growth. The analysis uses a large number of risk factors, going beyond the usual financial factors, employing a sequential selection approach with robustness checks. To support the analysis a MATLAB toolbox (M@RX) was developed, incorporating several quantile regression-based model classes with a novel parametric tilting methodology and a copula approach for transforming predictive densities across frequencies. This paper contributes to the literature on the treatment of the COVID-era data in quantile regression models. Results indicate that the predictive content of risk factors is horizon, time and objective-dependent. For example, labour market indicators are particularly relevant for assessing upside inflation risks, but to a time-varying extent and with limited predictive power for downside risks. Conversely, uncertainty, money and credit indicators perform better for downside inflation risks. As regards risks to growth, the results confirm the established role of financial conditions, while also highlighting the relevance of monetary indicators, particularly for downside risks. Combined risk factor frameworks – with several different risk indicators – tend to systematically outperform single-factor specifications for density forecasting, due to complementarities across risk indicator groups. An empirical application highlights the policy relevance of these tools, as they provide timely signals and accurately track the direction of realised outcomes. Given the time-varying and state-dependent nature of their predictive performance, a regular performance assessment of the specifications is recommended to maintain reliability.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了基于分位数回归的简化型宏观经济计量工具，用于识别欧元区经济的关键风险驱动因素，并评估围绕ECB/Eurosystem员工宏观经济预测的通胀和增长风险。研究开发了MATLAB工具箱（M@RX），采用序贯选择方法并结合多种稳健性检验，发现风险因素的预测能力随时间、预测期限和预测目标而变化，综合风险因子框架在密度预测上系统性优于单一因子模型。
AI.research_question: 如何识别欧元区经济和通胀增长预测中的关键风险因素，并利用分位数回归等简化型宏观计量工具评估围绕基线预测的风险分布？
AI.motivation: 传统的点预测无法充分刻画宏观经济预测的不确定性，需要一套系统化的工具来识别风险驱动因素并量化预测风险的分布；且现有研究多局限于金融因素，需要拓展到更广泛的风险指标；此外，需要解决COVID时期数据在分位数回归模型中的处理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 分位数回归模型、参数化倾斜方法（parametric tilting）、copula方法（用于跨频率转换预测密度）、序贯选择方法
AI.method: 采用分位数回归模型，纳入大量超越传统金融因素的宏观风险因子，通过序贯选择方法配合稳健性检验筛选变量；开发MATLAB工具箱（M@RX），整合多种基于分位数回归的模型类别，包含新颖的参数化倾斜方法和用于跨频率预测密度转换的copula方法。
AI.findings: （1）风险因素的预测内容随预测期限、时间和目标而变化；（2）劳动力市场指标对上行通胀风险特别重要，但具有时变特征且对下行风险预测能力有限；（3）不确定性和货币信贷指标对下行通胀风险表现更好；（4）金融状况在增长风险中作用显著，货币指标对下行增长风险尤为相关；（5）综合多风险因子框架在密度预测上系统性优于单一因子模型；（6）工具能提供及时信号并准确追踪实际结果方向。
AI.theory_contributions: 为分位数回归模型中COVID时期数据的处理方法做出了贡献；提出了新颖的参数化倾斜方法和copula跨频率密度转换方法；系统性地比较了综合因子框架与单一因子框架在密度预测中的表现。
AI.practical_contributions: 开发了MATLAB工具箱（M@RX）供政策分析使用；为ECB货币政策决策提供了识别风险驱动因素和评估预测不确定性的实用工具；建议定期评估模型表现以维持可靠性。

title: Paintings from Photographs: A Copyright Conundrum

detail.title: Paintings from Photographs: A Copyright Conundrum
detail.abstract: There has been a series of decisions of national courts in Europe concerning claims of infringement of copyright in photographs by paintings based on those photographs. These cases have had a diversity of outcomes. In part, this is due to a failure by national courts in recent cases properly to apply the guidance of the Court of Justice of the European Union. More fundamentally, it reflects a lack of agreement as to what the copyright in a photograph is supposed to protect. This article proposes a solution to the problem through a careful application of the principles laid down by the CJEU.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了欧洲各国法院在处理"以照片为基础的画作是否侵犯照片版权"这一问题上裁判结果不一的现象。文章指出，这一分歧部分源于国家法院未能正确适用欧洲联盟法院（CJEU）的指导原则，更根本的原因在于对照片版权的保护对象缺乏共识。文章提出通过仔细应用CJEU确立的原则来解决这一问题。
AI.research_question: 为什么欧洲各国法院在以绘画作品复制照片的版权侵权案件中裁判结果存在分歧？如何通过正确适用CJEU原则来解决这一问题？
AI.motivation: 欧洲各国法院在照片版权侵权诉讼中出现了多起相互矛盾的判决，这些分歧不仅源于对国家法院对CJEU指导原则的错误适用，更反映了理论层面对照片版权保护对象的根本性认识不一致，亟需澄清和统一。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧洲联盟法院（CJEU）关于版权保护的原则，特别是关于照片版权保护范围的判例法原则。
AI.method: 法律分析/判例分析法，对欧洲各国法院的系列判决进行比较分析，并对照CJEU确立的法律原则进行审视。
AI.findings: 各国法院判决结果不一的原因有二：（1）部分国家法院未能正确适用CJEU的指导原则；（2）更根本的问题在于对照片版权究竟保护什么缺乏共识。文章提出了通过仔细应用CJEU原则来解决这一问题的方案。
AI.theory_contributions: 阐明了照片版权的保护对象这一根本理论争议，并提供了基于CJEU原则的统一分析框架，有助于弥合各国司法实践中的理论分歧。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧洲各国法院在处理照片版权侵权案件中提供明确的适用指引，有助于统一裁判标准，减少因司法分歧导致的诉讼不确定性，对摄影作品创作者和使用者都具有实际指导意义。

title: Transforming Agricultural Practices in Hillyland Areas: Achieving Economic Growth and Gender Inclusivity Through Integrated Farming
affiliations: Department of Agriculture-Regional Field Office III, Department of Agriculture-Regional Field Office III, Department of Agriculture-Regional Field Office III, Department of Agriculture-Regional Field Office III and Department of Agriculture-Regional Field Office III

detail.title: Transforming Agricultural Practices in Hillyland Areas: Achieving Economic Growth and Gender Inclusivity Through Integrated Farming

declarations.funderStatement: We would like to express our deepest gratitude to the Department of Agriculture Regional Field Office 3 for providing the necessary funds for this research. Without their financial support, this study would not have been possible.

detail.abstract: This study investigated the implementation and outcomes of integrated farming systems in hillyland communities, focusing on enhancing farm productivity, profitability, and sustainability. Two primary farming systems were studied: Farming System 1 (Rice + Corn + Cassava + Poultry + Vermicomposting) and Farming System 2 (Corn + Poultry + Vermicomposting). Through comprehensive training sessions and technology demonstrations, farmers were educated and empowered to adopt integrated farming practices tailored to local conditions. The study found significant improvements in farm profitability with Farming System 1 achieving a 158.95% increase in profit and Farming System 2 realizing a remarkable 183.27% increase. Adoption of these systems also led to the development of 1.57 hectares of previously unproductive land, effectively optimizing land use and expanding agricultural production capacities. Gender inclusivity was a key focus, and both male and female farmers actively participated in adopting new technologies, particularly in corn and poultry production. Sustainable agricultural practices such as organic fertilization and integrated pest management were emphasized, contributing to improved environmental stewardship and economic resilience in the communities studied. The findings underscored the transformative potential of integrated farming systems, not only in increasing farm incomes but also in promoting sustainable development and enhancing livelihoods in challenging hillyland environments. The study highlights the importance of continued support for integrated farming initiatives, policy frameworks that incentivize sustainable practices, and the need for ongoing education and capacity-building programs to sustain these positive outcomes in agricultural communities.

AI.tldr: 本研究调查了丘陵社区综合农业系统的实施与成效，比较了两种系统（水稻+玉米+木薯+家禽+蚯蚓堆肥系统，以及玉米+家禽+蚯蚓堆肥系统），通过培训和示范推广农业实践，显著提升了农场盈利能力和土地利用率，并促进了性别包容与可持续农业发展。
AI.research_question: 丘陵社区综合农业系统的实施如何影响农场生产力、盈利能力和可持续性？
AI.motivation: 丘陵地区农业发展面临土地贫瘠、生产力低下等挑战，需要探索能够提升农场盈利能力、促进可持续发展和改善农民生计的综合农业模式。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合农业系统理论、可持续农业发展理论、农业技术扩散与农民赋权理论
AI.method: 实证研究：在丘陵社区实施两种综合农业系统（系统1：水稻+玉米+木薯+家禽+蚯蚓堆肥；系统2：玉米+家禽+蚯蚓堆肥），通过综合培训和技术示范推广，测量利润率变化、土地开发面积、性别参与度和可持续实践采纳情况。
AI.findings: 系统1利润增长158.95%，系统2利润增长183.27%；开发了1.57公顷此前未利用的土地；男女农民均积极参与新技术采用；有机施肥和综合病虫害管理等可持续实践得到推广，促进了环境管理和经济韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 为综合农业系统在丘陵环境下提升生产力与可持续性的有效性提供了实证证据，验证了系统整合（种植+养殖+堆肥循环）对农场盈利和土地优化的协同效应。
AI.practical_contributions: 为丘陵农业社区提供了可复制、可落地的综合农业系统实施方案；强调了培训、能力建设及政策支持（如激励可持续实践的政策框架）对农业可持续推广的关键作用；展示了性别包容在农业技术扩散中的实践路径。

title: Spending to Save: The Subscription Model for Eradicating Hepatitis C in Louisiana
affiliations: Tulane University - Department of Global Health Systems and Development, Boston University - Questrom School of Business, Massachusetts Institute of Technology (MIT) - Department of Economics and Yale University - School of Public Health

detail.title: Spending to Save: The Subscription Model for Eradicating Hepatitis C in Louisiana
detail.abstract:
How should payers balance fiscal sustainability with access to transformative medical technology? We study Louisiana’s 2019 Medicaid subscription model for hepatitis C (HCV), the first example of a U.S. state employing a two-part tariff to secure unlimited access to curative medicines. Using a differences-in-differences design comparing spending on beneficiaries with HCV to those with diabetes or HIV, we find that treatment volume tripled, medical spending fell, and new HCV diagnoses declined 23 percent. The state’s $37 million in incremental spending on antivirals generated $266 million in five-year savings. Innovative financing models can generate health benefits and near-term savings for payers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了路易斯安那州2019年针对丙型肝炎的Medicaid订阅制支付模式（美国首个采用两部收费制以实现治愈性药物无限获取的州级案例）。通过双重差分设计对比HCV患者与糖尿病或HIV患者的支出，发现治疗量增长三倍、医疗支出下降、新发HCV诊断下降23%。州政府3700万美元的抗病毒药物增量支出带来了2.66亿美元的五年期节省，表明创新融资模式能在近期为支付方带来健康收益和成本节约。
AI.research_question: 支付方应如何在财政可持续性与获取变革性医疗技术之间取得平衡？具体而言，路易斯安那州2019年Medicaid丙肝订阅制支付模式的效果如何？
AI.motivation: 变革性医疗技术（如丙肝治愈性药物）价格高昂，传统按量付费模式使支付方难以在控制预算的同时确保患者充分获取治疗。路易斯安那州首创的订阅制（两部收费制）支付模式为这一困境提供了新思路，但其实际效果缺乏实证评估。
AI.theoretical_framework: 订阅制/两部收费制定价理论（two-part tariff）；医疗支付创新模式理论；财政可持续性与医疗可及性的权衡框架
AI.method: 采用双重差分设计（differences-in-differences），将丙肝（HCV）受益人的支出与糖尿病或HIV患者进行对照比较，评估订阅制实施前后的支出变化、治疗量与诊断趋势。
AI.findings: 1) 抗病毒治疗量增长三倍；2) 医疗支出下降；3) 新发HCV诊断下降23%；4) 州政府3700万美元的增量抗病毒支出在五年内节省了2.66亿美元。
AI.theory_contributions: 为订阅制/两部收费制在医疗支付领域的应用提供了首个大规模实证证据，展示了创新融资模式如何在保证药物可及性的同时实现财政可持续性，扩展了医疗支付模式创新的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为美国各州及其他医疗支付方提供了关于创新药物采购合同的实证参考，证明订阅制模式不仅可控制总体医疗成本，还能提升患者治疗可及性和公共卫生结果（降低新发感染率），对政策制定者具有直接的借鉴价值。

title: Optimal Insider Trading in Prediction Markets
affiliations: Indiana University, Indiana University - Kelley School of Business - Department of Business Law and Indiana University - Kelley School of Business

detail.title: Optimal Insider Trading in Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: Prediction markets provide an informational public good but are prone to abuse in the form of insider trading and related market manipulation. The recent and rapid expansion of these markets, fueled by high-profile instances of allegedly illegal trades, has resulted in calls for widespread regulation. This article surveys existing public and private law tools available to prohibit insider trading on prediction markets. Our analysis finds that, despite the novelty of prediction markets and their expanding scope, there are ample legal mechanisms for restricting undesirable trades. From a policy perspective, this Article argues for a balanced approach that seeks to leverage the forecasting power of prediction markets, while restricting certain categories of trades that distort market pricing or rely on illegal sources of information acquisition. The policy goal is therefore not to limit all uses of inside information in such markets. Rather, prediction markets function best if there is some room for prices to indirectly incorporate inside information or otherwise include high-information traders.

AI.tldr: 本文调查了预测市场中内幕交易的法律规制工具，认为尽管预测市场是新兴且快速扩张的，但现有的公法和私法机制足以限制不当交易。文章主张采取平衡的监管方法：既要利用预测市场的预测能力，也要限制扭曲市场价格或依赖非法信息获取的交易类别。
AI.research_question: 预测市场中的内幕交易应如何通过现有法律工具进行规制？如何在保障预测市场信息功能的同时防止市场操纵和滥用？
AI.motivation: 预测市场提供信息公共品，但容易受到内幕交易和市场操纵的滥用。近期预测市场快速扩张，伴随着高调涉嫌非法交易的案例，引发了广泛的监管呼吁，因此亟需评估现有法律工具能否有效应对这些问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及公法与私法工具的法律分析框架，以及预测市场作为信息聚合机制的理论基础。
AI.method: 法律文献调查与政策分析，系统梳理现有的公法和私法工具（如证券法、合同法等）在禁止预测市场内幕交易方面的适用性。
AI.findings: 尽管预测市场具有新颖性和不断扩展的范围，但现有法律机制足以限制不良交易。政策上应采取平衡方法：一方面利用预测市场的预测能力，另一方面限制扭曲市场价格或依赖非法信息来源的交易类别。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出预测市场不应完全禁止内幕信息的间接融入，而应有条件地允许价格在一定程度上反映内部信息，从而为预测市场的监管提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了具体的监管思路，指出监管目标不是限制所有内幕信息的利用，而是通过平衡监管保留预测市场的信息功能，同时遏制市场操纵行为。

title: Cycles of Infertility: Intergenerational Transmission and the Role of Assisted Reproduction
affiliations: Stockholm University, Stockholm University and Johns Hopkins University

detail.title: Cycles of Infertility: Intergenerational Transmission and the Role of Assisted Reproduction
detail.abstract:
This study examines the persistence of fertility-related health problems across generations within the same family, and the utilization of assisted reproductive technologies (ART). Using comprehensive Swedish registry data, we document significant intergenerational transmission of fertility difficulties for both daughters and sons, independent of parental socioeconomic status. Daughters whose parents reported such problems are 2.6 percentage points, or 19.4 percent, more likely to experience fertility problems themselves. Sons whose parents reported fertility difficulties experience a 1.7 percentage point, or 13.5 percent, increase. These associations persist across alternative measures and samples. Comparing biological and adopted children raised in the same households, we find that this phenomenon is unlikely to be driven by family awareness of fertility issues, pointing to biological and other factors that biological children share with their parents but adopted children do not. Medical technology works equally well for those who use it, and we find no significant association between the success of advanced fertility treatments and parental backgrounds. However, past generations’ fertility difficulties are associated both with higher medical expenses and with social costs such as increased likelihood of divorce.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用瑞典综合登记数据，发现生育相关健康问题在同一家庭中跨代传递：女儿和儿子若父母有生育困难，其自身生育问题的概率分别增加19.4%和13.5%。通过对比收养子女与亲生子女，表明该传递主要源于生物学因素而非家庭认知。辅助生殖技术对不同背景家庭效果相同，但生育困难与更高的医疗支出和更高的离婚率相关。
AI.research_question: 生育相关健康问题是否在同一家庭内部跨代传递？这种传递是源于生物学因素还是家庭社会环境因素？辅助生殖技术的使用效果是否受父母生育背景影响？
AI.motivation: 生育困难是日益严峻的社会问题，理解其跨代传递机制对于评估生育率下降趋势、医疗资源分配以及辅助生殖技术的公平性具有重要意义。同时，此前缺乏基于大规模人口登记数据的严格实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 跨代传递理论（intergenerational transmission）、生物学遗传假说与家庭社会化假说的区分框架
AI.method: 利用瑞典全国综合登记数据，采用描述性统计与回归分析；通过对比亲生子女与收养子女（在同一家庭环境中成长）来区分生物学传递与家庭环境影响；对多种指标与样本进行稳健性检验。
AI.findings: （1）生育困难存在显著的跨代传递：女儿传递效应为2.6个百分点（19.4%），儿子为1.7个百分点（13.5%），且与父母社会经济地位无关；（2）通过亲生与收养子女对比，发现传递主要由生物学因素驱动，而非家庭对生育问题的认知或环境因素；（3）辅助生殖技术对不同家庭背景的使用者效果无显著差异；（4）生育困难不仅带来更高的医疗支出，还伴随更高的离婚率等社会成本。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次利用大规模登记数据与收养对比设计的因果识别策略，严格区分了生育困难跨代传递中的生物学因素与社会环境因素，为跨代健康不平等研究提供了新的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示公共卫生政策应关注生育困难家庭的跨代健康风险；辅助生殖技术在效果上的平等性为医疗资源配置提供了依据；同时生育困难带来的医疗成本与社会成本（如离婚）为完善社会保障与家庭支持政策提供了实证支持。

title: Market Constraints and Institutional Gaps in Indigenous Organic Farming Systems in Central Luzon, Philippines
affiliations: Department of Agriculture-Regional Field Office III and Department of Agriculture-Regional Field Office III

detail.title: Market Constraints and Institutional Gaps in Indigenous Organic Farming Systems in Central Luzon, Philippines

declarations.funderStatement: This research was supported by the Department of Agriculture – Bureau of Agricultural Research (DA-BAR) through the Organic Agriculture Program implemented in Region III.

detail.abstract: Indigenous organic farming systems in the Philippines are often characterized by low external input use and reliance on traditional ecological knowledge. However, limited empirical evidence exists regarding the structural barriers that constrain their economic sustainability and institutional integration. This study analyzed market constraints and institutional gaps affecting three Indigenous Cultural Communities (ICCs) in Central Luzon-the Kalanguya, Ilongot, and Ayta Sambal-engaged in organic farming practices. Using a mixed-methods approach involving complete enumeration surveys (n = 104), focus group discussions, field observation, and thematic analysis, the study examined socioeconomic conditions, marketing arrangements, transport systems, and alignment of government interventions with community needs. Results revealed four major structural constraints: (1) absence of stable buyers and lack of organic price premiums; (2) transport and infrastructure limitations resulting in high transaction costs and price suppression; (3) limited post-harvest facilities and storage systems; and (4) institutional misalignment between local government organic programs and indigenous production realities. Organic produce was frequently sold at prices comparable to conventionally grown products, reducing incentives for certification or system scaling. Transport burdens, particularly among upland Ayta Sambal farmers who walk 5-7 km to access markets, significantly constrained income generation and bargaining power. Furthermore, distribution of synthetic inputs under generalized agricultural programs contradicted organic production objectives. The study concludes that indigenous organic farming systems remain structurally undervalued due to weak market integration and fragmented institutional support. Policy reforms must prioritize infrastructure development, organic-specific extension services, participatory guarantee systems integration, and community-based aggregation mechanisms to enhance economic viability while preserving indigenous agricultural knowledge systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过混合方法调查了菲律宾中央吕宋地区三个原住民文化社区（Kalanguya、Ilongot和Ayta Sambal）的有机农业系统，揭示了四大结构性约束：缺乏稳定买家和有机溢价、运输和基础设施限制、产后设施和储存系统不足，以及政府有机项目与原住民生产现实之间的制度错位。研究认为，由于市场整合薄弱和制度支持碎片化，原住民有机农业系统在结构上被低估。
AI.research_question: 哪些结构性市场约束和制度缺口制约了菲律宾原住民文化社区有机农业的经济可持续性和制度整合？
AI.motivation: 菲律宾原住民有机农业系统通常具有低外部投入和依赖传统生态知识的特点，但关于限制其经济可持续性和制度整合的结构性障碍的实证证据有限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 传统生态知识理论、市场整合理论、制度错位/制度嵌入性理论
AI.method: 混合方法研究：完整枚举调查（n=104）、焦点小组讨论、实地观察和主题分析
AI.findings: （1）缺乏稳定买家和有机价格溢价；（2）交通和基础设施限制导致高交易成本和价格抑制；（3）产后设施和储存系统有限；（4）地方政府有机项目与原住民生产现实之间存在制度错位。原产品以与传统产品相当的价格出售，降低了认证和系统扩展的激励；高地Ayta Sambal农民步行5-7公里进入市场，严重制约了收入生成和议价能力；在广义农业项目下分发合成投入品与有机生产目标相矛盾。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了原住民有机农业系统因弱市场整合和碎片化制度支持而在结构上被系统性低估的机制，丰富了关于原住民农业经济可持续性与制度嵌入性的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出政策改革建议：优先发展基础设施、提供有机专项推广服务、整合参与式保障体系（PGS）、建立社区层面的农产品聚合机制，以提升经济可行性同时保护原住民农业知识体系。

title: Staged Access and Liability for Dual-Use Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: University of Toronto - Rotman School of Management

detail.title: Staged Access and Liability for Dual-Use Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract:
How should regulators combine staged access to a dual-use AI model with developer liability? I model a defender and an adversary searching for the same software flaws. After release, liability induces more defensive search but also makes the adversary search harder, limiting its effect on harm. Exclusive access removes this strategic response, so staged access and liability are complements in protection. Defensive effort rises towards the release date, making additional delay progressively less productive. Optimal evaluation windows are therefore bounded, and their response to greater harm saturates. Because defensive search uses real resources, the efficient liability rate can be below full internalisation of harm. That rate generally cannot induce the developer to choose the regulator's preferred release date, leaving a distinct role for a timing mandate.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了监管者应如何将双用途AI模型的分阶段访问（staged access）与开发者责任（developer liability）相结合。通过建模防御者（开发者）与攻击者（对手）寻找同一软件漏洞的博弈，发现阶段访问与责任在保护方面具有互补性，且最优评估窗口有界，高效责任率可低于危害完全内化的水平，但责任率通常无法诱导开发者选择监管者偏好的发布日期，因此需要单独的时机授权（timing mandate）。
AI.research_question: 监管者应如何将双用途AI模型的分阶段访问与开发者责任相结合，以实现最优的安全治理？
AI.motivation: 双用途AI模型（dual-use AI model）既可能被正当使用也可能被滥用，监管者在保护公众安全与促进创新之间面临权衡。现有的责任机制与访问控制机制如何相互作用尚不清楚，需要理论模型来指导政策设计。
AI.theoretical_framework: 博弈论模型（防御者与攻击者同时搜寻软件漏洞）；责任经济学；机制设计理论
AI.method: 建立防御者（开发者）与攻击者（对手）搜寻同一软件漏洞的理论博弈模型，分析在不同责任制度与分阶段访问（排他性访问）组合下的均衡结果与最优政策设计。
AI.findings: （1）责任在诱导更多防御性搜寻的同时，也会使攻击者搜寻更卖力，从而限制了责任对减少危害的效果；（2）排他性访问（exclusive access）消除了这一战略反应，因此分阶段访问与责任在保护方面是互补的；（3）防御性努力随发布日期临近而上升，使得额外延迟的边际效应递减，因此最优评估窗口是有界的；（4）面对更大危害时，最优评估窗口的响应会饱和；（5）由于防御性搜寻消耗真实资源，高效责任率可以低于危害的完全内化水平；（6）该责任率通常无法诱导开发者选择监管者偏好的发布日期，因此需要单独的时机授权。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次从理论上将分阶段访问与开发者责任纳入统一分析框架，揭示了二者之间互补性关系；拓展了责任经济学在AI治理领域的应用；为"责任最优水平低于完全内化"提供了新的理论解释（基于防御搜寻的真实资源成本）；建立了关于评估窗口有界性与饱和性的理论边界条件。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管者设计双用途AI模型的治理政策提供具体指导：（1）分阶段访问与责任应组合使用而非替代使用；（2）评估窗口不应无限延长，存在最优上限；（3）责任水平不必追求危害的完全内化；（4）需要单独的时机授权（timing mandate）作为责任制度的补充工具，以解决责任无法诱导最优发布日期的问题。

title: The Displacement Effects of Domestic Outsourcing
affiliations: Yale University and The University of Hong Kong - Faculty of Business and Economics

detail.title: The Displacement Effects of Domestic Outsourcing
detail.abstract:
Evidence that domestic outsourcing lowers pay comes largely from on-site transfers, in which workers move to a contractor but keep the same jobs. Displacement is rarely observed: whether workers lose their jobs, where they go, how earnings evolve. In Brazil’s 1993–1994 pro-outsourcing reforms, which differentially affected security guards, such transfers were rare; firms instead used occupational layoffs, shedding their guards while keeping other workers. Displaced guards’ employment recovered within five years, but many changed occupations and wages stayed about 12% lower. Lifetime losses average 1.2 to 1.5 years of pre-layoff earnings, concentrated among workers from high-wage firms, reflecting lost premia.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文利用巴西1993-1994年支持外包的改革（该改革对保安行业影响尤为显著）作为自然实验，发现企业并未通过现场转移（on-site transfer）方式将工人外包，而是主要通过职业性裁员（occupational layoffs）来剥离保安人员。被裁保安的就业在五年内恢复，但许多人转换了职业，工资仍低约12%，终身收入损失平均为裁员前收入的1.2至1.5年，且主要集中在高工资企业的工人身上，反映了失去的企业溢价。
AI.research_question: 国内外包降低工资的证据主要来源于现场转移（工人转至承包商但保留原岗位），而工人被裁后的去向及收入演变很少被观察到。本文研究的问题是：在外包改革下，工人是否被裁员？被裁后去向何处、收入如何演变？
AI.motivation: 现有关于外包对工资影响的研究大多依赖现场转移案例，但工人被迫离开企业的情形（displacement）很少被直接观察。本文旨在利用巴西外包改革这一准自然实验，填补在外包情景下工人失业后流动轨迹与收入动态的证据空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文基于劳动经济学中有关企业工资溢价（firm wage premia）与职业流动的理论框架，解释被裁工人因失去高工资企业的溢价而承受持久性收入损失。
AI.method: 利用巴西1993-1994年支持外包的改革作为差分识别（differential exposure）的外生冲击，该改革对保安行业的影响尤为突出；结合行政数据追踪被裁保安的就业去向、职业转换与工资演变，并估计终身收入损失。
AI.findings: （1）外包改革下企业极少采用现场转移，而是通过职业性裁员来剥离保安人员，同时保留其他工人；（2）被裁保安的就业在五年内恢复，但许多人转换了职业；（3）被裁后工资持续低于改革前约12%；（4）终身收入损失平均为裁员前收入的1.2至1.5年，且损失集中在来自高工资企业的工人，反映其丧失了企业工资溢价。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为外包与工资关系的理论提供了新的微观证据，表明外包压低工资的主要机制不是现场转移下的直接降薪，而是通过裁员与职业转换，使工人失去高工资企业的工资溢价；这丰富了关于企业工资溢价在劳动力流动中作用的理论认识。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究揭示外包改革的真实劳动力代价：以裁员方式完成的外包会给工人带来持久且实质性的收入损失，提示政策制定者在推进外包自由化时需考虑对被裁工人的补偿与再培训支持，尤其应关注来自高工资企业的高收入工人群体。

title: Social Performance Feedback and Managerial Moral Self-Regulation: The Microfoundations of Corporate Social (Ir)Responsibility
affiliations: University of Alabama, Western University, University of Arizona - Department of Management and Organizations, University of Texas at Dallas and The University of Arizona

detail.title: Social Performance Feedback and Managerial Moral Self-Regulation: The Microfoundations of Corporate Social (Ir)Responsibility
detail.abstract: Despite growing interest in the microfoundations of corporate social activities, prior research has not articulated the full chain connecting firm-level conditions to managers' psychological processes (a topdown pathway) and back to firm-level corporate social behavior (a bottom-up pathway), leaving existing microfoundational accounts incomplete. Drawing on the behavioral theory of the firm (BTOF) and moral self-regulation theory, we develop a cross-level moral feedback model that integrates both pathways by linking firm-level social performance feedback, individual-level managerial cognition, and firm-level corporate social responsibility (CSR) and corporate social irresponsibility (CSI). We argue that social performance feedback activates managers' moral self-regulation. When a firm falls below its social performance aspiration, its managers perceive a diminished firm image, which undermines their moral self-image and triggers moral cleansing behaviors-manifested as increased CSR and/or reduced CSI. Conversely, when a firm exceeds its social performance aspiration, its managers perceive an enhanced firm image, which elevates their moral self-image and activates moral licensing behaviors-manifested as reduced CSR and/or increased CSI. Study 1, using archival data, examines the main effects of firms' social performance feedback on CSR and CSI. Study 2 uses a series of experiments to examine the proposed micro-level mechanisms, demonstrating how managers' perceived firm image and moral selfimage sequentially mediate the effects of social performance feedback on CSR and CSI. These studies provide complementary evidence for our multilevel behavioral model. Our study contributes to research on the microfoundations of corporate social activities, behavioral strategy, and moral self-regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文基于企业行为理论和道德自我调节理论，构建了一个跨层级的道德反馈模型，将企业层面的社会绩效反馈、个体层面的管理者认知与企业层面的CSR和CSI联系起来。研究发现：当企业社会绩效低于期望水平时，管理者感知的企业形象受损，削弱道德自我形象，触发道德净化行为（增加CSR/减少CSI）；当社会绩效高于期望时，管理者感知企业形象提升，增强道德自我形象，激活道德许可行为（减少CSR/增加CSI）。通过档案数据研究和系列实验验证了该模型。
AI.research_question: 企业层面的社会绩效反馈如何通过管理者的心理过程（感知企业形象和道德自我形象）影响企业层面的企业社会责任（CSR）与企业社会不负责任（CSI）行为？
AI.motivation: 已有研究对企业社会活动微观基础的兴趣日益增长，但尚未阐明从企业层面条件到管理者心理过程（自上而下路径）再回到企业层面社会行为（自下而上路径）的完整链条，导致现有微观基础解释不完整。
AI.theoretical_framework: 企业行为理论（BTOF）、道德自我调节理论（moral self-regulation theory），以及跨层级道德反馈模型（cross-level moral feedback model）。
AI.method: 采用多研究方法：研究1使用档案数据进行主要效应检验；研究2采用一系列实验检验微观层面的中介机制，验证感知企业形象和道德自我形象的序列中介作用。
AI.findings: 社会绩效反馈激活了管理者的道德自我调节。当企业社会绩效低于期望时，管理者感知企业形象受损，削弱道德自我形象，触发道德净化行为（增加CSR和/或减少CSI）；当社会绩效高于期望时，管理者感知企业形象提升，增强道德自我形象，激活道德许可行为（减少CSR和/或增加CSI）。两个研究提供互补证据支持多层次行为模型。
AI.theory_contributions: 对企业社会活动微观基础研究的贡献：整合了自上而下和自下而上两条路径，构建了完整的跨层级模型；对行为战略研究的贡献：将企业行为理论拓展到社会绩效反馈情境；对道德自我调节理论的贡献：将该理论从个体层面拓展到组织层面。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者理解社会绩效反馈如何影响其道德决策提供认知机制洞见，有助于企业更有效地管理CSR和CSI行为，避免道德许可效应带来的潜在负面影响。

title: Dividing Residual Control over AI Learning Assets: Complementary Investment Across Firm Boundaries
affiliations: Georgia State University and Wake Forest University School of Law

detail.title: Dividing Residual Control over AI Learning Assets: Complementary Investment Across Firm Boundaries

declarations.funderStatement: This research was sponsored by the Army Research Laboratory and was accomplished under Cooperative Agreement Number W911NF-23-2-0224. The views and conclusions contained in this document are those of the authors and should not be interpreted as representing the official policies, either expressed or implied, of the Army Research Laboratory or the U.S. Government. The U.S. Government is authorized to reproduce and distribute reprints for Government purposes notwithstanding any copyright notation herein

detail.abstract: Enterprise AI often becomes useful only after a firm organizes its proprietary knowledge and an external provider adapts the technology to that knowledge. Their collaboration creates a persistent, customer-specific AI learning asset that neither party brings to the relationship in finished form. We develop a bilateral incomplete-contracting model to examine how two forms of control over this asset affect the investments that create it. Cross-client isolation limits the provider's reuse of customer-induced learning. Post-exit continuity determines how much of the learned state the firm can keep operating after separation. Because neither party captures the full return to its contribution, both invest below the jointly efficient level. Greater continuity encourages firm investment, but it may reduce provider adaptation enough to lower the performance of the deployed AI system. When isolation is incomplete and the parties' contributions are complementary, more valuable cross-client reuse can increase both investments, AI performance, and joint value, even as the firm's investment shortfall widens. Assigning isolation and continuity separately can therefore achieve outcomes that a bundled rule excludes. The paper extends property-rights theory from control over existing assets to the governance of learning created through joint use.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个双边不完全契约模型，研究企业对AI学习资产（该资产由企业与外部AI提供方协作产生）的两种控制形式——跨客户隔离（限制提供方复用客户诱导的学习）和退出后连续性（企业分离后能保留多少学习状态）——如何影响双方的专用性投资及AI系统绩效。研究发现，两种控制形式可以分别配置以实现捆绑规则无法达成的治理结果。
AI.research_question: 企业AI技术的有效性依赖于企业组织专有知识并与外部提供方协作适配，由此产生客户特定的持久AI学习资产。本文研究的问题是：对这项AI学习资产的两种控制形式（跨客户隔离与退出后连续性）如何影响创造该资产所需的双方投资，以及何种控制权配置能够实现更优的治理结果？
AI.motivation: 企业AI系统通常在部署后才能通过客户使用过程中产生的学习持续改进，形成客户特定的学习资产。这种资产由企业与外部提供方共同创造，双方都无法投入即获得完整成果，产生双边套牢问题。但现有产权理论主要关注对既有资产的控制，缺乏对联合使用中产生的学习资产的治理分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 不完全契约理论（产权理论/财产权方法），扩展至对联合使用中产生的学习资产的治理。
AI.method: 双边不完全契约博弈论模型。分析两种控制形式（跨客户隔离与退出后连续性）对双方投资激励的影响，并进行比较静态分析和福利分析。
AI.findings: （1）由于任何一方都无法获得其贡献的全部回报，双方投资均低于联合有效水平；（2）更大的连续性鼓励企业投资，但可能降低提供方适配投入，从而降低已部署AI系统绩效；（3）当隔离不完整且双方贡献互补时，更有价值的跨客户复用可以同时提高双方投资、AI绩效和联合价值，即使企业的投资缺口扩大；（4）分别配置隔离与连续性可以达成捆绑规则所无法实现的结果。
AI.theory_contributions: 将产权理论从对既有资产的控制扩展到对联合使用中产生的学习资产的治理，为理解AI时代企业边界与治理安排提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业与外部AI供应商在合同中如何设计学习资产的控制权（如数据隔离、退出安排）提供了治理启示，表明控制权配置的灵活性对AI部署绩效和联合价值有重要影响。

title: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
affiliations: , , NYU Stern School of Business and New York University (NYU) - New York University

detail.title: Property Taxes and Housing Allocation Under Financial Constraints
detail.abstract:
Low property taxes amplify lock-in among elderly homeowners, limiting housing access for young families. Raising them reallocates housing toward the young through two channels: capitalization into lower prices reduces required downpayments for financially constrained buyers, a form of embedded leverage, while higher tax obligations raise holding costs for older owners. In our overlapping generations model, raising California’s property taxes to Texas levels increases young homeownership while decreasing elderly homeownership. Removing step-up basis also lowers elderly homeownership, suggesting their tenure is sustained by bequest tax advantages. The tax treatment of housing shapes housing allocation across generations.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究房产税对代际住房配置的影响。低房产税会加剧老年房主的"锁定效应"（不愿出售房屋），从而限制年轻家庭获得住房。提高房产税可通过两个渠道将住房重新分配给年轻人：资本化效应（压低房价、降低首付门槛）和持有成本效应（提高老年房主的持有成本）。基于重叠世代模型，研究发现将加州的房产税提高到得克萨斯州水平会增加年轻家庭房屋所有权，同时减少老年房主数量。此外，取消"递增基数"（step-up basis）税收优惠也会降低老年房主比例，表明老年房主的持续持有依赖于遗产税优势。
AI.research_question: 房产税制度如何影响代际之间的住房配置？具体而言，低房产税导致的老年房主锁定效应如何限制年轻家庭的住房获取，以及提高房产税能否将住房向年轻人重新分配？
AI.motivation: 住房代际公平问题日益突出：年轻家庭面临住房可及性困难，而老年房主长期持有房产。低房产税政策可能通过锁定效应加剧这一问题，需要从税收政策角度理解其对代际住房配置的影响机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 重叠世代模型（Overlapping Generations Model, OLG）；房产税资本化理论；锁定效应（Lock-in Effect）理论；遗产税/递增基数（Step-up Basis）税收优势理论；嵌入式杠杆（Embedded Leverage）概念。
AI.method: 构建重叠世代（OLG）理论模型，以加州和得克萨斯州的房产税差异为情景进行政策模拟分析。
AI.findings: 1) 提高房产税通过房价资本化降低购房者首付门槛（嵌入式杠杆渠道）以及提高老年房主持有成本两个渠道，将住房向年轻家庭重新分配；2) 将加州房产税提高到得州水平会增加年轻家庭房屋所有权并减少老年房主；3) 取消递增基数税收优惠同样降低老年房主比例，说明遗产税优势是老年房主持续持有房产的重要支撑因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"嵌入式杠杆"概念，将房产税资本化效应与购房者财务约束联系起来；将房产税、锁定效应和代际住房配置纳入统一的理论分析框架；揭示了遗产税（递增基数）政策与房产税在塑造老年房主持有行为中的交互作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为房产税政策改革（如加州Proposition 13等低房产税政策的调整）提供了理论依据；为决策者提供证据表明提高房产税可缓解代际住房不平等，同时提示取消递增基数税收优惠可作为补充政策工具。

title: Ecomodulation of Extended Producer Responsibility Fees: A Literature Review
affiliations: Faculty of Environmental and Urban Change, York University

detail.title: Ecomodulation of Extended Producer Responsibility Fees: A Literature Review
detail.abstract:
Ecomodulation—differentiating the fees producers pay into extended producer responsibility (EPR) schemes based on environmental criteria—has rapidly become a default policy mechanism across Europe and North America. This literature review consolidates academic and grey literature to evaluate whether ecomodulation successfully drives product and packaging redesign.

The central finding reveals that at implemented fee levels and observed governance conditions, current evidence fails to demonstrate that ecomodulation causes product redesign at scale. Econometric and empirical evaluations show that price differentials are generally too small relative to product economics to alter design decisions, with compliance costs frequently passed through to consumers.

However, ecomodulation has achieved significant indirect success. It has reorganized corporate reporting, institutionalized eco-design knowledge within firms, created standing audit frameworks, and fairer cost-allocation structures by narrowing cross-subsidies from well-designed to poorly designed products. Conversely, risks include added administrative burdens, criteria capture by incumbents, perverse incentives (e.g., lightweighting into less recyclable formats), and unmeasured regressive consumer cost impacts. Furthermore, criteria fail to account for positive non-waste outcomes, such as reduced food waste from protective packaging.

To achieve meaningful design impact, schemes must meet six key conditions: material fee differentials, verifiable and aligned criteria, predictable multi-year trajectories, centralized governance with robust auditing, international harmonization, and the assignment of non-fee objectives to better-suited complementary instruments. Ultimately, ecomodulation should be leveraged for its proven strengths—fair cost allocation and informational transparency—rather than relied upon as an unproven, standalone driver of eco-design.

AI.tldr: 本文是一篇文献综述，系统评估了生态调节（ecomodulation）——即根据环境标准差异化生产者责任延伸（EPR）计划中生产者缴纳的费用——是否有效推动产品和包装的重新设计。核心发现是：在现行费用水平和治理条件下，现有证据无法证明生态调节能大规模引发产品重新设计；但它在企业报告重组、生态设计知识制度化、审计框架建立和成本分配公平性方面取得了显著的间接成功。为实现有意义的设计影响，需要满足六项关键条件。
AI.research_question: 生态调节（ecomodulation）是否成功驱动产品和包装的重新设计？其在什么条件下有效？
AI.motivation: 生态调节已迅速成为北美和欧洲EPR计划的默认政策机制，但对其是否真正推动产品重新设计的效果缺乏系统性的整合评估。有必要梳理学术和灰色文献，验证该政策工具的实际效能。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于生产者责任延伸（EPR）理论框架，结合环境经济学中的价格信号机制与成本传递理论，以及制度理论（企业组织变革、知识制度化）和公共政策评估框架。
AI.method: 系统性文献综述方法，整合学术文献与灰色文献，对生态调节政策的效果进行定性与定量证据的归纳评估。
AI.findings: （1）直接效果：现有证据表明生态调节未能大规模引发产品重新设计，费用差异相对于产品经济性而言过小，合规成本常转嫁给消费者；（2）间接效果：在重组企业报告、制度化生态设计知识、建立审计框架和改善成本分配公平性（缩小交叉补贴）方面成效显著；（3）风险：行政负担增加、标准被现有企业捕获、产生不正当激励（如减量化导致可回收性下降）、未测量的累退税成本影响；（4）标准未能涵盖非废弃物领域的正面成果（如保护性包装减少食物浪费）。
AI.theory_contributions: 对EPR和生态调节研究领域进行了系统性的证据整合，澄清了直接设计与间接制度效应之间的区分，提出了生态调节有效性的六项关键条件框架，为政策评估理论提供了新的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了明确的政策建议：应发挥生态调节在公平成本分配和信息透明方面的优势，而非将其视为未经证实的独立生态设计驱动工具；提出了六项关键实施条件（费用差异化、可验证标准、可预测的多年度轨迹、集中治理与审计、国际协调、将非费用目标分配给更合适的补充工具）。

title: Income Shocks and Intrahousehold Dynamics: Evidence from a Guaranteed Income Experiment
affiliations: OpenResearch Lab, University of California, Berkeley, University of Toronto, OpenResearch Lab, University of Michigan at Ann Arbor and University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign - Department of Economics

detail.title: Income Shocks and Intrahousehold Dynamics: Evidence from a Guaranteed Income Experiment
detail.abstract:
When an individual's income changes, it can affect their entire household. We study the intrahousehold effects of an unconditional cash transfer in which 1,000 individuals were randomly selected to receive a $1,000 per month transfer for three years, while a control group of 2,000 participants received $50 per month over the same time period. We find no effects on aggregate measures of household stability, although there is suggestive evidence of improved relationship quality and greater trust in partners among recipients in relationships. Transfers to friends and family increase, consistent with recipients sharing some of the additional income with others. There are also spillovers on the income and employment-related outcomes of other household members: household income excluding the recipient decreases by about $1,700 per year, and partners are less likely to be promoted or to move to a better job. Other household members are significantly more likely to participate in education or training, and recipients are also more likely to report someone in their household having to forgo healthcare, potentially reflecting greater engagement with the healthcare system and the identification of previously unmet needs. We observe limited changes in decision-making power or division of labor within the household. Some indicators of intimate partner violence decline, particularly for women, but reported incidence is low and most estimates do not remain statistically significant after adjustment for multiple hypothesis testing. Subgroup differences are generally imprecise, although point estimates suggest larger education and health spillover effects when the recipient is a woman. Household structure also appears to mediates the impacts of the transfers.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了一项无条件现金转移支付（每月1000美元，持续三年）对受助者家庭内部的影响。研究发现，该转移支付对家庭稳定性整体指标无显著影响，但改善了伴侣间的关系质量和信任度；受助者增加了对亲友的转移支付；其他家庭成员的收入下降约1700美元/年，伴侣晋升或跳槽可能性降低，但其他家庭成员参加教育或培训的可能性显著增加；部分亲密伴侣暴力指标下降，但多数估计在多重假设检验校正后不显著。
AI.research_question: 当个人收入发生变化时，这一变化如何影响其整个家庭内部的经济行为、关系质量和资源分配？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注现金转移支付对个体层面的影响，但对收入变化如何传导至家庭内部、影响其他家庭成员的行为和福祉知之甚少。理解家庭内部的溢出效应对于评估无条件现金转移支付的整体福利效应至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 家庭内部资源分配理论、家庭集体模型（collective household model）、转移支付溢出效应理论
AI.method: 随机对照试验（RCT）：1000名个体被随机分配到每月1000美元的无条件现金转移组（持续三年），2000名对照组参与者每月获得50美元。使用意向性分析（ITT）估计家庭内部的溢出效应，并进行多重假设检验校正和亚组分析。
AI.findings: （1）对家庭稳定性整体指标无显著影响，但关系中伴侣的关系质量和信任度有所改善；（2）对亲友的转移支付增加，受助者将部分额外收入与他人分享；（3）排除受助者后的家庭收入每年减少约1700美元，伴侣晋升或跳槽的可能性降低；（4）其他家庭成员参加教育或培训的可能性显著增加；（5）部分家庭成员的医疗支出被放弃的报告增加，反映医疗系统参与度提高和既往未满足需求的识别；（6）家庭内部决策权和分工变化有限；（7）部分亲密伴侣暴力指标下降（尤其对女性），但发生率低且多数估计在校正后不显著；（8）受助者为女性时教育和健康溢出效应更大，家庭结构调节了部分影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过随机实验证据，为家庭集体模型和家庭内部资源分配理论提供了因果识别的实证支持，揭示了无条件现金转移支付在家庭内部的收入替代效应、人力资本投资效应和关系质量效应，丰富了关于家庭内部溢出机制的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为无条件现金转移支付政策的家庭层面福利评估提供了重要证据；提示政策制定者需要考虑转移支付的收入替代效应（其他家庭成员收入下降）和人力资本提升效应；为针对女性受助者的政策设计提供了亚组证据。

title: The Perils of Bilateral Sovereign Debt
affiliations: and University of Notre Dame

detail.title: The Perils of Bilateral Sovereign Debt
detail.abstract:
Motivated by the emergence of new official creditors outside the Paris Club framework, we study the interaction between senior official lending and market debt. We develop a quantitative sovereign default model featuring a large senior lender with whom borrowing terms are negotiated. Obtaining more net financing from the market strengthens the government’s bargaining position and improves bilateral terms. This endogenous cross-elasticity erodes the discipline of spreads and amplifies debt dilution, leading to welfare losses even as bilateral borrowing helps avert some defaults ex-post. With pre-specified rules, rewarding market issuance can be enough to generate such losses, and an optimal rule instead raises bilateral rates with net market financing. The direction of the cross-elasticity can thus guide in practice the assessment of new forms of bilateral sovereign debt.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文基于巴黎俱乐部框架外新型官方债权人的出现，构建了一个包含大型优先贷款人的量化主权违约模型，研究优先官方贷款与市场债务之间的互动。研究发现，市场融资的增加会增强政府的谈判地位并改善双边贷款条件，这种内生交叉弹性侵蚀了利差的约束作用并加剧债务稀释，导致福利损失。
AI.research_question: 巴黎俱乐部框架外的新型官方优先贷款人与市场债务之间的互动关系是什么？这种互动如何影响主权违约、债务稀释和福利？
AI.motivation: 近年来出现了巴黎俱乐部框架之外的新型官方债权人（如中国等国），这些优先贷款人的贷款条件是通过谈判确定的，而非市场定价。理解这类优先贷款与市场债务之间的互动对评估新型双边主权债务具有重要意义。
AI.theoretical_framework: 量化主权违约模型（quantitative sovereign default model），结合谈判理论（bargaining theory）分析双边贷款条件的内生决定。
AI.method: 构建包含大型优先贷款人的量化主权违约模型，其中双边借贷条件通过谈判确定，并进行定量模拟分析。
AI.findings: （1）从市场获得更多净融资会增强政府的谈判地位，改善双边贷款条件；（2）这种内生交叉弹性侵蚀了市场利差的约束纪律并加剧债务稀释；（3）即使双边借款在事后帮助避免了一些违约，仍会导致福利损失；（4）在预先设定规则的情况下，奖励市场发行可能足以产生此类损失，而最优规则应在市场净融资增加时提高双边利率。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将优先官方贷款人与市场债务之间的内生交叉弹性纳入主权违约模型，揭示了谈判机制下交叉弹性对利差纪律和债务稀释的放大效应，并提出了最优双边贷款规则的设计方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践中评估新型双边主权债务形式提供了指导——交叉弹性的方向可作为评估新型双边主权债务是否有利的实践指南。

title: AI Agents and Prompt Engineering in Econometric Coding
affiliations: ,  and University of San Andres (UdeSA)

detail.title: AI Agents and Prompt Engineering in Econometric Coding
detail.abstract:
We study how large language models write code for econometric analysis. We compare three dimensions of AI-assisted coding: statistical software (Stata, R, or Python), prompting (zero-shot versus few-shot), and the degree of agency, from a chatbot that writes a single script to an agent that executes and revises its own code. On a benchmark of applied econometric and statistical tasks, moving from the chatbot to the constrained agent raises task success from 74 to 96 percent, at about eight additional cents per run. For Claude Sonnet 4.6 and GPT-5.4 through Codex, few-shot prompting improves the chatbot far more than the constrained agent, indicating that prompting and agency act as substitutes. For these models, differences across statistical software are sizeable under the chatbot but largely disappear under the constrained agent.

Institutional subscribers to the NBER working paper series, and residents of developing countries may download this paper without additional charge at www.nber.org.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大语言模型如何编写计量经济学分析代码，比较了统计软件（Stata/R/Python）、提示方式（零样本vs少样本）以及AI自主性程度（从单一脚本聊天机器人到能执行并修订代码的代理）三个维度。基准测试表明，从聊天机器人升级为受约束的代理可将任务成功率从74%提升至96%，每次运行仅增加约8美分成本。对于Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-5.4（通过Codex），少样本提示对聊天机器人的改进远大于受约束代理，说明提示与代理具有替代关系；统计软件差异在聊天机器人下显著，但在受约束代理下基本消失。
AI.research_question: 大语言模型在不同软件环境、提示方式和自主性程度下，编写计量经济学分析代码的表现如何？
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在科研中的应用日益普及，需要对LLM辅助计量经济学编码的能力进行系统性评估，以指导研究者如何最优地使用这些工具——尤其是理解软件选择、提示工程和AI自主性程度之间的相互作用。
AI.theoretical_framework: 涉及AI辅助编码的理论框架，包括提示工程（prompting）、代理能力（agency）理论，以及人机交互中自主性水平对任务绩效的影响机制。
AI.method: 在应用计量经济学和统计任务基准上，系统比较三个维度：统计软件（Stata、R、Python）、提示策略（零样本vs少样本）、以及自主性程度（单一脚本聊天机器人vs能执行和修订自身代码的约束代理），并评估任务成功率与运行成本。
AI.findings: 1）从聊天机器人升级为受约束代理，任务成功率从74%提升至96%，每次运行仅增加约8美分成本；2）对于Claude Sonnet 4.6和GPT-5.4（通过Codex），少样本提示对聊天机器人的改进远大于受约束代理，说明提示与代理为替代关系；3）统计软件差异在聊天机器人模式下显著，但在受约束代理模式下基本消失。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了提示工程与AI代理自主性之间存在替代关系，而非互补关系；为理解LLM辅助编码中不同设计维度如何交互影响绩效提供了理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为计量经济学研究者提供了实用指导：采用受约束代理模式可显著提升代码成功率且成本可控；在软件选择上，若使用高自主性的AI代理则无需过度关注统计软件差异；提示工程在高自主性代理下收益递减。

title:
From Iran to Taylor Swift: 
Informed Trading in Prediction Markets
affiliations: Columbia Law School and University of Haifa

detail.title:
From Iran to Taylor Swift: 
Informed Trading in Prediction Markets
detail.abstract: This Article presents a systematic empirical and legal study of informed trading on prediction markets. We document a series of case studies in which traders appear to have exploited material nonpublic information on Polymarket and Kalshi, spanning events from the joint U.S. - Israel February 2026 strike on Iran to pre-announcement trading in Taylor Swift's engagement. Building on these cases, we develop a statistical screening of all Polymarket markets from February 2024 through February 2026, analyzing over 210,000 suspicious wallet-market pairs using a composite score that combines bet size anomalies, profitability, pre-event timing, and directional concentration. Flagged traders earn positive realized profit in 69.9% of resolved pairs and hold the winning token in 75.0%, in excess of chance and price-implied market expectations, and we estimate approximately $143 million in aggregate realized profit among the flagged pairs and $119 million more than execution prices implied. We then analyze the legal framework governing this conduct, finding that neither the classical nor misappropriation theories of securities fraud map cleanly onto geopolitical or macroeconomic event contracts, and that the CFTC's principal anti-fraud vehicle, Rule 180.1, is narrower in critical respects than SEC Rule 10b-5 and has rarely been applied to prediction markets. We argue that a comprehensive regulatory response requires mandatory registration and surveillance obligations for any platform serving U.S. persons, contract-level rules targeting high-risk information channels, and an extended misappropriation theory directed at informed traders on decentralized platforms that resist operator-level regulation.

AI.tldr: 本文对预测市场（Polymarket和Kalshi）上的知情交易进行了系统的实证与法律研究，通过案例分析、超过21万个可疑钱包-市场对的统计筛查，发现交易者利用重大非公开信息获利的证据，并指出现有证券欺诈法律框架（经典理论、盗用理论、CFTC Rule 180.1）均难以有效规制此类行为，提出了平台注册监管、合约层面规则及扩展盗用理论等综合监管建议。
AI.research_question: 预测市场中是否存在系统性利用重大非公开信息的知情交易行为？现有的法律与监管框架能否有效规制此类行为？如果需要规制，应当采取怎样的法律与监管路径？
AI.motivation: 预测市场（如Polymarket和Kalshi）快速增长，但关于知情交易的系统性实证研究匮乏；同时，现有证券法规（SEC Rule 10b-5、CFTC Rule 180.1）是否适用于预测市场的信息欺诈行为存在重大法律不确定性，亟需系统性审视。
AI.theoretical_framework: 证券欺诈法的经典理论（classical theory）与盗用理论（misappropriation theory）；法律与金融交叉分析框架；市场效率与价格预期理论。
AI.method: 多案例研究（从2026年2月美以联合打击伊朗到Taylor Swift订婚公告前交易）；对2024年2月至2026年2月Polymarket全部市场进行统计筛查，构建复合评分（包括下注规模异常、盈利性、事件前时机、方向集中度），分析超过21万个可疑钱包-市场对。
AI.findings: 被标记的交易者在69.9%的已解决对中实现正实际利润，75.0%持有获胜代币，显著超出随机概率和价格隐含的市场预期；标记对中估计累计实际利润约1.43亿美元，较执行价格隐含预期多出约1.19亿美元。法律分析发现，经典理论和盗用理论均无法干净地适用于地缘政治或宏观经济事件合约，且CFTC Rule 180.1在关键方面比SEC Rule 10b-5更窄，极少被应用于预测市场。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次对预测市场知情交易进行系统性大规模的实证检验；识别出现有证券欺诈法律理论（经典理论与盗用理论）在预测市场情境下的适用困境；提出扩展盗用理论以涵盖去中心化平台上知情交易者的理论创新。
AI.practical_contributions: 为监管机构（如CFTC）提供针对预测市场的具体监管建议：强制注册与监控义务、合约层面的高风险信息渠道规则，以及针对去中心化平台的扩展监管路径；为平台运营商和交易者提供知情交易风险的实证证据。

title: Two Geographies of Motorcycle Fatalities: Urban Streets and Highways in São Paulo
affiliations: Sao Paulo School of Economics FGV EESP

detail.title: Two Geographies of Motorcycle Fatalities: Urban Streets and Highways in São Paulo
detail.abstract: Motorcycle fatalities have risen sharply in the State of São Paulo, accounting for roughly 90% of the increase in road traffic deaths between 2019 and 2025. Using georeferenced data for the 645 municipalities of the State over 2019-2025, we estimate Bayesian spatial models (BYM2) relating fatality counts to demographic, socioeconomic and built-environment covariates, while decomposing residual risk into spatially structured and idiosyncratic components. We distinguish fatalities occurring on urban roads from those occurring on highways and estimate their differences directly using a joint bivariate spatial model. Three findings stand out. First, the post-2022 increase in motorcycle fatalities is concentrated on urban roads. Fatality rates on highways, measured per registered motorcycle, remained broadly stable, and direct urban-highway contrasts confirm statistically credible differences in the temporal trajectories in 2023, 2024, and 2025. Second, the correlates of motorcycle fatalities differ substantially between urban roads and highways, highlighting the importance of distinguishing these environments rather than modelling motorcycle mortality as a single aggregate process. Third, residual risk is strongly spatially structured: roughly two-thirds of the unexplained variation is spatial, with high-risk areas forming patterns that extend across municipal boundaries. These findings have direct implications for motorcycle-safety policy. The administrative scale at which interventions are typically designed does not always match the geography of risk. In particular, risks associated with highway corridors extend across municipal boundaries, indicating a need for coordination among neighbouring jurisdictions rather than isolated municipal interventions.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用巴西圣保罗州645个市镇2019-2025年的地理编码数据，通过贝叶斯空间模型（BYM2）和联合双变量空间模型，发现摩托车死亡率的上升主要集中在城市道路而非高速公路上，两类道路的风险影响因素存在显著差异，且未解释的残余风险约三分之二具有空间结构性特征，高风险区域的模式跨越市政边界，对交通安全政策具有直接启示。
AI.research_question: 圣保罗州2019-2025年摩托车死亡率的上升在空间上如何分布？城市道路与高速公路上的摩托车死亡率及其影响因素有何差异？残余风险是否呈现空间结构特征？
AI.motivation: 摩托车死亡人数在圣保罗州急剧上升，占2019至2025年间道路交通死亡增长的大约90%，但以往研究往往将摩托车死亡率视为单一的整体过程，未能区分城市道路与高速公路两种不同环境，也缺乏对空间结构的深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 贝叶斯空间统计理论，包括BYM2（Besag-York-Mollié二型）空间模型，以及联合双变量空间模型，用于分解空间结构化与个体特有（异质）残余风险成分。
AI.method: 使用圣保罗州645个市镇2019-2025年的地理编码数据，估计贝叶斯空间模型（BYM2），将死亡人数与人口、社会经济和建成环境协变量相关联，同时将残余风险分解为空间结构化和个体特有成分；进一步使用联合双变量空间模型直接估计城市道路与高速公路死亡率的差异。
AI.findings: 第一，2022年后摩托车死亡率的上升集中在城市道路，高速公路死亡率（按登记摩托车数计算）保持基本稳定，2023、2024和2025年两类道路的时间轨迹存在统计学上可信的差异。第二，摩托车死亡率的关联因素在城市道路与高速公路之间存在显著差异。第三，残余风险具有强烈的空间结构性，约三分之二的未解释变异是空间性的，高风险区域模式跨越市政边界。
AI.theory_contributions: 本研究通过直接估计城市道路与高速公路死亡率的差异，挑战了将摩托车死亡率视为单一聚合过程的传统做法，并利用空间分解方法揭示了残余风险的空间结构特征，为空间流行病学在道路交通安全领域的应用提供了理论贡献。
AI.practical_contributions: 研究结果表明，行政层面的干预设计规模往往与风险的地理分布不匹配。高速公路走廊相关风险跨越市政边界，表明需要邻近辖区之间的协调合作，而非孤立的市政干预，为摩托车安全政策制定提供了直接指导。

title: Revisiting Tourism Psychology and Tourist Experience: Evidence from Pentagonal Review Matrix and Causal Analysis
affiliations: Assam University - Department of Business Administration and Sunchon National University

detail.title: Revisiting Tourism Psychology and Tourist Experience: Evidence from Pentagonal Review Matrix and Causal Analysis
detail.abstract: Tourist psychology is fundam ental to fostering rational contributions, scholarly engagem ent, and stakeholder efforts toward the sustainable development of the tourism industry. This review paper serves two primary objectives: first, to evaluate tourism psychology and the tourist experience through the application of a Pentagonal Review M atrix; and second, to analyze the im pact of this m atrix using causal analysis m ethodology. The methodology involves identifying Boolean keywords related to tourist experience and psychology-mapped against the Maslowian Triangle and the five dimensions of the Pentagonal Review Matrix indices-within the Scopus database. By incorporating causal effects, this study provides a robust integrative conceptual framework for understanding the relationships and operational mechanisms of psychological factors. The analysis focuses on core objectives such as infrastructure and revenue generation, alongside findings related to community involvement, income generation, and destination attractiveness. Furthermore, it explores similarities in stakeholder competency, investment, and tourist arrivals, while highlighting unique contributions in resource management and tourism psychology across qualitative, quantitative, and mixed-method approaches. A significant takeaway is the call for future research to prioritize esteem and self-actualization needs, urging a shift beyond purely theoretical and empirical studies to provide more enriched perspectives on the tourism experience.

AI.tldr: 本文通过五星评价矩阵（Pentagonal Review Matrix）和因果分析方法，系统评述了旅游心理学与游客体验的研究现状，并构建了一个整合性概念框架，强调未来研究应更多关注尊重与自我实现需求。
AI.research_question: 如何运用五星评价矩阵和因果分析方法评估旅游心理学与游客体验研究，并理解心理因素的作用机制？
AI.motivation: 游客心理学对旅游业的可持续发展至关重要，但现有研究缺乏系统的整合性框架来理解心理因素与游客体验之间的关系及运作机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 马斯洛需求层次理论（Maslowian Triangle）、五星评价矩阵（Pentagonal Review Matrix）五维度指标
AI.method: 在Scopus数据库中，使用与游客体验和心理学相关的布尔关键词检索，结合马斯洛三角与五星评价矩阵五维度进行映射，并运用因果分析方法评估各维度的影响。
AI.findings: 研究发现核心因素包括基础设施与收入生成，以及社区参与、收入生成和目的地吸引力等相关发现；利益相关者能力、投资和游客到达量存在相似性；资源管理和旅游心理学在定性与定量及混合方法研究中各有独特贡献。
AI.theory_contributions: 提供一个稳健的整合性概念框架，阐明心理因素的关系与运作机制，并推动旅游心理学研究从纯粹理论与实证研究转向更丰富的体验视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为旅游业各利益相关者提供基于心理学的系统框架，有助于改善基础设施规划、社区参与、收入生成和目的地吸引力管理，促进旅游业可持续发展。

title: Evidence-Based National Implementation of the Afcfta Agreement and its Protocols a Cross-Continental Strategic Blueprint: Egypt, Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana, Kenya, and Cameroon
affiliations: Ahmadu Bello University

detail.title: Evidence-Based National Implementation of the Afcfta Agreement and its Protocols a Cross-Continental Strategic Blueprint: Egypt, Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana, Kenya, and Cameroon
detail.abstract:
As of July 2026, the operationalisation of the African Continental Free Trade Area (AfCFTA) Agreement has successfully transitioned from high-level treaty ratification to concrete, data-backed marketplace performance [^6]. Driven by milestone developments like the AfCFTA Digital Trade Forum in Lagos, member states have begun enforcing reciprocal tariff alignments and harmonizing cross-border protocols.

According to the definitive Afreximbank African Trade Report 2026, aggregate intra-African trade volumes climbed to $220 billion in 2025 and are on track to reach an unprecedented $250 billion by the close of 2026. This trajectory reflects a sharp increase in the depth of implementation across the continent’s key economic hubs.


While the deployment of the Pan-African Payment and Settlements System (PAPSS) is structurally eliminating third-currency dependencies and saving up to $5 billion annually [^3][^4], an execution gap remains between instant digital clearing and physical logistics. This definitive report provides a consolidated, evidence-based integration of national strategies, macro-level trade data, product type contributions, financial impacts, and actionable frameworks across six pivot economies: Egypt, Nigeria, South Africa, Ghana, Kenya, and Cameroon.

AI.tldr: 本文基于2026年非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）协议的实际运作情况，分析了非洲内部贸易从条约批准到市场化落实的转型过程。报告整合了六个关键经济体（埃及、尼日利亚、南非、加纳、肯尼亚、喀麦隆）的国家战略、宏观贸易数据、产品类型贡献、金融影响及可操作框架，显示2025年非洲内部贸易额已达2200亿美元，预计2026年底将达2500亿美元，同时PAPSS支付系统的部署每年可节省高达50亿美元。
AI.research_question: 非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）协议在从条约批准转向实际市场化运作的过程中，其执行情况如何？六个关键经济体的贸易整合、支付系统部署与物流执行之间的差距如何被弥合？
AI.motivation: AfCFTA已从高层条约批准阶段过渡到具体的、数据支撑的市场绩效阶段，但数字清算与实体物流之间仍存在执行差距。需要对这一转型过程进行系统性的、基于证据的整合分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 非洲大陆自由贸易区（AfCFTA）协议框架；泛非支付与结算系统（PAPSS）理论；区域经济一体化理论；关税协调与跨境协议理论。
AI.method: 采用基于证据的整合分析方法，综合国家战略、宏观贸易数据、产品类型贡献、金融影响等多维度数据进行综合分析，聚焦六个关键经济体。
AI.findings: 1) 2025年非洲内部贸易额达2200亿美元，预计2026年底达2500亿美元；2) PAPSS系统每年节省高达50亿美元的第三方货币依赖成本；3) 数字即时清算与物理物流之间仍存在执行差距；4) 非洲各主要经济枢纽的实施深度显著增加。
AI.theory_contributions: 为AfCFTA从条约批准到实际市场绩效的过渡提供了实证数据支撑，并揭示了数字支付系统与物流基础设施之间的理论执行差距。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了非洲六个关键经济体的综合贸易评估报告，为政策制定者、企业和投资者提供了可操作的框架和数据参考，支持非洲内部贸易的进一步深化。

title: Accounting for Space-system Development Costs A Stage-gated Recognition, Measurement and Disclosure Model under IFRS and US GAAP

detail.title: Accounting for Space-system Development Costs A Stage-gated Recognition, Measurement and Disclosure Model under IFRS and US GAAP

declarations.declarationOfInterest: he author declares that there are no personal, financial, or professional relationships or competing interests with any entities, organizations, or standard-setting bodies (including Rocket Lab USA, Inc., AST SpaceMobile, Inc., Redwire Corporation, IASB, or FASB) that could have influenced or be perceived to have influenced the objectivity, design, analysis, or conclusions reported in this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study, as the research did not involve human participants, patients, clinical trials, biological specimens, or personal data. The study methodology is entirely theoretical, conceptual, and analytical, relying on mathematical modeling, accounting framework design, and publicly available financial disclosures.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant, financial support, or commercial funding from any agency or organization in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors. The study was independently conducted and entirely self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
Commercial-space and other deep-technology firms can consume substantial capital for years before a
system is operational, while outsiders observe only aggregated research and development expense,
construction in progress, and selective technical milestones. The resulting accounting choice is
economically consequential: premature capitalization can overstate technological maturity and covenant
capacity, whereas indiscriminate expensing can conceal the formation of controlled operational assets
and qualifying development intangibles. Both errors weaken investors’, analysts’, creditors’, and
auditors’ ability to price execution risk, compare development intensity, and assess the persistence of
reported performance.
This paper develops the Space Development Cost Accounting Model (SDCAM), a stage-gated
engineering-to-accounting framework under current IFRS and US GAAP. SDCAM begins with scope
routing rather than a preferred capitalization outcome. It separately applies IAS 38, IAS 16, IAS 2,
IFRS 15, IAS 23, IAS 20, and IAS 36 under IFRS, and ASC 730, tangible-asset and inventory guidance,
ASC 340-40, applicable software guidance, ASC 835-20, and government-grant guidance under US
GAAP. The model does not convert technology-readiness levels, design reviews, funding awards, or
successful tests into accounting recognition rules. SDCAM does not create a sector-specific accounting
exception or override any recognition, measurement, presentation, or disclosure requirement; it is an
engineering-to-accounting ERP bridge that structures evidence and routes each cost cell to the existing
IFRS or US GAAP literature.
The model introduces five control artifacts: a project-and-configuration unit of account; a cost-cell
ledger connecting expenditure to purpose, phase, and output; a prospective IAS 38 development-
recognition gate; a US GAAP route-exclusivity control; and a readiness-for-intended-use gate. Sixteen
operational equations formalize recognition, attribution, allocation, failure disposition, financing, grant,
impairment, and reconciliation controls. These equations are not deterministic proofs and do not
displace professional judgment. They function as executable validation specifications for ERP and
subledger databases: required-field constraints, Boolean AND (∧) gates, route-exclusivity checks,
allocation rules, exception flags, and roll-forward reconciliations. By requiring each judgment to be
evidenced, time-stamped, and processed consistently, they make human judgment traceable, auditable,
and reproducible without converting uncertain engineering facts into numerical certainties.
The Asteria numerical case demonstrates that identical engineering facts can produce materially
different EBITDA, operating-margin, and invested-capital profiles under IFRS and US GAAP even
when tangible construction is treated consistently. Public disclosures by Rocket Lab, AST SpaceMobile,
and Redwire further show that material R&D expense can coexist with construction in progress,
reusable test assets, design-change losses, and qualification failures. SDCAM converts those
economically distinct activities into a connected reconciliation that supports valuation, credit analysis,
covenant monitoring, audit testing, and disclosure review.
Methodologically, SDCAM is a Design-Science Research artifact following the process taxonomy of
Peffers et al. (2007). The paper completes problem definition, solution-objective specification, artifact
design, and operational demonstration through the Asteria case and public market evidence. It
deliberately reserves field evaluation and archival econometric validation for the seven propositions
and research protocols presented later. The central contribution is a decision-useful and falsifiable
reporting architecture that improves the visibility and pricing of development risk without creating a
sector-specific recognition exception.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了空间开发成本会计模型（SDCAM），一个在现行IFRS和US GAAP框架下的阶段门控工程-会计桥梁模型，通过五个控制人工制品和十六个操作方程，将工程证据结构化地路由至现有会计准则，提高商业太空及深科技企业开发风险的可见性与可定价性，而无需创建行业特定的会计例外。
AI.research_question: 商业太空及深科技企业在长期资本消耗阶段，如何在不偏离现有IFRS和US GAAP框架的前提下，改善开发成本会计处理的决策有用性，使外部利益相关者（投资者、分析师、债权人、审计师）能够更好地评估执行风险、比较开发强度并判断业绩持续性？
AI.motivation: 商业太空等深科技企业可能在系统运营前多年消耗大量资本，而外部观察者只能看到汇总的研发费用、在建工程和选择性技术里程碑。过早资本化会夸大技术成熟度和契约能力，而一律费用化则会掩盖受控运营资产和合格开发无形资产的形�成，这两类错误都会损害外部利益相关者对执行风险的定价能力和业绩持续性的评估能力。
AI.theoretical_framework: 设计科学研究（Design-Science Research），遵循Peffers et al. (2007)的过程分类法；在IFRS下分别应用IAS 38、IAS 16、IAS 2、IFRS 15、IAS 23、IAS 20和IAS 36；在US GAAP下应用ASC 730、有形资产与存货指引、ASC 340-40、适用软件指引、ASC 835-20和政府补助指引。
AI.method: 设计科学研究方法，遵循Peffers et al. (2007)过程分类法。完成问题定义、解决方案目标规格、人工制品设计和操作演示。通过Asteria数值案例和Rocket Lab、AST SpaceMobile、Redwire的公开披露进行演示验证。提出七个命题和研究协议供后续实地评估和档案计量验证。
AI.findings: Asteria数值案例表明，即使在有形建造处理一致的情况下，相同的工程事实在IFRS和US GAAP下也会产生实质性不同的EBITDA、营业利润率和投资资本特征。公开披露显示，重大研发费用可以与在建工程、可复用测试资产、设计变更损失和合格性失败共存。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种决策有用且可证伪的报告架构，在不创建行业特定确认例外的情况下提升开发风险的可见性和可定价性。SDCAM不将技术就绪水平、设计评审、资助奖励或成功测试转换为会计确认规则，而是作为工程到会计的ERP桥梁，将证据结构化并路由至现有IFRS或US GAAP文献。将人类判断变得可追溯、可审计和可复现，而无需将不确定的工程事实转化为数值确定性。
AI.practical_contributions: 五个控制人工制品（项目与配置记账单位、成本单元分类账、前瞻性IAS 38开发确认门、US GAAP路由排他性控制、预期用途就绪门）和十六个操作方程可作为ERP和子分类账数据库的可执行验证规格，支持估值、信用分析、契约监控、审计测试和披露审查。在场实施将提升开发成本核算的透明度、可比性和可审计性。

title: Urban Waterlogging in Bangladesh (2015-2018): Its Spatio-temporal Pattern, Relationship with Rainfall, and (Proximate) Causes
affiliations: North South University and

detail.title: Urban Waterlogging in Bangladesh (2015-2018): Its Spatio-temporal Pattern, Relationship with Rainfall, and (Proximate) Causes
detail.abstract: To a future where the fast-growing coastal areas will host most of humanity, urban areas in deltaic Bangladesh offer potentially useful lessons. One major lens to look into the processes in urban growth and governance in these parts of the world is urban waterlogging. This study documented waterlogging events in urban Bangladesh from newspaper reports over a 4 year period (2015-2018). Urban waterlogging is pervasive and occurred in all parts of the country. Among the 327 urban areas in 2018, 146 (44.6%) experienced waterlogging at least once. Among the 43 larger urban areas with 100,000 or more population, 38 (88.4%) were found to have experienced waterlogging at least once in that period. The urban areas that did not experience waterlogging are mostly small, with a median population of less than 28 thousand. There was no relationship between population density in an area and the number of events. The hypothesis that faster-growing areas might have upset natural drainage, and thereby more susceptible was not supported by data either. From a daily rainfall database of 259 rain gauge locations across the country, this study found the rainfall amount that can be attributed to every event (through a GIS procedure). Nearly 31% of the events happened with less than 50mm of daily rainfall. As per rainfall data from the past 5 years, an average urban area saw more rain than that in 13.5 days per year. The two largest cities, Dhaka and Chittagong, were found to have waterlogged with much less rain than that. The proximate causes found in this study point to the legal and illegal earth-filling of wetlands and canals, and solid waste clogging drains and natural channels. They all are tied to larger issues in urban environmental management and governance of urban growth.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过2015-2018年间报纸报道和259个雨量站数据，系统记录了孟加拉国城市内涝事件。研究发现城市内涝在该国普遍存在，44.6%的城市区域（327个中的146个）至少经历过一次内涝，但人口密度和城市增长速度与内涝事件频率无关。31%的内涝事件发生在日降雨量不足50毫米的情况下，说明内涝并非单纯由强降雨驱动，而是与湿地和运河被合法及非法填埋、固体废物堵塞排水系统等治理问题密切相关。
AI.research_question: 孟加拉国三角洲城市区域的城市内涝事件在空间上如何分布？其发生频率与人口密度、城市增长速度及降雨量有何关系？导致内涝的直接原因是什么？
AI.motivation: 快速增长的沿海地区将容纳大部分人类，而孟加拉国三角洲城市提供了潜在的有用经验教训。城市内涝是审视这些地区城市增长与治理过程的重要视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 城市内涝作为审视城市增长与治理的透镜；城市增长对自然排水系统影响的假设。
AI.method: 基于报纸报道的内容分析（2015-2018年4年期间）记录内涝事件；利用地理信息系统（GIS）程序将259个雨量站数据与内涝事件进行匹配归因；统计分析人口密度、城市规模与内涝事件数的关系。
AI.findings: 1）城市内涝在孟加拉国全国普遍存在，327个城市区域中146个（44.6%）至少经历一次内涝；43个人口10万以上的较大城市中38个（88.4%）发生过内涝。2）未发生内涝的城市多为小城市（人口中位数低于2.8万）。3）人口密度与内涝事件数无显著关系。4）增长更快的城市扰乱自然排水从而更易内涝的假设未得到数据支持。5）约31%的内涝事件发生在日降雨量不足50毫米的情况下，平均城市每年有13.5天降雨量超过这一阈值。6）达卡和吉大港两大城市在更少的降雨量下就发生内涝。7）直接原因包括合法和非法填埋湿地与运河、固体废物堵塞排水系统。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了"快速增长城市更易内涝"的假设，表明内涝问题并非单纯由人口密度或增长速率驱动，而是普遍存在于各种规模和增长模式的城市中，凸显了城市环境治理的结构性问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为孟加拉国乃至其他三角洲地区的城市治理提供了系统的内涝事件证据基础，指出湿地和运河填埋及排水系统堵塞是治理的关键切入点，为城市增长管理政策提供实证依据。

detail.abstract: The major goal of a ferry terminal is to serve transportation activities, besides many other important factors, it must be located in the right place. In this research the main purpose is finding optimum location for ferry terminals so: By field studies and published documents fifteen factors that may have the most effects extracted and then by using the S.W.O.T technique and related strategies also mathematical and psychological data and results based on the AHP method, rankings, weights, and results are calculated and sorted. As research, factors assigned to three locations at the Persian Gulf coastal line with acceptable conditions and outputs are presented as schedules and charts. Finally, the results are compared and the best output introduced as the most optimum location for regional ferry terminals.

AI.tldr: 本研究旨在为波斯湾沿岸地区的渡轮码头寻找最优选址。通过实地调研和文献资料提取了15个关键影响因素，运用SWOT技术及相关策略，结合基于AHP方法的数学和心理数据，对三个候选地点进行排名、权重计算和结果排序，最终通过比较确定最佳选址方案。
AI.research_question: 如何确定波斯湾沿岸地区渡轮码头的最优选址位置？
AI.motivation: 渡轮码头的主要功能是服务交通运输活动，其位置选择至关重要，必须位于合适的地点才能充分发挥其功能。
AI.theoretical_framework: SWOT分析法、层次分析法（AHP）
AI.method: 通过实地调研和文献查阅提取15个影响渡轮码头选址的因素；运用SWOT技术制定相关策略；结合AHP方法处理数学与心理数据，计算各候选地点的排名、权重及最终结果。
AI.findings: 在波斯湾海岸线上确定了三个具有可接受条件的候选地点，通过比较各因素的排名和权重，最终筛选出最优的渡轮码头选址方案，并以图表形式呈现。
AI.theory_contributions: 将SWOT分析与AHP方法相结合，应用于渡轮码头选址问题，为该领域提供了一种多准则决策分析的综合方法论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为波斯湾地区渡轮码头规划与建设提供了具体的选址决策参考，帮助相关决策者通过系统化的评估过程确定最佳选址位置。

declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a meta-analysis of publicly available, previously published literature and secondary data (financial disclosure reports and peer-reviewed studies) and did not involve human participants, patients, or personally identifiable data requiring IRB review. One personal interview was conducted with a subject-matter expert (Professor Kent Kauffman) who provided informed consent for his statements to be quoted and attributed in this paper
