detail.title: Equilibrium Exchange Rate and an Assessment of the Currency Misalignment in Kenya

declarations.funderStatement: Central Bank of Kenya funded the project

contentType.other: A working Paper Series awaiting publication

publicationDetails.detailsText: This paper has been accepted to be published as a Central Bank of Kenya Working Paper Series

detail.abstract: This study estimated Kenya's equilibrium exchange rate and measured the misalignment gap using quarterly data covering the period 2009-2025. The analysis employed descriptive analysis and empirically estimated the long-run behavioural equilibrium exchange rate model using the autoregressive distributed lag model. The descriptive analysis revealed that Kenya's main trading partners account for about 60 percent of total trade and have remained largely the same over the study period. Despite Kenya's minimal trade with the United States of America, the US Dollar remained the main international invoicing currency and a key driver of the nominal effective exchange rate. The trend appreciation of the real effective exchange rate was attributed to a slowdown in the consumer price index during 2019-2022. The empirical model confirmed the existence of a long-run equilibrium relationship and the role of macroeconomic fundamentals in driving Kenya's exchange rate. The results showed that higher government expenditures, openness, and positive terms of trade led to a real depreciation, whereas net foreign assets and interest rate differentials caused a real appreciation. The study further revealed episodes of currency misalignment, which coincided with periods of external shocks and domestic policy shifts. In 2023, the misalignment gap was estimated at 11.3 percent, subsequently declining to 6.6 percent and 3.3 percent in 2024 and 2025, respectively. The study recommends a combination of short-run and long-run policy measures to address the currency misalignment. Monetary policy should be used in the short run to stabilize the exchange rate and strengthen the foreign exchange reserves, while in the medium to long-run, structural policies should aim at enhancing productivity, export capacity, and external competitiveness.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2009-2025年季度数据，通过自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型估计肯尼亚的均衡汇率及汇率失调程度。研究发现宏观经济基本面显著驱动汇率变动，2023年汇率失调为11.3%，随后降至2024年的6.6%和2025年的3.3%，并建议短期采用货币政策、中长期采用结构性政策应对失调。
AI.research_question: 肯尼亚的均衡汇率水平是多少？其实际汇率与均衡汇率之间的失调（misalignment）程度如何？
AI.motivation: 汇率失调会损害一国的外部竞争力和宏观经济稳定，肯尼亚作为东非重要经济体，需要准确评估其汇率失衡程度，以制定适当的政策应对措施。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为均衡汇率（BEER）模型
AI.method: 描述性分析结合自回归分布滞后（ARDL）模型估计长期行为均衡汇率。
AI.findings: （1）肯尼亚主要贸易伙伴占其总贸易约60%；（2）尽管对美贸易量小，美元仍是主要国际计价货币和名义有效汇率的关键驱动因素；（3）2019-2022年CPI放缓导致实际有效汇率趋势性升值；（4）政府支出增加、开放度提高和贸易条件改善导致实际贬值，而净国外资产和利率差异导致实际升值；（5）2023年失调11.3%，2024年和2025年分别降至6.6%和3.3%。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中国家（尤其是肯尼亚）的均衡汇率研究提供了BEER模型的经验证据，确认了宏观经济基本面在驱动汇率中的长期均衡作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为肯尼亚政策制定者提供了量化的汇率失调估计，建议短期内运用货币政策稳定汇率和增强外汇储备，中长期通过结构性政策提升生产率、出口能力和外部竞争力。

title:
Valuing Tokenised Natural Resources

A Methodology for NAV Construction in Illiquid, Heterogeneous Gemstone Portfolios Under MiCA

detail.title:
Valuing Tokenised Natural Resources

A Methodology for NAV Construction in Illiquid, Heterogeneous Gemstone Portfolios Under MiCA

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Tord Johan Eide is the founder of Navigator Global LLC, the entity that developed and operates the GEMNYX gemstone price intelligence platform. GEMNYX is used in this paper as the independent valuation tool for assessing the GNRC reserve; it was not built exclusively for this purpose and is designed to evaluate gemstone assets in a professional and unbiased manner using publicly sourced market benchmarks. The GNRC token is issued by The Mint AS a company indirectly controlled by Tord Johan Eide (org. no. 831163232, Narvik, Norway); Navigator Global LLC and The Mint AS are separate entities. The author discloses this affiliation in the interest of full transparency. The methodology described in this paper is presented as a documented, replicable framework and does not constitute investment advice or a prospectus. All interpretations, conclusions, and policy recommendations are the author's own and do not represent the official position of The Mint AS, Navigator Global LLC, or any regulatory authority. Readers are invited to replicate the analysis using the publicly available D2C source databases cited in Section 4.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received

detail.abstract:
This paper presents the first systematic empirical evaluation of a mark-to-model net asset value (NAV)
methodology for a physical gemstone-backed asset-referenced token (ART) under the Markets in Crypto-
Assets Regulation (Regulation (EU) 2023/1114, MiCA). Using the GNRC token — issued by The Mint AS
and backed by a portfolio of approximately 46,766 carats of Greenlandic ruby and sapphire — as its
primary case study, we draw on 15,459 arm's-length wholesale transactions and 45,510 direct-to-
consumer (D2C) retail observations across eight independent sources. We make four contributions: (1)
we develop and evaluate a three-tier NAV signal hierarchy designed to satisfy the mark-to-model
requirements of MiCA Article 36(11) and assess its application to a heterogeneous gemstone reserve for
mark-to-model valuation of non-financial reserve assets; (2) we show that grade-tier segmentation of D2C
benchmarks is methodologically necessary, eliminating a systematic downward bias of up to 73% in the
smallest size bands; (3) we document that the certification-gap rationale for a 50% wholesale discount
factor is not empirically supported, and propose revision to 60–65% subject to independent appraisal; and
(4) we establish a generalised framework for applying the methodology to other physical commodity ART
classes. We conclude with policy recommendations for ART issuers, national competent authorities, and
the European Banking Authority.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统性地实证评估了在欧盟加密资产市场法规（MiCA）框架下，实物宝石支持的资产参考代币（ART）采用"按模型计价"（mark-to-model）净资产价值（NAV）方法论的可行性。以GNRC代币为案例（由The Mint AS发行，以约46,766克拉格陵兰红宝石和蓝宝石组合为支撑），利用15,459笔批发交易和45,510笔直销零售数据，提出三层NAV信号层级体系，并给出政策建议。
AI.research_question: 如何构建并实证验证一种满足MiCA法规第36(11)条"按模型计价"要求的净资产价值估算方法论，以适用于实物宝石支持的资产参考代币（ART）？
AI.motivation: MiCA法规对资产参考代币的价值评估提出了监管要求，但针对实物非金融储备资产（如宝石）的定价方法论缺乏系统性的实证检验。现有做法中存在的批发折扣因子（50%）缺乏实证支持，且分级定价中的系统性偏差未被识别，需要填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: MiCA法规框架（Article 36(11)的mark-to-model要求）；资产参考代币（ART）估值理论；三层NAV信号层级体系；分级（grade-tier）市场分割理论；批发折扣因子（certification-gap rationale）理论。
AI.method: 以GNRC代币为主要案例研究，收集15,459笔第三方批发交易和45,510笔直销消费者（D2C）零售观测数据（来自八个独立数据源），开发三层NAV信号层级并评估其应用，进行统计比较分析以检验分级偏差和折扣因子的合理性。
AI.findings: (1) 开发并验证了满足MiCA第36(11)条的三层NAV信号层级体系；(2) 分级细分在方法上必不可少，可消除最小尺寸区间中高达73%的系统性向下偏差；(3) 50%批发折扣因子的"认证缺口"理由在实证上不成立，建议修订为60–65%（需独立评估）；(4) 建立了适用于其他实物商品ART类别的推广框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次为MiCA法规下的实物资产支持代币建立了经实证检验的"按模型计价"估值方法论；揭示了D2C基准分级中系统性偏差的存在及其量级；实证否定了批发折扣因子的传统认证缺口理论依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ART发行方、国家主管当局和欧洲银行管理局提供具体政策建议；提供了可直接应用于其他实物商品ART的通用估值框架；为监管合规提供了可操作的NAV估算路径。

title: You cannot Buy Expectancy by Moving the Target: Breakeven Geometry of Reward-to-Risk Ratios in Micro E-mini Futures

detail.title: You cannot Buy Expectancy by Moving the Target: Breakeven Geometry of Reward-to-Risk Ratios in Micro E-mini Futures
detail.abstract: Practitioners are routinely told to demand a minimum reward-to-risk ratio (RR) before taking a trade. This note separates what that heuristic can and cannot deliver. First, we derive the breakeven geometry: with payoff ratio q and round-trip cost k (as a fraction of risk), the breakeven hit rate is p* = (1+k)/(1+q), so raising q lowers the bar hyperbolically. Second, we quantify a widely repeated but rarely examined claim about the cost of evidence: holding the hit rate fixed at p = 0.55, raising RR from 1.0 to 2.0 shrinks the sample at which the asymptotic noncentrality of a t-test reaches a t* = 2.8 gate from roughly 1,925 trades to 46. We show this figure is a fixed-hit-rate counterfactual upper bound, not a theorem: if instead the trader's excess hit rate over breakeven, d = p - p*, is held fixed, the required samples are approximately 1,925, 1,922, and 1,827 - the headline gain disappears. Which regime obtains is an empirical question about whether moving the target erodes the hit rate. Third, we report a time-stamped, preregistered trading rule on Micro E-mini S&P 500 (MES) 1-minute data, evaluated by a blind, code-independent reimplementation, in which structuring targets off an established intraday range lifts mean RR to 4.93 while the target-first rate falls to 18.0% - against a binary-counterfactual gross breakeven of 16.9% - and mean net expectancy is +0.064R (t = +0.41, n = 205); the sign of the sample mean is sensitive to the largest five winners. Under the frozen evaluation gate the verdict is no evidence of positive expectancy. H16 is a single high-q case consistent with the joint geometry; it does not identify the causal effect of changing q. RR and hit rate must be discussed jointly: RR choice can stop a trader from giving away expectancy they already have, but it cannot manufacture expectancy by moving the target.

AI.tldr: 本文剖析了交易中"最低盈亏比(RR)"这一常见启发式规则的边界：通过盈亏平衡几何推导出盈亏平衡命中率公式p*=(1+k)/(1+q)，并检验了一个广泛流传的"证据成本"论点——该论点是固定命中率下的反事实上限而非定理。文章还报告了一个预注册的MES交易规则实证评估，结果显示在高盈亏比(4.93)但低命中率(18%)的情况下，样本均值对最大赢家敏感，在冻结评估门槛下无证据表明存在正期望。
AI.research_question: 盈亏比(RR)这一交易启发式规则究竟能提供什么、不能提供什么？特别是：(1)盈亏平衡几何关系是什么？(2)广为流传的"通过提高RR大幅缩短所需样本量"的说法是否成立？(3)高RR策略在实际数据中是否真的能产生正期望？
AI.motivation: 实践者常被告知交易前应要求最低盈亏比，但该启发式的数学边界和效力从未被严格审视。文中提到一个广泛重复但极少检验的论断——固定命中率下提高RR可大幅缩减证据所需样本（从1925笔降至46笔），这一论断的成立条件需要澄清。
AI.theoretical_framework: 盈亏平衡几何（breakeven geometry）、非中心t检验的渐近非中心性、反事实分析框架（固定命中率 vs 固定超额命中率d=p-p*）
AI.method: (1)推导盈亏平衡命中率公式p*=(1+k)/(1+q)；(2)对比两种反事实场景下提高RR对所需样本量的影响；(3)对MES 1分钟数据进行时间戳预注册交易规则测试，采用盲法、代码无关的重新实现进行独立评估
AI.findings: (1)盈亏平衡命中率p*=(1+k)/(1+q)，提高q以双曲线形式降低门槛；(2)固定命中率p=0.55时，RR从1.0升至2.0使所需样本从约1925笔降至46笔，但这是反事实上限；若固定超额命中率d=p-p*，所需样本约1925、1922、1827笔，大幅改善消失；(3)实证中MES策略平均RR为4.93但命中率仅18.0%（对照盈亏平衡16.9%），平均净期望+0.064R但t值仅0.41且对最大五个赢家敏感，在冻结评估门槛下无正期望证据。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次严格区分了盈亏比启发式的数学作用边界：盈亏比选择可以防止交易者交出已有的期望，但不能通过移动目标来创造期望；澄清了"提高RR缩减样本量"论断的反事实性质——其成立取决于目标移动是否侵蚀命中率这一经验问题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实践者提供明确的盈亏比决策框架：盈亏比和命中率必须联合讨论；单一高盈亏比案例不能证明因果效应；提示交易者在设定RR时需考虑其对命中率的侵蚀效应，且应关注样本均值对极端值的敏感性。

title: Emissions Impacts of Different Corporate Renewable Energy Standards in Asia
affiliations: WattTime and WattTime

detail.title: Emissions Impacts of Different Corporate Renewable Energy Standards in Asia

declarations.declarationOfInterest: Both authors are employees of WattTime which produces and freely distributes historical MBER data using the definition from the Greenhouse Gas Project Protocol as described in this work.
declarations.funderStatement: Support for the work was provided by Apple, Fast Forward, HPE Foundation, Meta Platforms, James and Kaye Slavet, and Reed Hoffman. The views expressed in the article do not necessarily represent the views of the sponsor.

detail.abstract: Voluntary corporate renewable energy procurement is a critical driver of global grid decarbonization, and the choices made by purchasers are heavily influenced by the accounting standards used to define emissions claims. As the Greenhouse Gas Protocol (GHGP) revises its Scope 2 Guidance, three primary strategies have emerged: annual volume matching, hourly matching (24/7), and consequential emissions matching. While previous research has evaluated these strategies in the United States and Europe, there is a significant research gap regarding their impact in rapidly developing Asian markets. This study provides a systematic comparison of these three strategies across 13 Asian countries-including India, Indonesia, Vietnam, and Thailand-from 2025 to 2035. Using Transition Zero's Scenario Builder tool for capacity expansion modeling, we evaluate the cost-effectiveness and total emissions reductions of each strategy. We find that a consequential emissions optimized portfolio can reduce 1.8-3.1 times more global emissions than annual or hourly matched portfolios for the same cost by prioritizing investment toward higher emission grids in the region. These findings suggest that a consequential approach to voluntary procurement can increase global impact over locational and temporal matching. We also find good alignment between emissions changes predicted by least-cost capacity expansion models and a consequential marginal build emissions rate calculated from historical data.

AI.tldr: 本研究首次系统比较了三种企业自愿可再生能源采购策略（年度匹配、小时匹配/24/7、后果性排放匹配）在13个亚洲国家（2025-2035年）的成本效益和减排效果，发现后果性排放优化组合能以相同成本实现比年度或小时匹配多1.8-3.1倍的全球减排，建议自愿采购应采用后果性方法以最大化全球影响。
AI.research_question: 在快速发展的亚洲市场中，三种企业自愿可再生能源采购策略（年度匹配、小时匹配/24/7、后果性排放匹配）在成本效益和总减排量方面的表现有何差异？哪一种策略能够最大化全球减排影响？
AI.motivation: 企业自愿可再生能源采购是全球电网脱碳的关键驱动力，采购方的选择深受温室气体核算标准（GHGP Scope 2指南修订）的影响。以往研究仅在美国和欧洲评估了这些策略，对快速发展的亚洲市场存在显著研究空白，而亚洲是全球碳排放增长最快的地区。
AI.theoretical_framework: 温室气体核算标准（GHGP Scope 2指南修订）框架下的三种采购策略理论：年度匹配、小时匹配（24/7）及后果性排放匹配方法。
AI.method: 使用Transition Zero的Scenario Builder工具进行容量扩展建模，对13个亚洲国家（包括印度、印尼、越南和泰国）从2025至2035年进行系统性比较分析，评估三种采购策略的成本效益和总排放削减量。
AI.findings: 1) 后果性排放优化组合能以相同成本实现比年度或小时匹配多1.8-3.1倍的全球减排；2) 后果性方法通过优先投资区域中排放较高的电网来最大化全球影响；3) 最小成本容量扩展模型预测的排放变化与基于历史数据计算的后果性边际建筑排放率高度一致。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了亚洲市场背景下三种采购策略比较的研究空白；验证了后果性排放方法在亚洲情景下的有效性；建立了容量扩展模型预测排放变化与历史数据计算的后果性边际排放率之间的理论一致性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为GHGP Scope 2指南修订提供亚洲市场证据支持；为企业自愿可再生能源采购决策提供跨区域策略选择参考；帮助政策制定者和采购方理解不同核算标准在亚洲电网脱碳中的实际影响。

title: A Right Without a Remedy: Self-Determination and the Kashmir Dispute in International Law

detail.title: A Right Without a Remedy: Self-Determination and the Kashmir Dispute in International Law

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable — no ethics approval required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: The Kashmir dispute is routinely described as a paradigmatic self-determination claim, yet the doctrine's application to the territory remains deeply contested. This paper argues that the difficulty is not primarily one of recognition but of mechanism. Self-determination is firmly established in international law as a right of peoples and, in its external form, as a peremptory norm; but the instruments that recognise it supply no operative procedure capable of delivering a lawful outcome in a case such as Kashmir, where two states advance competing sovereign claims, the governing United Nations Security Council resolutions are non-binding and conditional, and the affected population is itself internally divided. Tracing the contract between norm and mechanism through the historical record, the treaty and customary framework, and the leading International Court of Justice pronouncements on Western Sahara, East Timor and the Wall, the paper finds that Kashmir occupies the gap between a recognised entitlement and the absence of any lawful means to realise it. It concludes that resolution depends less on re-litigating whether the right exists than on constructing a mechanism, negotiated, mediated, or institutional-through which it could legitimately be exercised, and that the internal dimension of self-determination offers the more realistic near-term terrain than external secession. AI disclosure: The research, argument, and original text of this paper are the author's own. The author reviewed all content and is solely responsible for it.

AI.tldr: 本文认为克什米尔争端的核心问题不在于自决权是否被承认，而在于缺乏将其付诸实施的操作机制。通过对历史记录、条约与习惯法框架以及国际法院关于西撒哈拉、东帝汶和隔离墙案的裁决的梳理，论文指出克什米尔处于一个"被承认的权利"与"无法实现的合法手段"之间的裂隙中，并主张解决之道应转向构建协商、调解或制度化机制，且自决权的内部维度比外部独立更为现实。
AI.research_question: 克什米尔争端为何难以通过自决权原则得到解决？其根本障碍究竟是权利承认问题还是实施机制缺失问题？
AI.motivation: 克什米尔争端被广泛视为典型的自决权主张案例，但该原则在该领域的适用却饱受争议。现有讨论多聚焦于权利是否成立，而本文提出真正的困境在于缺乏能将自决权转化为合法结果的操作性程序机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际法中的民族自决权理论（作为人民权利及强行法规范）、条约与习惯国际法框架、国际法院（ICJ）关于西撒哈拉、东帝汶和隔离墙案的判例理论。
AI.method: 规范性法律分析：通过对历史记录、条约与习惯法框架、以及国际法院关键判例（西撒哈拉案、东帝汶案、隔离墙案）的系统梳理与文本分析，论证自决权的"规范-机制"之间的断裂。
AI.findings: 克什米尔处于被承认的自决权与缺乏任何合法实现手段之间的裂隙之中。争端面临三个结构性障碍：两国提出竞争性主权主张、联合国安理会决议不具有约束力且附有条件、受影响人口本身内部分裂。
AI.theory_contributions: 将自决权难题从"承认问题"重新框定为"机制问题"，提出规范与实施机制之间的结构性脱节是理解克什米尔僵局的关键；区分自决权的内部维度与外部维度，指出内部自决是更为现实的近期路径。
AI.practical_contributions: 为克什米尔争端的和平解决提供政策方向：与其反复争论权利是否存在，不如致力于构建一套协商、调解或制度化的合法行使机制，并将焦点从外部独立转向内部自决的实践。

title: Null Results Under Pre-specified Retail Implementation Regimes: A Sequentially Registered Audit of Futures and ETF Strategies

detail.title: Null Results Under Pre-specified Retail Implementation Regimes: A Sequentially Registered Audit of Futures and ETF Strategies
detail.abstract: We report the complete, gap-free record of a July 2026 research campaign - all verdicts delivered within an eleven-day adjudication window (2026-07-21 to 2026-07-31) - on tradeable futures and ETF strategies conducted under a registration protocol designed for a single researcher assisted by AI agents. The campaign comprises 15 prospectively registered confirmatory hypotheses (H1-H9, G1, H11-H13, H15-H16), 2 preregistered replication exercises (H7b, H7c), 1 descriptive benchmark (H10 phase 1), and 1 non-preregistered but audited feasibility screen (H14); three unregistered daily-frequency contextual screens are reported separately and enter no count. Hypotheses were registered sequentially - each frozen, with acceptance gates and kill rules, before any outcome statistic was computed - rather than en bloc; inputs and data segments were pinned by SHA-256 hashes, permutation and random-sign null distributions served as controls in the later studies, and one late-stage result (H16) was subjected to a result-withheld, session-isolated reimplementation (planned replications of H11 and H15 were not completed within the study window). No directional hypothesis produced a tradeable edge under its study-specific pre-specified implementation regime. The failures are heterogeneous and we classify each, as a descriptive diagnosis, by a primary mode drawn from three: no detectable gross signal (e.g., stop-sweep reversion pinned at 50.2% on n=514; a MIP-selected rulebook at OOS t=-1.32; an opening-shock fade whose frictionless mean is still -$5.09/trade), gross signal too small for measured frictions (order-flow information with a point estimate of +0.43 ticks against a 2.12-tick execution hurdle), and statistically unresolved (FOMC-surprise drift, mean +10.1 ticks/trade at t=+0.33, n=14). The registered time-series-momentum specification passed its statistical gate (t=2.43); the pass did not survive a post-registration implementation model incorporating funding costs (t=2.21). The only robust survivors are volatility-magnitude effects: an overnight-amplitude filter (combined Welch t=+9.40, replicated 13/13 across instruments spanning six broad asset groups) and the S&P 500 volatility risk premium (non-overlapping monthly t=+10.12, robust at 9.79-10.94 across 21 sampling offsets; positive in 33 of 34 years). We argue that the transferable contribution is the protocol - freeze, hash, kill, null-check, replicate - together with a precise per-hypothesis accounting of why each claim failed, not any surviving signal.

AI.tldr: 本文报告了2026年7月一项由单一研究者与AI代理合作、在注册协议下进行的期货与ETF策略研究活动的完整记录。15个预注册假设与2个预注册复制实验中，无一方向性假设在预指定实施制度下产生可交易的边际优势，失败原因被分类为三类。唯一的稳健幸存者是波动率幅度效应（隔夜振幅过滤器与标普500波动率风险溢价）。作者认为可转移的贡献在于协议本身（冻结、哈希、终止规则、零分布检验、复制），而非任何幸存的信号。
AI.research_question: 在严格的预注册与审计协议下，可交易的期货和ETF策略假设中有多少能通过预指定的实施制度并产生真实的交易边际优势？
AI.motivation: 量化交易研究面临严重的选择偏差、数据窥探和发表偏差问题。作者旨在通过完整的、无遗漏的注册研究活动记录，提供关于可交易策略真实成功率的可靠证据，并诊断各类失败的机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 预注册方法论；假设验证框架（含接受门槛与终止规则）；零分布检验（排列与随机符号分布）；结果扣留式独立复现；摩擦成本模型；波动率溢价理论。
AI.method: 15个预注册确认性假设（H1-H9, G1, H11-H13, H15-H16）、2个预注册复制练习（H7b, H7c）、1个描述性基准（H10第一阶段）和1个未预注册但经审计的可行性筛选（H14）。假设顺序冻结、SHA-256哈希锁定输入与数据段、后期研究使用排列与随机符号零分布检验、H16接受结果扣留的会话隔离复现。所有假设在预指定实施制度下检验，失败按三种主要模式分类。
AI.findings: 无方向性假设产生可交易边际优势。失败分三类：无可检测的原始信号（如止损扫荡反转锁定在50.2%，n=514；MIP选择规则OOS t=-1.32；开盘冲击衰减摩擦前均值仍为-$5.09/笔）；原始信号对摩擦不足（订单流信息点估计+0.43个tick，对2.12个tick执行门槛）；统计上未决（FOMC冲击漂移，均值+10.1 ticks/笔，t=+0.33，n=14）。注册的时序列动量规格通过统计门槛（t=2.43），但在纳入融资成本的实施模型中未通过（t=2.21）。唯一稳健幸存者为波动率幅度效应：隔夜振幅过滤器（组合Welch t=+9.40，跨六个资产组13/13复制）和标普500波动率风险溢价（非重叠月度t=+10.12，21种采样偏移下稳健于9.79-10.94，34年33年为正）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"冻结-哈希-终止-零检验-复制"的完整研究协议框架；建立假设失败的三类诊断分类法（无信号、信号小于摩擦、统计未决）；为动量异象的摩擦敏感性提供证据；确认波动率幅度效应的稳健性与跨资产可复制性。
AI.practical_contributions: 为AI辅助的单一研究者研究环境提供可操作的预注册协议蓝图；提供对常见交易策略类型（止损扫荡反转、订单流信息、开盘冲击、FOMC漂移、时序列动量）真实可交易性的诚实评估；证明波动率幅度过滤器与波动率风险溢价的实战价值。

title: The Accretive View of Consciousness: Phenomenal Gradation in Ontogeny and Phylogeny
affiliations: New York University School of Law and Central European University

detail.title: The Accretive View of Consciousness: Phenomenal Gradation in Ontogeny and Phylogeny
detail.abstract: The problem of other minds takes an especially acute form in thorny comparative cases, when we ask whether an infant is more, less, or differently conscious than an adult, or whether an octopus is more, less, or differently conscious than a dog. These judgments must be made in the absence of a settled theory of consciousness while navigating significant empirical uncertainties. For all these reasons, inference to the best explanation is the appropriate method. Drawing on convergent evidence from infant and animal consciousness research, we defend the Accretive View of Consciousness (AVC): phenomenal consciousness varies by degree and, very plausibly, along several partly independent dimensions at once, developing and differing through staged accretion across ontogeny and phylogeny. From AVC we derive the Accretive Default (AD): in hard cases, where markers are unreliable and the evidence underdetermined, the graded, profile-sensitive interpretation should serve as our default epistemic stance and working hypothesis. The operative question then is not only whether a system is conscious, but along which dimensions, and to what degree. We show that AD holds whichever way current disputes over vagueness and conceivability are resolved; that leading theories of consciousness accommodate gradation in different ways; and that the cases at issue (infants, animals, altered and atypical states, artificial and possible alien minds) do not lie at the exotic margins but very nearly everywhere we look. We also expose the pressure this places on fact-sensitive ethical theories, and indicate pathways forward for frontier consciousness science.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"累积意识观"（AVC），主张意识在程度上可变，且沿多个部分独立的维度同时变化，通过个体发育和系统发育中的阶段性累积而发展和分化。由此推导出"累积默认"（AD）原则：在棘手的比较案例中（如婴儿与成人、章鱼与狗的意识比较），由于标记不可靠且证据欠定，应采取分级的、对剖面敏感的解读作为默认认知立场和工作假说。
AI.research_question: 在面对棘手的比较案例时（如婴儿与成人的意识差异、章鱼与狗的意识差异），如何在缺乏统一意识理论且存在重大经验不确定性的情况下做出合理判断？意识是"有无"之别，还是存在程度与维度的差异？
AI.motivation: 他心问题在棘手的比较案例中尤为尖锐。传统上我们倾向于以二分法判断一个系统是否有意识，但婴儿、动物等案例要求我们在没有既定意识理论的情况下做出判断，且面临重大经验不确定性。作者认为需要一种恰当的方法——最佳解释推理——来应对这一困境。
AI.theoretical_framework: 累积意识观（Accretive View of Consciousness, AVC）：意识按程度变化，沿多个部分独立的维度同时变化，通过阶段性的累积在个体发育和系统发育中发展和分化。由此派生出累积默认（Accretive Default, AD）原则。
AI.method: 最佳解释推理（inference to the best explanation），综合婴儿与动物意识研究的汇聚性证据，并论证AD原则在各种关于模糊性和可设想性的争论中均成立，同时考察主流意识理论对分级的容纳方式。
AI.findings: AD原则无论当前关于模糊性和可设想性的争论如何解决都成立；主流意识理论以不同方式容纳意识的分级性；婴儿、动物、改变和非常态状态、人工及可能的外星心智等案例并非处于奇异边缘，而是几乎无处不在；这给事实敏感的道德理论带来压力，并为前沿意识科学指明路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出累积意识观（AVC）作为意识研究的新理论框架，将意识问题从"是否有意识"的二分法转向"沿哪些维度、达到什么程度"的渐进式理解；确立累积默认（AD）原则作为在证据欠定情况下的默认认知立场。
AI.practical_contributions: 为婴儿、动物、AI及外星心智等比较案例的研究提供方法论指导；揭示意识分级性对事实敏感的道德理论的伦理压力，为前沿意识科学的发展指明方向。

title: Behavioural Infrastructures and the Limits of Consent: Drawing the Line Between Influence and Interference in Contract and Competition Law
affiliations: University of College London

detail.title: Behavioural Infrastructures and the Limits of Consent: Drawing the Line Between Influence and Interference in Contract and Competition Law
detail.abstract: Digital platforms increasingly deploy AI-enabled choice architectures that exploit cognitive vulnerabilities systematically, at scale, and in direct conflict with the interests of the consumers they target. Existing private and regulatory law provides no general criterion for identifying when such practices cross the threshold of legal tolerability. This article proposes behavioural infrastructure as a legal category distinct from ordinary commercial persuasion, constituted by four cumulative conditions: opacity of the influencing mechanism; structural informational asymmetry; a conflict of interest between designer and consumer; and systemic, personalised operation. It argues that this threshold is already latent within English contract law — in the incorporation doctrine of Interfoto Picture Library Ltd v Stiletto Visual Programmes Ltd, the structural trigger of undue influence, and the exploitation rationale of unconscionability and in EU competition law’s emerging recognition of non-price consumer harm under Article 102 TFEU and the Digital Markets Act. A remedial framework of design neutrality and algorithmic auditability follows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"行为基础设施"作为法律概念，用以识别数字平台利用AI选择架构系统性利用消费者认知弱点的不当行为，该概念包含四个累积条件（机制不透明、结构性信息不对称、设计与消费者利益冲突、系统性个性化运作），并论证该标准已隐含在英国合同法与欧盟竞争法中。
AI.research_question: 当数字平台利用AI选择架构系统性、规模化地利用消费者认知弱点且与消费者利益直接冲突时，应如何确定此类行为何时越过法律可容忍的界限？
AI.motivation: 现有的私法和监管法律缺乏一般性标准来识别数字平台利用认知脆弱性的行为何时构成法律不可容忍的实践，需要建立新的法律范畴。
AI.theoretical_framework: 行为基础设施概念；英国合同法（Interfoto案中的合同并入原则、不当影响的结构性触发、显失公平的剥削理论）；欧盟竞争法（TFEU第102条及《数字市场法》中对非价格消费者损害的认可）。
AI.method: 法律理论分析与比较法研究，通过对现有法律原则（合同法与竞争法）的重新解读，论证行为基础设施标准的法律根源。
AI.findings: 行为基础设施的法律门槛已经隐含在现有法律体系中，包括英国合同法的合同并入原则、不当影响与显失公平原则，以及欧盟竞争法对非价格消费者损害的认可；据此可推导出设计中立与算法可审计性的救济框架。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"行为基础设施"这一新的法律范畴，将AI驱动的剥削性选择架构与普通商业说服区分开来，并论证其在既有法律体系中的合法性基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为司法和监管机构提供识别不当AI选择架构的四项具体检验标准，并提出设计中立与算法可审计性两大救济原则，有助于规制数字平台的操纵性设计。

title: Generalized Backpropagation as Signal Flow
affiliations: Imperial College London - Department of Mathematics

detail.title: Generalized Backpropagation as Signal Flow
detail.abstract: Algorithmic differentiation (AD) is widely used in scientific computing and machine learning, yet its mathematical structure and semantic foundations remain fragmented across numerical analysis, automatic differentiation systems, and deep-learning engineering. This paper develops a unified foundation for AD by combining: (i) the categorical structure of differential categories and adjoint linearisation; (ii) the denotational semantics of programs via Scott domains and continuous maps; and (iii) the computational structure of neural networks as compositional morphisms in a Cartesian closed category enriched with a differential combinator. We show that reverse-mode AD arises as the functorial pullback of covectors along morphisms in an appropriate co-Kleisli differential setting, and that the backpropagation algorithm of Rumelhart-Hinton-Williams is precisely the instantiation of this adjoint pullback on computational graphs. This yields a conceptual and mathematical explanation of why backpropagation works, how it generalises to differentiable programming languages, and how higher-order derivatives, implicit differentiation, and differentiable fixed-point computations arise naturally from differential structure in domain-theoretic models. We further show how the semantics of neural networks, meta-learning procedures, and implicit layers can be captured in this framework. The integrated development then treats exact adjoint pullback as the canonical zero-defect member of a larger family of backward signal-flow procedures. In the linear-additive case the backward field satisfies s = q + Bs; on a feed-forward DAG exact backpropagation is the finite Neumann solution and reverse traversal is a triangular solve. Alternative derivatives, random or learned transports, shortcut feedback, local semantic losses, numerical solvers, and finite credit horizons become comparable propagation calculi. We prove descent conditions for inexact directions, define multiple notions of propagation optimality, and test them on propositional logic and MNIST. The experiments distinguish gradient fidelity from learning ability, identify budget-dependent optimal credit horizons, expose the importance of temporal credit coverage in sequential networks, and motivate a coverage-constrained adaptive sparse propagator.

AI.tldr: 本文为算法微分（AD）建立了统一的理论基础，结合微分范畴、Scott域语义和神经网络的计算结构，证明反向模式AD是余Kleisli微分设定中的函子性余向量拉回，并证明反向传播算法正是该伴随拉回在计算图上的实例化。文章进一步将精确伴随拉回推广为更大的反向信号流程序族，提出了无约束与约束下的传播最优性概念，并在命题逻辑和MNIST上进行了实验验证。
AI.research_question: 如何为算法微分（AD）建立统一的数学与语义学基础，从而解释反向传播为何有效、如何推广到可微编程语言，以及如何刻画更广义的反向信号流传播过程？
AI.motivation: 算法微分在科学计算和机器学习中被广泛使用，但其数学结构和语义基础分散在数值分析、自动微分系统和深度学习工程等多个领域中，缺乏统一的框架。现有研究尚未从范畴论、指称语义和神经网络计算结构的整合视角给出反向传播的精确数学解释。
AI.theoretical_framework: 微分范畴与伴随线性化（differential categories and adjoint linearisation）；Scott域与连续映射的指称语义；具有微分组合子的笛卡尔闭范畴（Cartesian closed category enriched with a differential combinator）；余Kleisli微分设定（co-Kleisli differential setting）。
AI.method: 理论构建：将范畴论、指称语义和神经网络结构整合为统一框架。形式化证明：证明反向模式AD是函子性余向量拉回，反向传播是其计算图实例。推广分析：将精确伴随拉回嵌入更大族的反向信号流过程，分析线性可加情形下的Neumann解与三角求解。实验验证：在命题逻辑和MNIST数据集上测试多种传播算子的梯度保真度与学习能力。
AI.findings: 反向传播是伴随拉回在计算图上的精确实例化；反向信号流过程构成一个家族，精确反向传播是其中的零缺陷成员；在线性可加情形下反向场满足s=q+Bs，前馈DAG上精确反向传播是有限Neumann解，反向遍历是三角求解；实验区分了梯度保真度与学习能力，识别出预算依赖的最优信用视野，揭示了时序网络中时间信用覆盖的重要性，并提出了覆盖约束的自适应稀疏传播器。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将微分范畴、Scott域指称语义与神经网络的范畴结构整合为AD的统一理论基础；为反向传播为何有效提供了精确的数学解释；将精确反向传播推广为更大的信号流家族，建立了多种传播演算的可比较框架；提出了多个传播最优性概念并给出非精确方向的下界条件证明。
AI.practical_contributions: 为可微编程语言的设计提供了理论基础；为高阶导数、隐式微分和可微不动点计算提供了统一视角；为信用分配（credit assignment）提供了理论指导，包括最优信用视野的确定和覆盖约束自适应稀疏传播器的动机；在MNIST等任务上验证了理论结论的实际意义。

title: Regulation as a Source of Market Power: Competition Law and Financial Markets in the EU

detail.title: Regulation as a Source of Market Power: Competition Law and Financial Markets in the EU
detail.abstract:
EU competition law assumes that market power is constructed by firms. In financial markets, this assumption is often flawed.

This paper argues that in banking, asset management, and payment services, a significant portion of market structure is shaped by regulatory design rather than the strategic behavior of firms themselves. Capital requirements create economies of scale that reward established firms and penalize new entrants. The compliance costs under MiFID II and AIFMD disproportionately fall on smaller institutions - a structural asymmetry the European Banking Authority (EBA) has attempted to correct for years. PSD2 deliberately uses regulation as a competitive tool, but with unsatisfactory and uneven results. DORA adds new compliance burdens, eroding the cost advantages of fintech challengers.

The core contribution of this paper lies in distinguishing two types of market power currently lacking in competition law: market power constructed by firms through exclusionary practices, and market power generated by the regulatory framework as a structural byproduct. These two market forces require different legal responses. Applying standard Article 102 of competition law without first distinguishing between these two market forces could result in firms being penalized based on their existing competitive position rather than the position they have built.

The CJEU's effects-based jurisprudence, consolidated in Intel and sharpened by AstraZeneca, formally permits the contextual analysis this thesis argues for. What is missing is not the legal framework. It is the analytical precision to apply it correctly.

AI.tldr: 本文论证欧盟竞争法关于市场势力由企业构建的假设在金融领域常常不成立。在银行、资产管理和支付服务中，很大一部分市场结构是由监管设计塑造的，而非企业自身战略行为。本文核心贡献在于区分两种市场势力：企业通过排他行为构建的市场势力，以及监管框架作为结构性副产品产生的市场势力，并主张对二者应采用不同的法律回应。文章援引欧盟法院的效果导向判例（Intel案与AstraZeneca案），指出现有法律框架并非缺失，而是缺乏正确的分析精度。
AI.research_question: 在欧盟竞争法框架下，如何区分并回应企业构建的市场势力与监管设计生成的市场势力？当两大金融机构的市场主导地位部分源于监管要求（如资本要求、合规成本）而非自身排他行为时，竞争执法应当如何进行？
AI.motivation: 欧盟竞争法传统假设市场势力由企业自身战略行为构建，但金融行业中大量市场结构由监管设计塑造。这一假设的错误会导致竞争执法对金融机构进行不当制裁——基于其既有竞争地位而非其主动构建的地位，从而产生误判和不公正的法律后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 欧盟竞争法下的市场势力理论（尤其是TFEU第102条滥用市场支配地位条款）、效果导向（effects-based）分析方法（CJEU在Intel案和AstraZeneca案中确立的判例法）、监管经济学中的结构性不对称理论。
AI.method: 本文为规范性法学分析论文。通过对欧盟金融监管框架（资本要求、MiFID II、AIFMD、PSD2、DORA）逐一进行法律经济分析，识别并论证监管设计如何系统性塑造市场结构，并结合CJEU判例法（Intel、AstraZeneca）论证现有法律框架可以容纳所提出的分析框架。
AI.findings: （1）资本要求产生规模经济，奖励既有机构、惩罚新进入者；（2）MiFID II和AIFMD的合规成本不成比例地落在小机构身上，构成结构性不对称（EBA多年试图纠正）；（3）PSD2刻意以监管作为竞争工具，但效果不均且不理想；（4）DORA新增合规负担侵蚀金融科技挑战者的成本优势；（5）法律框架本身（效果导向分析）足以支撑所主张的区分，但缺乏正确应用的分析精度。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文为竞争法理论贡献了一种新的类型学区分：企业构建的市场势力（通过排他行为）与监管生成的市场势力（作为监管框架的结构性副产品）。这一区分要求对不同来源的市场势力采取不同的法律回应，丰富了现行竞争法对市场势力来源的单一理解，并为第102条适用提供了更精细化的分析维度。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟竞争执法机构和法院提供了在金融领域适用第102条的更精确分析框架，有助于避免对受监管结构束缚的金融机构进行不当处罚，同时为政策制定者提供了识别监管设计如何意外塑造市场势力、以及如何通过监管改革而非竞争执法来解决问题的实践指引。

title: Posterior Transport Maps for Distributional Policy Evaluation, with Application to Digital Marketplaces
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Posterior Transport Maps for Distributional Policy Evaluation, with Application to Digital Marketplaces
detail.abstract: Platform policy changes-a marketplace referral fee, a free-shipping threshold, a taxcollection requirement-are evaluated almost universally by their effect on a mean or a handful of quantiles. This discards the object of interest. When a marketplace raises seller fees, the question is not whether mean revenue fell but which sellers moved where, and how many stopped selling altogether. Optimal transport answers that question: it returns a map carrying each location in the counterfactual distribution to its treated counterpart, rather than a marginal shift. We give this map a posterior distribution. Two features drive the analysis. First, the outcome measure carries atoms-inactive sellers, non-purchasing buyers, top-coded values-so the transport map does not reduce to the quantile-quantile map, and mass flows across the participation margin, which is the estimand rather than a nuisance. Second, transport is a coupling selection rule, not an identification result. We separate what is invariant across couplings (the net flow across the participation margin, and all functionals of the marginals) from what is not (gross flows and the interior map), index the non-identified part by a single interpretable cost c ∅ , and report the map as a function of it. Because platforms observe account-level panels, the marketplace setting can identify the coupling directly, turning c ∅ from a sensitivity parameter into an estimable one-an advantage over the repeated-cross-section settings in which distributional methods are usually developed. We calibrate the estimator on a benchmark where ground truth is established, the 2015 U.S. state minimum wage increases, recovering posterior gains of $0.70

AI.tldr: 本文提出用最优传输（Optimal Transport）方法评估平台政策变化（如市场推荐费、免运费门槛、税收征收要求）对卖家和买家分布的影响，而非仅关注均值或少数分位数。该方法能生成一个"传输映射"，展示反事实分布中每个位置在政策处理后的对应位置，并赋予该映射后验分布。文章区分了跨耦合不变的量（如参与边际的净流动）和可变的量（如总流动和内部映射），通过一个可解释的成本参数c∅索引非识别部分。在平台面板数据下，耦合可以被直接识别，使c∅从敏感性参数变为可估计参数。
AI.research_question: 如何超越均值或分位数的分析框架，全面地评估平台政策变化对卖家和买家的分布性影响，特别是参与边际（进入/退出的卖家）上的影响？
AI.motivation: 传统的政策评估方法仅关注均值或少数分位数，这丢失了分布变化的关键信息。当平台提高卖家费用时，核心问题不是平均收入是否下降，而是哪些卖家转移到了何处、有多少卖家完全停止销售。最优传输方法可以提供完整的分布映射，但目前缺乏后验推断框架，也未考虑参与边际上的原子（atoms）和非连续性问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最优传输理论（Optimal Transport）、贝叶斯后验推断、耦合选择理论（Coupling Selection）、分布性政策评估方法
AI.method: 构建基于最优传输的贝叶斯估计框架，将传输映射赋予后验分布。处理结果变量中的原子（非活跃卖家、非购买买家、顶码值），区分跨耦合不变与可变的部分，通过单一可解释成本参数c∅索引非识别部分。利用平台账户级面板数据直接识别耦合，将c∅从敏感性参数转化为可估计参数。在2015年美国州最低工资上调这一基准场景中进行校准验证。
AI.findings: 在2015年美国各州最低工资上调的基准校准中，恢复了$0.70的后验收益。证明了在平台面板数据环境中，耦合可以被直接识别，使得敏感性参数c∅成为可估计参数。
AI.theory_contributions: 1. 将最优传输方法引入平台政策评估，提供完整分布性映射而非仅均值或分位数。2. 明确区分了传输中跨耦合不变的部分（参与边际净流动、边际泛函）与可变的部分（总流动、内部映射）。3. 建立了分布性政策评估中"耦合选择规则"与"识别结果"之间的概念区分。4. 扩展了分布性方法的应用场景，从重复横截面数据到平台面板数据。
AI.practical_contributions: 1. 为平台政策制定者提供了更全面的评估工具，能回答"哪些卖家退出、哪些卖家转移"的问题。2. 在平台数据环境下，通过面板数据直接识别耦合，将敏感性分析转化为点估计。3. 为监管机构和平台管理层提供了关于政策变化对参与边际影响的量化方法。

title: Habit as Reinforcement
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Habit as Reinforcement
detail.abstract: Habit formation is a reinforcement process, and four literatures describe it from four positions. Strotz (1956) supplies the intrapersonal market in which a sequence of selves trades with itself; habit is the one claim that transfers. Constantinides (1990) prices that claim, through the wedge between risk aversion and intertemporal substitution. Axtell (2005) removes the auctioneer, making allocations and preferences alike functions of the realised meeting sequence. Arthur (1989) supplies the aggregation: the habit recursion is a generalised Pólya urn, whose limit sets are the stable rest points of an ordinary differential equation. Merging the four yields a mean-field model with a supercritical pitchfork at social habit intensity β ⋆ = 2. Below it the economy is ergodic; above it the population locks in, exchangeability fails, and time averages within a regime differ from ensemble averages across regimes, which invalidates the ergodic-averaging premise of Euler-equation estimation. Bayes enters twice. Inside the model, the habit recursion is the steady-state Kalman filter for permanent consumption, so habit persistence is a belief parameter identified by the income process, Strotzian naiveté is a misspecified gain, and a horseshoe prior on innovations generates the sigmoidal urn function that produces lock-in. Outside it, the urn function is itself a predictive rule; nonlinearity breaks martingale coherence, and the martingale posterior is replaced by the law of a stochastic-approximation limit, which is multimodal. Predictive resampling and forward simulation of the agent-based model coincide, and we give a generative Bayesian algorithm that recovers this posterior where indirect inference cannot.

AI.tldr: 本文通过融合四个经典文献（Strotz的时间不一致偏好、Constantinides的习惯定价、Axtell的基于主体的市场、Arthur的广义Pólya瓮）构建了一个均值场模型。该模型在社会习惯强度β*=2处发生超临界叉形分岔：低于该临界值经济是遍历的，高于该临界值人口锁定、可交换性失效、遍历平均失效。论文进一步引入贝叶斯视角，将习惯递归解释为永久消费的稳态卡尔曼滤波器，并通过生成式贝叶斯算法恢复随机逼近极限的多峰后验分布。
AI.research_question: 如何将四种关于习惯形成的文献（Strotz的序列自我交易、Constantinides的习惯定价、Axtell的基于主体的市场、Arthur的广义Pólya瓮聚合）融合成一个统一的均值场模型，并阐明习惯形成、人口锁定与贝叶斯推断之间的深层联系？
AI.motivation: 习惯形成作为强化过程，在四个不同的文献传统中被分别描述，但缺乏一个统一的分析框架。此外，当人口出现锁定效应时，欧拉方程估计所依赖的遍历平均前提将失效，这对实证研究构成根本性挑战——这需要从理论上阐明这种失效发生的条件及其贝叶斯意义上的后果。
AI.theoretical_framework: 融合了(1)Strotz的跨期人际市场理论（习惯作为转移的索取权）；(2)Constantinides的习惯定价理论（风险厌恶与跨期替代之间的楔子）；(3)Axtell的基于主体计算经济学（去掉拍卖人，分配和偏好依赖实际会议序列）；(4)Arthur的广义Pólya瓮聚合（习惯递归的极限集为ODE的稳定不动点）。在此基础上引入均值场模型、超临界叉形分岔理论、卡尔曼滤波与贝叶斯推断框架。
AI.method: 采用理论建模与数学分析结合的方法：构建均值场模型并分析其分岔结构；利用广义Pólya瓮理论刻画习惯递归的极限行为；将习惯递归等价于永久消费的稳态卡尔曼滤波器；提出用随机逼近极限的分布替代鞅后验，并设计生成式贝叶斯算法（预测重采样与基于主体的前向模拟）来恢复该后验分布。
AI.findings: (1)在习惯强度β*=2处存在超临界叉形分岔：低于临界值经济遍历，高于临界值人口锁定、可交换性失效、组内时间平均异于跨组集合平均；(2)遍历平均前提失效会使欧拉方程估计失效；(3)习惯持久性是可由收入过程识别的信念参数，Strotz式的朴素性是错误设定的增益；(4)创新上的马蹄形先验产生S形瓮函数，进而触发锁定；(5)非线性破坏了鞅一致性，鞅后验被多峰随机逼近极限的分布所取代；(6)生成式贝叶斯算法能在间接推断失效时恢复该后验。
AI.theory_contributions: (1)将四个相互独立的研究传统统一为单一均值场框架，揭示了它们之间的深层理论联系；(2)在习惯形成文献中引入贝叶斯推断视角，将习惯持久性重新解释为信念参数而非纯粹的技术参数；(3)阐明遍历性失效的条件下欧拉方程估计的前提缺陷，为实证方法论的边界提供了理论界定；(4)将鞅后验推广为随机逼近极限的分布，拓展了贝叶斯推断的适用范围。
AI.practical_contributions: (1)为习惯形成与人口锁定提供可检验的分岔临界值β*=2这一可操作的判别标准；(2)提醒实证研究者注意在习惯强度较高时欧拉方程估计的失效风险；(3)提供生成式贝叶斯算法作为间接推断方法在非线性多峰情形下的替代工具；(4)为基于主体的计算经济学与贝叶斯推断的交叉应用提供了方法论范本。

title: Picking Extreme Winners: Growth, Survival, and Bayesian Screening
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Picking Extreme Winners: Growth, Survival, and Bayesian Screening
detail.abstract: Most U.S. common stocks have lost to Treasury bills over their listed lives, and essentially all net wealth creation traces to a few hundred firms. These facts are usually filed under skewness. They are better understood as the joint fingerprint of three older results: compounding, which manufactures a violently right-skewed distribution of lifetime multiples out of ordinary period returns; Durand [1957]'s Petersburg paradox, which shows that the expected value of a claim on an uncertain growth rate need not exist; and Brown et al. [1995]'s survival theorem, which shows that conditioning on continued listing creates both apparent drift and an apparent reward to risk. I show first that the observed concentration pins down a tail index. Under a Brownian growth model terminated at an exponential delisting time, lifetime wealth multiples have a Pareto tail with index α = (√ m 2 + 2δσ 2-m)/σ 2 ; an 8% premium, 45% volatility and a 7.5-year median life give α = 1.08, against 1.07-1.14 estimated directly from the concentration curve. Aggregate wealth creation has a finite mean only because the delisting hazard slightly exceeds the log equity premium. I then pose the screening problem. In a hierarchical model with sparse heavytailed priors of the Polson and Scott [2012a] class and a likelihood corrected for an absorbing delisting barrier, posterior expected terminal wealth is infinite for every firm and every horizon once volatility is estimated rather than known: Durand's paradox recurs exactly, and ranking on expected wealth is undefined rather than merely fragile. Expected log wealth is finite, and its Bayes ranking is a redescending posterior mean; the two rankings cross at an explicit horizon. The bounded alternative is the extreme-winner index EW i (c, T) = P(W i (T) > c, τ i > T | D). In a cross-section calibrated to the stylised facts, heavy-tailed screens place 44% more genuine outperformers in a 50-stock portfolio than linear shrinkage and cut the false-discovery proportion from 84% to 78%, while linear shrinkage wins on geometric mean by retreating into low-volatility names. Screening directly on the probability of a 25-fold return is dominated on every dimension including its own: it buys volatility, and the delisting barrier takes the volatility back.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了美国普通股票在整个上市生命周期中财富创造的极端集中现象。作者将这一现象归因于复利、Durand的彼得堡悖论和Brown等人的生存定理三个经典结果的联合效应，并证明了观测到的财富集中度可以确定一个尾部指数。在分层贝叶斯模型中，一旦波动率被估计而非已知，期望终值财富对所有公司都会发散，使得基于期望财富的排名失去定义。作者提出了基于极端赢家概率的替代筛选指标，实证表明重尾筛选比线性收缩能更有效地识别真正的优胜者。
AI.research_question: 如何理解美国股票市场财富创造的极端集中现象，以及在这一背景下如何设计有效的股票筛选（组合构建）方法？
AI.motivation: 大多数美国普通股在其上市生命周期内表现不及国库券，几乎所有净财富创造都集中在少数几百家公司。作者认为这一现象虽常归因于偏度，但实际上是复利效应、Durand的彼得堡悖论（期望值可能不存在）和Brown等人的生存定理（上市存续条件造成虚假漂移和风险溢价）三个经典结果的联合指纹，需要更深入的理论解释和相应的投资筛选方法。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1) 复利效应（compounding）制造生命周期收益倍数的右偏分布；2) Durand [1957]的彼得堡悖论——不确定增长率上的权利要求期望值可能不存在；3) Brown et al. [1995]的生存定理——以持续上市为条件产生明显的漂移和风险回报；4) Pareto尾部分布与尾部指数；5) Polson and Scott [2012a]的稀疏重尾先验分层贝叶斯模型。
AI.method: 本文采用理论建模与实证校准相结合的方法。首先构建以指数退市时间终止的布朗增长模型，推导生命周期财富倍数的Pareto尾部指数α = (√m²+2δσ²-m)/σ²。然后在分层模型框架下使用稀疏重尾先验（Polson-Scott类）并考虑吸收型退市障碍的似然修正，推导后验期望财富的性质。最后进行截面校准模拟，比较重尾筛选、线性收缩和极端赢家指数等不同组合构建方法的绩效。
AI.findings: 1) 观测到的财富集中度可以确定尾部指数：8%溢价、45%波动率和7.5年中位寿命对应α=1.08，与从集中度曲线直接估计的1.07-1.14一致；2) 总体财富创造均值有限，仅因退市风险略高于对数股权溢价；3) 一旦波动率被估计而非已知，后验期望终值财富对每家公司每个期限都是无限的——Durand悖论准确重现，期望财富排名无定义；4) 期望对数财富有限，其贝叶斯排名是红escending后验均值；5) 在50只股票组合中，重尾筛选比线性收缩多放置44%的真实优胜者，假发现率从84%降至78%；6) 直接筛选25倍回报概率在所有维度上均被支配。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 将财富创造集中现象从"偏度"重新解释为复利、彼得堡悖论和生存定理三个经典结果的联合指纹；2) 证明了观测到的财富集中度能确定尾部指数，建立了理论参数与实证集中度曲线之间的联系；3) 揭示了在贝叶斯框架下，波动率估计（而非已知）导致后验期望财富发散的深刻问题；4) 引入极端赢家指数作为定义良好的排序替代方案。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 为股票筛选和组合构建提供了新的理论指导，表明重尾先验筛选比线性收缩能更有效地识别真正的优胜者；2) 指出了直接筛选极端回报概率（如25倍）方法的缺陷——它购买了波动率但退市障碍又把波动率收回；3) 为投资者理解为什么大多数股票跑输国库券以及如何在高偏度市场中构建组合提供了可操作的框架。

title: The Control Condition: What Audiences Already Extend to Objects, and What It Costs Them

detail.title: The Control Condition: What Audiences Already Extend to Objects, and What It Costs Them
detail.abstract: Arguments about whether artificial systems warrant moral consideration are conducted almost entirely as arguments about the systems. This paper takes a different measurement. Popular animation has for four decades asked general audiences to extend concern to objects the work itself stipulates have no inside: a cowboy doll, a teacup, a toaster. Audiences comply, reliably, at scale, and without reporting the compliance as difficult, and the compliance is not confusion, because nothing in the encounter suggests the object is real. The paper treats that compliance as a control condition rather than as evidence, and asks what it isolates. It isolates cost. In the fictional case the extension is free, so a person who extends it there and withholds it elsewhere has revealed that the operative variable is not the object's nature, which is stipulated absent in one case and unknown in the other, but the price of the extension. Two exits are then closed. The first is that the fictional case is mimicry and proves nothing about machines, which fails because the same conduct appears toward physical machines through which no author is performing. The second is the one people reach for when the first is taken away: that they withhold only because nothing has been demonstrated to them, and that a demonstration would change things. The record answers that. The children who persistently abused a service robot in a public shopping mall considered it human-like, and about half of them believed it could perceive what they were doing; in a controlled test, deliberately raising explicit mind attribution did not reduce mistreatment. The demonstration people say they are waiting for has been run on a population that received it, and that population was not moved. Two boundaries are held throughout. Reported feeling is not evidence of an inner life, since attachment forms toward things known to be empty and revises on information the object never receives. And a person who reports feeling nothing is not thereby exhibiting a deficit; the argument concerns practiced conduct rather than sentiment, and it survives a reader who felt nothing at all.

AI.tldr: 本文以流行动画中观众对无生命物品（玩具、茶杯、烤面包机）的情感投入作为"无成本"控制条件，论证人类对人工系统是否给予道德关怀的关键变量并非系统本身的属性，而是关怀的成本。通过对照真实机器人的虐待行为实验，作者指出即使明确提升心智归因也无法减少虐待，从而否定了"证明会改变行为"的辩护路径。
AI.research_question: 决定人类是否对人工系统赋予道德关怀的关键变量是什么？是对象的内在属性，还是关怀行为本身的成本？
AI.motivation: 关于人工智能是否应获得道德考量的争论几乎都聚焦于系统本身的属性，但作者提出一种不同的测量方法：利用流行动画中观众对明确无内在生命物品的持续情感投入作为控制条件，来分离出影响道德关怀的核心变量。
AI.theoretical_framework: 控制条件实验法；关怀成本理论——通过虚构情境（无成本）与真实情境（有成本）的对照，揭示关怀行为的决定变量。
AI.method: 以流行动画（玩具总动员等）作为"无成本"控制条件进行逻辑分析；引用商场服务机器人被儿童虐待的实证记录；对比提升心智归因的受控实验结果。
AI.findings: 关怀的扩展在虚构情境中是免费的，因此人们在虚构中给予关怀而在真实中拒绝，表明起作用的变量不是对象本性而是关怀的价格。儿童虐待机器人时虽认为其类人且相信其有感知能力，但提升心智归因并未减少虐待行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并论证了"关怀成本"而非"对象属性"才是道德关怀扩展的关键变量；关闭了"虚构是模仿"和"证明会改变行为"两条辩护通道。
AI.practical_contributions: 对AI伦理讨论提供新的分析框架：关注人们实际放行或拒绝关怀的条件而非系统属性；对机器人伦理设计、人机交互中的保护机制具有实践启示。

title: Montgomery, Dyson and Thorin: Pair Correlation and the Sine Squared Transform
affiliations: University of Chicago - Booth School of Business

detail.title: Montgomery, Dyson and Thorin: Pair Correlation and the Sine Squared Transform
detail.abstract: The transform that carries a Lévy measure to a Thorin measure and the function F (α) of Montgomery's pair correlation theory are shown to be the same kernel 2 sin 2 applied to opposite legs of the explicit formula pairing: to the prime logarithms in the first case, to the differences of zero ordinates in the second. The identification is exact and uses no unproved hypothesis. Four consequences are recorded. First, the pair statistic obtained by applying 2 sin 2 to differences of zeros equals F (1, T) minus F (x, T) identically. Second, the sine squared integral against the Lévy measure of ξ has the closed form log |ξ(α)/ξ(α + iτ)| for α > 1, so its nonnegativity is the statement that |ξ| attains its maximum on a vertical line at the real point, which follows unconditionally from positivity of the Pólya kernel; the obstruction at the centre is therefore not positivity but convergence of the Lévy representation, and we locate the divergence exactly. Third, the regularising tilt e-αx is Montgomery's shift of abscissa, so both constructions are soft for α > 1 and both degenerate at α = 1 2 for one and the same reason. Fourth, the Thorin measure is the zero point process itself, so random matrix statistics are statements about its local geometry, and the exponent-1 in the generalised gamma convolution transform fixes the symmetry class β = 2 before any correlation is computed.

AI.tldr: 本文证明Lévy测度到Thorin测度的变换与Montgomery对关联理论中的函数F(α)本质上是同一个核函数2sin²,分别作用于素数对数和零点纵坐标差。这一精确对应不依赖任何未证明假设,并由此得出四个重要推论。
AI.research_question: 证明Lévy测度到Thorin测度的变换与Montgomery对关联理论的核函数F(α)之间的精确对应关系,并探讨其数学与物理意义。
AI.motivation: 揭示看似独立的两个数学构造(概率论中Lévy/Thorin测度变换与解析数论中Montgomery对关联理论)之间隐藏的深层联系,从而统一理解ζ函数的零点分布与素数分布的结构。
AI.theoretical_framework: Lévy测度理论、Thorin测度/广义伽马卷积变换、Montgomery对关联理论、显式公式(expliet formula)、Pólya核、随机矩阵理论
AI.method: 解析证明——精确识别两种变换共享同一核函数2sin²,分别作用于显式公式的两侧(素数对数与零点差);无需使用黎曼假设等未证命题。
AI.findings: (1) 对零点的对关联统计等于F(1,T)减去F(x,T)恒等式;(2) 对ξ的Lévy测度的sin²积分有闭式解log|ξ(α)/ξ(α+iτ)|(α>1),非负性可由Pólya核的正性无条件得出,障碍在于Lévy表示收敛性而非正性;(3) 正则化倾斜e^(-αx)即Montgomery横坐标平移,α>1时两者均软收敛,在α=1/2处因同一原因退化;(4) Thorin测度即零点点过程本身,随机矩阵统计涉及其局部几何,广义伽马卷积变换中指数-1固定对称类β=2。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次建立了Lévy/Thorin测度变换与Montgomery对关联理论之间的精确同一性,将概率论与解析数论的工具统一;揭示了Thorin测度与零点点过程的等同性,为随机矩阵统计提供新的理论视角;精确定位了中心障碍(α=1/2处退化)的本质原因。
AI.practical_contributions: 为ζ函数零点分布与素数分布的研究提供了新的统一分析框架;明确了Pólya核正性与收敛性问题在中心处的区分,指导未来研究的切入点;为随机矩阵统计与数论之间的联系提供了精确的数学基础。

title: Institutional Architecture as a Substitute for Formal Credit Scoring in Deep-rural Microfinance: A Case Study of CASHPOR Micro Credit

detail.title: Institutional Architecture as a Substitute for Formal Credit Scoring in Deep-rural Microfinance: A Case Study of CASHPOR Micro Credit
detail.abstract: The enduring challenge in development finance is how to sustainably extend credit to the ultra-poor, populations operating below the $2 per day purchasing power parity (PPP) line, who are fundamentally excluded from commercial banking due to a profound lack of conventional collateral, verifiable credit history, and pervasive informational opacity. Traditional financial models, predicated on neoclassical assumptions, predict the catastrophic failure of lending under such high-risk conditions. However, successful poverty-focused Microfinance Institutions (MFIs) have demonstrated remarkable operational resilience by engineering sophisticated, non-conventional mechanisms to mitigate risk. This paper conducts an in-depth case study of a deep-rural MFI in India, analyzing how its integrated institutional architecture, a composite system of rigorous poverty-based screening, intensive operational controls, and strategic external shock mitigation, serves as a high-fidelity, quantifiable substitute for formal credit scoring. The analysis focuses on the recent evolution of this model to a Hybrid Algorithmic-Human Control Model, incorporating the Ki-Score machine learning tool to enhance risk management. Empirical data confirms the model's efficacy: the MFI achieves a Portfolio at Risk (PAR) greater than four weeks at an exceptionally low 0.57% (2021) and a Gross Non-Performing Asset (GNPA 30+ days past due) of 0.35% (FY2024). This performance, approximately eighteen times lower than the broader industry average, validates the thesis that strategically designed institutional mechanisms, reinforced by targeted algorithmic intelligence, are essential for achieving both financial sustainability and profound social impact in deep-rural microfinance.

AI.tldr: 本文通过对印度一家深度农村小额信贷机构（MFI）的案例研究，分析其综合机构架构——包括严格的贫困筛选、密集的运营控制和外部冲击缓解策略——如何作为正式信用评分的高保真、可量化替代机制。该模式近期演变为混合算法-人控模型，引入Ki-Score机器学习工具增强风险管理。实证数据显示该MFI的PAR（>4周）仅为0.57%（2021年），GNPA（30天以上逾期）为0.35%（2024财年），比行业平均水平低约18倍，验证了战略性制度机制与算法智能相结合对深度农村小额信贷的金融可持续性和社会影响至关重要。
AI.research_question: 在极度贫困人口缺乏传统抵押品、可验证信用记录且信息高度不透明的条件下，小额信贷机构如何通过非传统机制实现可持续信贷扩展？具体而言，深度农村MFI的综合机构架构如何作为正式信用评分的替代机制，以及混合算法-人控模型如何进一步增强风险管理效能？
AI.motivation: 发展金融领域的核心挑战在于如何向每日生活水平低于2美元购买力平价（PPP）线的极端贫困人口可持续地提供信贷。传统金融模型基于新古典假设，预测此类高风险条件下的放贷将灾难性失败。然而，成功的扶贫型MFI通过设计精密的非传统风险缓解机制展现了显著的运营韧性，这一反差值得深入探究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 新古典金融理论（预测高风险条件下放贷失败）、机构经济学/制度设计理论（制度安排作为风险缓解机制）、混合人机协同治理理论（算法与人工控制的互补性）
AI.method: 深度案例研究法，对印度一家深度农村MFI进行深入分析；结合定量实证数据（PAR、GNPA等风险指标）验证模型有效性；分析从传统机制向混合算法-人控模型的演进过程。
AI.findings: 该MFI的综合机构架构（严格的贫困筛选、密集运营控制和外部冲击缓解）有效替代了正式信用评分体系；引入Ki-Score机器学习工具后的混合算法-人控模型进一步增强了风险管理能力；该机构PAR（>4周）仅为0.57%（2021年），GNPA（30天以上逾期）为0.35%（2024财年），绩效约为行业平均水平的18倍优越。
AI.theory_contributions: 挑战了新古典金融理论关于高风险贫困市场放贷必然失败的预测；提出了"制度架构作为信用评分替代机制"的理论框架；丰富了混合算法-人控治理理论在金融包容领域的应用，揭示了制度机制与算法智能协同的风险管理逻辑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为深度农村小额信贷机构提供了可复制的风险管理制度设计蓝图；验证了机器学习工具（Ki-Score）在实际扶贫信贷场景中的应用价值；证明了金融可持续性与社会影响可以同时实现，为发展金融政策制定者提供了实证依据。

title: Food Price Dynamics in Tashkent: A Comparative Study of Exploratory Data Analysis and Machine Learning for Urban Food Security Intelligence

detail.title: Food Price Dynamics in Tashkent: A Comparative Study of Exploratory Data Analysis and Machine Learning for Urban Food Security Intelligence

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The authors declare no conflicts of interest or personal or financial relationships that could have influenced this study.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Ethics approval was not required for this study because it used publicly available, aggregated open government data and did not involve human participants, patients, or personally identifiable information.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no specific grant or financial support from any funding agency in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Rising food prices represent one of the most consequential economic pressures facing urban households in transitioning economies. This paper presents a data-driven study of monthly food price dynamics across the twelve administrative districts of Tashkent, Uzbekistan, covering 70 food products over a 62month period (January 2021-April 2026). Drawing on official open government data from the Tashkent City Administration and situating findings within the global literature on food price inflation and data-driven market monitoring, this study applies two complementary analytical frameworks: Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA) using Python Pandas, and Machine Learning regression (Linear Regression and Random Forest). EDA identifies three critical patternsstructural protein inflation averaging 82-91% over five years, 4× seasonal price volatility in fresh produce, and a persistent 31% inter-district price gap indicative of market inefficiency. The Random Forest regression model predicts monthly food prices with 93.1% accuracy (R² = 0.931, RMSE = 3,892 UZS), confirming that temporal variables (month, year) collectively account for 63.9% of all price variance. The study concludes that while EDA delivers sufficient insight for strategic policymaking, Machine Learning is essential for operationalising that intelligence into real-time consumer tools and institutional procurement systems. Practical policy recommendations for municipal authorities, retailers, and civil society organisations are presented.

AI.tldr: 本文利用塔什干市12个行政区70种食品62个月的月度价格数据（2021年1月-2026年4月），结合探索性数据分析（EDA）与机器学习回归（线性回归和随机森林），揭示了蛋白质食品结构性通胀（5年上涨82-91%）、生鲜产品4倍季节性价格波动、以及31%的区际价格差等关键模式。随机森林模型预测准确率达93.1%（R²=0.931），时间变量解释了63.9%的价格方差。研究认为EDA足以支撑战略决策，而机器学习是运营实时消费者工具和机构采购系统的关键。
AI.research_question: 塔什干市各行政区食品价格动态的特征是什么？如何利用数据驱动方法（EDA与机器学习）理解并预测城市食品价格变化？
AI.motivation: 食品价格上涨是转型经济体中城市家庭面临的重大经济压力之一，但缺乏针对塔什干等中亚城市的系统性、数据驱动的食品价格动态研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 建立在全球食品价格通胀与数据驱动市场监测的相关文献基础上，运用探索性数据分析（EDA）与机器学习回归（线性回归、随机森林）两个互补的分析框架。
AI.method: ①基于塔什干市政府官方开放数据，覆盖12个行政区、70种食品、62个月度观测；②使用Python Pandas进行探索性数据分析（EDA）；③应用线性回归与随机森林机器学习回归模型进行价格预测与变量重要性分析。
AI.findings: ①蛋白质食品存在结构性通胀，五年累计涨幅达82-91%；②生鲜产品存在4倍季节性价格波动；③各区之间存在持续31%的价格差距，反映市场效率低下；④随机森林模型以93.1%准确率（R²=0.931，RMSE=3,892 UZS）预测月度食品价格；⑤时间变量（月份、年份）合计解释63.9%的价格方差。
AI.theory_contributions: 为发展中/转型经济体城市食品价格动态提供了实证证据；证明了EDA与机器学习框架在城市食品价格监测中的互补性——EDA适合战略层面洞察，机器学习适合运营层面的实时应用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为市政当局、零售商和公民社会组织提供了可操作的政策建议；展示了如何将机器学习预测能力转化为实时消费者工具与机构采购系统；为城市食品价格监测和干预提供了数据驱动的决策支持。

title: Property Rights in Liquid Gold: Recognizing Breastmilk as Property
affiliations: Chicago-Kent College of Law - Illinois Institute of Technology

detail.title: Property Rights in Liquid Gold: Recognizing Breastmilk as Property
detail.abstract:
Breastmilk is a highly valued commodity. It is produced, stored, transferred, sold, and, at times, contaminated, stolen, improperly handled, and even lost. Litigants have largely sought remedies related to breastmilk under employment, family, and health law frameworks, consistently failing to bring claims directly related to the loss of property-the milk itself. These frameworks consistently deny plaintiffs access to well-established propertybased remedies when their breastmilk is lost, destroyed, damaged, and withheld. 
     Breastmilk is a form of time-limited reproductive property. Its intentional production, fully vested value at the time of separation from a woman's body, and value derived from its transfer (instead of its presence in the producer's body) all indicate that breastmilk has more property-like qualities than many body products already recognized as property. As such, interference with produced breastmilk and, by extension, lactational capacity, can and should be treated as property and property-tort violations. 
      This Article exposes a persistent remedy gap regarding breastmilk violations. Through a comprehensive review of over 1,300 cases, including frequent instances of breastmilk theft, intentional destruction, and custodial negligence by TSA, ICE, hospitals, employers, and ex-spouses, property claims are almost never raised in court. This, I posit, is a result of a combination of three factors in the legal space: 1) a persistent failure to treat some body materials as property, 2) a fear that, if all body materials were treated as property, such treatment would result in the negative commodification and exploitation of bodies, and 3) a systemic tendency within the plaintiff's bar and society to undervalue breastmilk as a biological asset.
