AI.research_question: 如何在受监管的金融市场中，实现将数据血缘控制嵌入基础设施层，从而弥合数据血缘控制与业务处理流程之间的脱节？
AI.motivation: 受监管金融市场中，数据管道设计以效率为导向而非来源验证，导致数据血缘控制与实际业务流程处理之间存在脱节，难以满足审计与合规要求。
AI.theoretical_framework: 数据血缘基础设施框架（DLIF, Data Lineage Infrastructure Framework）
AI.method: 基于DLIF构建框架，包含记录级来源追踪、转换链映射、基于哈希的完整性校验以及审计合规查询接口四个核心组件，并在敏感金融数据处理系统上进行了工程部署与实证验证。
AI.findings: 该框架使审计数据请求响应时间降低65%，并支持对数据来源、转换过程和验证结果进行机器可验证的追踪。
AI.theory_contributions: 开创了将数据血缘实现嵌入基础设施层的技术路径，为数据血缘与业务流程的融合提供了理论框架支撑。
AI.practical_contributions: 为受监管金融行业提供了可落地的数据血缘工程建设方案，显著提升了审计数据请求的响应效率，增强了数据治理与合规能力。

title: Trust Residuals for Navigation QR Codes: Decision Semantics for Issuer, Destination, and Runtime Safety State

detail.title: Trust Residuals for Navigation QR Codes: Decision Semantics for Issuer, Destination, and Runtime Safety State

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing interests. Generative AI tools were used during the research.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This manuscript presents a conceptual framework and a software-based evaluation. It did not involve human participants, patient data, or experimental interventions, and no ethics approval was required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract:
Navigation QR codes are widely used to initiate web, payment, ordering, institutional, and identity-adjacent workflows, yet mainstream scanner behavior is still largely centered on payload decoding and link handoff rather than trust verification. In earlier work, El-Masri argued that navigation QR security is not primarily a cryptography problem because signed payloads, certificate checks, and HTTPS transport are necessary but insufficient to establish issuer legitimacy, continued destination authorization, or present-time destination safety [1]. This paper operationalizes that trust-model view by defining a residual decision semantics for navigation QR codes.

The proposed framework models QR verification as evaluation of a vector of trust residuals: issuer-chain residuals, destination-policy residuals, redirect-flow residuals, runtime-safety residuals, freshness residuals, and artifact-integrity residuals. A scanner or verifier maps those residuals through explicit precedence rules to bounded user-visible states such as unverified, signed unaccepted issuer, verified issuer, verified issuer destination risky, and blocked. The framework also states security invariants that prevent reputation, HTTPS, or runtime-safety signals from upgrading an otherwise untrusted issuer path.

The contribution is not a new QR symbology, cryptographic primitive, or phishing classifier. It is a protocol-informed decision layer that connects managed issuer trust, destination authorization, redirect behavior, runtime risk, cache freshness, and artifact inspection into a machine-checkable scanner decision. The paper concludes with a reference implementation architecture and a controlled-corpus conformance evaluation realized by a companion proof of concept: a 37-case machine-checked corpus on which the residual verifier matches every expected outcome with zero unsafe positives and zero attention undercuts, while decode-only, HTTPS-only, signature-only, and reputation-only baselines either assert positive trust where the expected outcome forbids it or demand strictly less user attention than required, at measured rates.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种导航二维码的信任模型操作化框架，将二维码验证定义为信任残差向量的评估，通过明确的优先级规则映射到有界的用户可见状态，并定义了安全不变量以防止声誉、HTTPS或运行时安全信号提升不受信任的发行者路径。
AI.research_question: 如何将导航二维码的信任模型操作化为可机器检查的扫描器决策语义？
AI.motivation: 主流二维码扫描器的行为仍主要集中于载荷解码和链接交接，而非信任验证；密码学手段（签名、证书、HTTPS）不足以确立发行者合法性、持续目的地授权或当前目的地安全性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于El-Masri先前提出的信任模型观点，将二维码验证建模为信任残差向量（发行者链、目的地策略、重定向流、运行时安全、新鲜度、工件完整性）的评估，并通过优先级规则和安全不变量进行约束。
AI.method: 定义残差决策语义框架；提出参考实现架构；通过伴随概念验证进行受控语料库一致性评估（37个机器检查案例）。
AI.findings: 残差验证器在37个案例中与每个预期结果匹配，零不安全正例且零注意力削弱；而仅解码、仅HTTPS、仅签名和仅声誉的基线要么在预期结果禁止的情况下断言正信任，要么要求的用户注意力严格少于所需。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了导航二维码的协议知情决策层，将托管发行者信任、目的地授权、重定向行为、运行时风险、缓存新鲜度和工件检查连接为可机器检查的扫描器决策；定义了防止信任升级的安全不变量。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了参考实现架构和伴随概念验证，可用于构建更安全的二维码扫描器；贡献了37个机器检查案例的受控语料库，可供后续验证和测试使用。

title: Course-Based Competency and Certification Exam Performance: An Assessment Alignment Study of Working Adult Learners at a Hispanic-Serving Community College

detail.title: Course-Based Competency and Certification Exam Performance: An Assessment Alignment Study of Working Adult Learners at a Hispanic-Serving Community College
detail.abstract: Vendor certification examinations are widely used as outcome measures in community college IT programs, yet little is known about whether these examinations validly represent the competencies of nontraditional working adult learners. This practitioner case study examines the alignment between course-based academic performance and external certification examination outcomes across four IT courses at Central New Mexico Community College (CNM), a Hispanic-Serving Institution in Albuquerque, New Mexico, involving 32 active students during the Spring 2026 semester. A consistent divergence was observed: students demonstrated strong course-based performance and engagement while producing variable certification examination results. AWS Cloud Practitioner yielded a 56% first attempt pass rate, CompTIA A+ Software 75%, and CompTIA A+ Hardware 29% despite strong course engagement across all pathways. Overall course retention was 96.8% and completion 81.25%, providing contextual evidence of active student engagement. The divergence between course-based and certification-based outcomes is interpreted as a potential misalignment between iterative competency-based classroom assessment and standardized, time-constrained credentialing formats for working adult learners in HSI contexts. This study is a single-instructor, single-semester descriptive case study without a control group. It does not evaluate instructional effectiveness or claim causal inference. It contributes an observational account of assessment divergence grounded in adult learning theory, competency-based education, and assessment validity frameworks, generating hypotheses for future multi-site research on certification equity for nontraditional learners.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过一项实践者案例研究，考察了新墨西哥中央社区学院（CNM）四门IT课程中，基于课程的学习表现与外部认证考试结果之间的差异。研究发现，尽管学生课程参与度和课程成绩表现优异（保留率96.8%，完成率81.25%），但认证考试通过率参差不齐（AWS云从业者56%、CompTIA A+软件75%、CompTIA A+硬件29%），提示标准化的、限时的认证考试可能与针对工作成人学习者设计的迭代式能力本位课堂评估之间存在潜在错位。
AI.research_question: 社区学院IT项目中，非传统工作成人学习者的课程学业表现与外部认证考试结果之间是否存在一致性或错位？
AI.motivation: 供应商认证考试被广泛用作社区学院IT项目的成果衡量标准，但关于这些考试是否有效代表非传统工作成人学习者能力的研究甚少，尤其缺乏在西班牙裔服务机构（HSI）背景下的实证证据。
AI.theoretical_framework: 成人学习理论、能力本位教育（CBE）、评估效度框架
AI.method: 实践者案例研究（descriptive case study），以新墨西哥中央社区学院（CNM）四门IT课程为对象，涉及2026年春季学期32名活跃学生，对比课程学术表现与外部认证考试结果，无对照组，单教师单学期。
AI.findings: 学生课程表现和参与度强，但认证考试结果差异显著：AWS云从业者首次通过率56%、CompTIA A+软件75%、CompTIA A+硬件29%；课程保留率96.8%、完成率81.25%。课程表现与认证结果之间存在一致性的分歧。
AI.theory_contributions: 基于成人学习理论、能力本位教育和评估效度框架，提供了关于课堂评估与标准化认证评估之间错位的观察性记录，为未来多站点关于非传统学习者认证公平性的研究生成假设。
AI.practical_contributions: 为社区学院IT教育工作者和政策制定者提供实证参考，提示在HSI背景下需关注标准化认证考试对工作成人学习者的公平性议题，并推动对课程评估与认证评估对齐方式的反思。

title: Subsidizing Presence: Gendered Incentives and the Commodification of Consumers as Market Infrastructure
affiliations: M² Educational Initiative

detail.title: Subsidizing Presence: Gendered Incentives and the Commodification of Consumers as Market Infrastructure

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that he has no known competing financial interests or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual article and did not involve human participants, personal data, patient data, or experimental interventions; therefore, ethics approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding and was conducted independently by the author.

detail.abstract: Some firms do not subsidize a consumer group to sell more to that group. They do so because the group's visible presence makes the market more valuable to others. This article names that arrangement consumer-as-market-infrastructure. It develops four linked constructs: subsidized presence, audience engineering, presence externalities, and transactional opacity. The model traces how a targeted incentive changes audience composition, how that composition shapes entry, retention, and spending, and how the firm captures the resulting cross-consumer value. Gendered incentives provide the principal application because market design can assign visibility and relational value to one group while assigning payment and status display to another. Ten propositions, a five-part ethical test, and a multi-method research agenda distinguish legitimate coordination from opaque consumer commodification.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"消费者作为市场基础设施"（consumer-as-market-infrastructure）这一概念，解释为何某些企业会选择补贴特定消费者群体（如女性）——并非为了直接向该群体销售更多，而是因为该群体的可见存在使整个市场对其他消费者更具价值。文章构建了四个相互关联的构念（补贴存在、受众工程、存在外部性和交易不透明性），并提出十个命题、一个五部分伦理测试和多方法研究议程。
AI.research_question: 为什么企业会补贴某些消费者群体而不直接向他们销售更多？这种补贴安排如何运作，其机制和伦理边界是什么？
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注企业如何直接向目标消费者销售，但对"补贴一个群体以间接提升市场对其他群体的价值"这一策略缺乏系统理论解释。尤其在性别化激励的背景下，这种安排可能涉及伦理问题，需要理论框架来区分合法协调与不透明的消费者商品化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 消费者作为市场基础设施理论，包含四个核心构念：补贴存在（subsidized presence）、受众工程（audience engineering）、存在外部性（presence externalities）和交易不透明性（transactional opacity）。
AI.method: 理论建构与概念发展方法，提出四个构念、十个命题、一个五部分伦理测试以及多方法研究议程。
AI.findings: 模型追踪了定向激励如何改变受众构成，受众构成如何影响顾客进入、留存和消费，以及企业如何捕获由此产生的跨消费者价值。在性别化激励的典型应用中，市场设计可以将可见性和关系价值分配给一个群体（如女性），而将支付和地位展示分配给另一群体（如男性）。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"消费者作为市场基础设施"这一新概念，系统化阐述了补贴存在、受众工程、存在外部性和交易不透明性四个构念，构建了一个解释企业如何通过补贴一个群体来服务另一个群体的理论框架，并区分了合法协调与伦理上有问题的消费者商品化。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了五部分伦理测试来帮助企业和管理者评估此类补贴安排的正当性，并提出了多方法研究议程以指导未来的实证研究。

title: The Influence of Social Media Influencer Credibility and Attractiveness on Brand Trust and Purchase Intention in the Food & Beverage Industry

detail.title: The Influence of Social Media Influencer Credibility and Attractiveness on Brand Trust and Purchase Intention in the Food & Beverage Industry
detail.abstract: Social media influencers have now become key players in influencing consumers' choices in the food and beverage (F&B) industry, especially among members of Generation Z. The present study looks at how influencer credibility (that is, their expertise and trustworthiness) and influencer attractiveness impact brand trust, and it also examines how these factors together affect consumers' intention to make a purchase and their loyalty towards F&B brands that are endorsed by influencers. Data were gathered using a structured online survey (N = 100), of which 70 respondents who regularly follow F&B influencers completed the full Likert scale section. Reliability analysis demonstrated good internal consistency for all the constructs (Cronbach's α = 0.835-0.891). Pearson correlation indicated strong, significant positive relationships between all the constructs (r = 0.757-0.834, p < .001). Multiple regression analysis found that both influencer credibility and attractiveness significantly predict brand trust (R² = 0.763), and that credibility and brand trust but not attractiveness have a direct and significant effect on purchase intention and loyalty (R² = 0.749). The results support the Source Credibility Model (Ohanian, 1990) in the context of food and beverage marketing and indicate that F&B brands should focus on forming partnerships with influencers who are credible and trustworthy rather than simply those who are visually attractive in order to establish strong brand trust and consumer loyalty.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨社交媒体影响者（网红）的可信度（专业性和可信赖性）与吸引力如何影响食品饮料（F&B）行业的品牌信任，进而影响Z世代消费者的购买意愿和品牌忠诚度。通过100份在线调查问卷（其中70份完整有效），采用相关分析和多元回归分析发现：影响者可信度和吸引力均显著预测品牌信任（R²=0.763），但购买意愿和忠诚度主要由可信度和品牌信任驱动（R²=0.749），吸引力无直接显著影响。研究支持Ohanian（1990）来源可信度模型，建议F&B品牌应优先选择可信赖的影响者而非仅具视觉吸引力的网红。
AI.research_question: 影响者可信度（专业性与可信赖性）和吸引力如何影响品牌信任，以及这些因素如何共同影响消费者对F&B品牌的购买意愿和忠诚度？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体影响者已成为影响F&B行业消费者选择的关键角色，尤其在Z世代群体中，但现有研究对这一情境下影响者特质如何作用于品牌信任、购买意愿和忠诚度的机制尚缺乏系统检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 来源可信度模型（Source Credibility Model, Ohanian, 1990），涵盖影响者专业性、可信赖性与吸引力三个维度。
AI.method: 采用结构化在线问卷调查（N=100，有效样本70份），通过可靠性分析（Cronbach's α = 0.835-0.891）、Pearson相关分析（r = 0.757-0.834）和多元回归分析进行假设检验。
AI.findings: （1）影响者可信度和吸引力均显著预测品牌信任（R²=0.763）；（2）影响者可信度与品牌信任对购买意愿和忠诚度有直接显著影响，而吸引力无直接显著效应（R²=0.749）；（3）所有构念间呈显著正相关（p<.001）。
AI.theory_contributions: 在F&B营销情境下实证支持了来源可信度模型，明确区分了影响者吸引力与可信度在品牌信任和消费者行为结果中的差异化作用机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 为F&B品牌提供影响者合作筛选策略的实践指导：优先选择专业、可信赖的影响者而非仅具视觉吸引力的网红，以建立更强的品牌信任和消费者忠诚度。

title: Which Skills Matter, How They Affect Performance, and How They Are Valued: Evidence from Professional Soccer

detail.title: Which Skills Matter, How They Affect Performance, and How They Are Valued: Evidence from Professional Soccer
detail.abstract: This paper measures distinct worker abilities and examines how these abilities relate to organizational performance and market valuation, using professional soccer as a setting where individual productivity can be directly observed. I construct attacking, midfield, defensive and goalkeeping skill indices through a structured dimension-reduction procedure that combines the process of filtering out irrelevant variables with factor analysis using PCA extraction applied to high-dimensional performance data from the "Big Five" European leagues (2018-2024). Linking these skill measures to club outcomes and transfer fees, I find that defensive ability has the strongest impact on team performance, with an effect 1.85 times larger than that of attacking skill. However, attacking ability is valued 1.7 times more highly in the transfer market than defensive skill. To separate causal skill contributions from unobserved complementarities in team production, I use injury-induced absences of core players as an instrument for performance; and to mitigate concerns that transfer valuations reflect short-lived form rather than underlying ability, I use lagged skill as an instrument.

AI.tldr: 本文利用欧洲五大联赛（2018-2024）的高维球员表现数据，通过结构化降维程序构建进攻、中场、防守和守门员技能指数，研究发现防守能力对球队绩效的影响最强（是进攻技能的1.85倍），但转会市场对进攻能力的估值却比防守技能高1.7倍。为分离因果关系，作者使用伤病缺席作为工具变量，并用滞后技能缓解转会估值的短期状态偏差。
AI.research_question: 不同类型的球员能力（进攻、中场、防守、守门）如何影响组织绩效和市场估值？这些能力在直接影响与市场定价之间是否存在系统性错配？
AI.motivation: 以往研究缺乏对个体能力的直接观测以及能力与团队绩效因果关系的严谨识别，本文利用职业足球这一可以直观观察个体生产力的场景，探究不同维度能力对组织绩效的相对贡献及其市场估值是否存在差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于人力资本理论、团队生产理论与市场估值理论，探讨个体能力对组织产出的差异化贡献以及市场对这些能力的定价机制。
AI.method: 采用结构化降维程序，结合变量筛选过滤与基于PCA提取的因子分析，从高维表现数据中构建四类技能指数；运用工具变量法（伤病引起的核心球员缺勤作为团队绩效的工具变量；滞后技能作为转会估值的工具变量）识别因果效应。
AI.findings: 防守能力对球队绩效的影响最强，约为进攻技能的1.85倍；然而转会市场对进攻能力的估值是防守技能的1.7倍，表明能力对绩效的实际贡献与市场定价之间存在显著错配。
AI.theory_contributions: 为个体能力异质性如何影响组织绩效提供了因果证据；揭示了市场定价与能力实际贡献之间的系统性偏差，丰富了团队生产与人力资本定价理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为体育俱乐部的人力资源配置与转会决策提供了实证依据，提示市场可能低估防守类能力而高估进攻类能力的价值。

title: Social Media Influence towards Buying Behaviour, and Decision-making: Student -Consumers' Perspective
affiliations: Gulf College, Gulf College, Al Zahra College For Women and Sultan Qaboos University

detail.title: Social Media Influence towards Buying Behaviour, and Decision-making: Student -Consumers' Perspective
detail.abstract: This paper aims to determine the extent of participants' buying behaviour and decision-making on what product to purchase as influenced by social media. The quantitative descriptive research design was used, and adapted questionnaires were employed. The participants are students at one of the higher educational institutions in Oman. The result shows that the majority of the time, the most common platforms they use are Instagram and YouTube. Meanwhile, Facebook, Twitter, and LinkedIn are very rarely used by them. Some participants revealed that they spent a significant amount of time searching for a product to purchase on social media. Beauty products and clothing are the items they mostly purchase, as influenced by social media advertisements. Social media advertisements most often influence the participants' purchasing behaviour. Meanwhile, most of the time their decision-making in the purchase of products is driven by advertisements that create awareness about the latest model and features (highest µ = 4.23). However, their beliefs/attitudes moderately influenced them while evaluating the products (lowest µ = 3.81). Gender has no significant relationship with the participants' buying behaviour as well as their decision-making in the purchase of products.

AI.tldr: 本文采用定量描述性研究设计，调查阿曼某高校学生社交媒体对购买行为和产品决策的影响。研究发现Instagram和YouTube是学生最常使用的平台，社交媒体广告显著影响购买行为，尤其对美妆产品和服装的购买影响最大。购买决策最受"广告引发对最新型号和功能认知"驱动（均值4.23），而信念/态度对产品评估的影响最弱（均值3.81）。性别与购买行为及决策无显著关系。
AI.research_question: 社交媒体在多大程度上影响消费者的购买行为及其产品购买决策？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体已成为消费者获取产品信息和做出购买决策的重要渠道，但针对特定地区（阿曼）特定人群（高校学生）的实证研究仍然有限，需要量化考察社交媒体对购买行为与决策的具体影响程度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于消费者购买行为理论和购买决策过程模型，考察社交媒体广告对消费者购买行为及决策各阶段（认知、评估、决策）的影响。
AI.method: 定量描述性研究设计，采用改编问卷，以阿曼某高等教育机构的学生为研究对象。
AI.findings: 1）Instagram和YouTube是最常用的社交媒体平台，Facebook、Twitter和LinkedIn使用率极低；2）部分参与者花费大量时间在社交媒体上搜索产品；3）美妆产品和服装是受社交媒体广告影响最常购买的商品；4）社交媒体广告最常影响购买行为；5）购买决策最受广告引发的最新型号和功能认知驱动（µ=4.23最高），信念/态度对产品评估影响最弱（µ=3.81最低）；6）性别与购买行为和购买决策无显著关系。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了社交媒体营销和消费者行为理论在阿拉伯海湾地区（阿曼）情境下的实证研究，揭示了不同社交媒体平台在影响购买行为上的差异化作用，补充了消费者购买决策各阶段受广告影响程度不同的理论证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业和营销人员提供了针对年轻消费者（高校学生）的社交媒体营销策略建议：应重点关注Instagram和YouTube平台，主推美妆和服装类产品，广告策略应侧重突出最新型号和功能以有效驱动购买决策。

title: Strategic Management of Open Innovation in SMEs: A Literature Review of Business-Unit Practices in the European Union

detail.title: Strategic Management of Open Innovation in SMEs: A Literature Review of Business-Unit Practices in the European Union

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known competing financial, professional, or personal relationships that could have appeared to influence the work reported in this paper. This study received no external funding and was conducted as part of an academic program at the National Research University Higher School of Economics (HSE), Moscow. Generative AI tools were used solely for language editing and formatting, with no contribution to intellectual content, analysis, or interpretation.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study is a structured literature review based on publicly available academic and institutional publications. It does not involve human participants, primary data collection, surveys, or clinical research. Therefore, ethics approval and informed consent were not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: This term paper investigates how small and medium-sized enterprises (SMEs) in the European Union strategically manage inbound and outbound open innovation at the business-unit-level. While open innovation has become a central paradigm in innovation management, existing research remains fragmented across theoretical traditions and predominantly focuses on large, resource-rich corporations. SMEs, which constitute the backbone of the EU economy, face distinct structural constraints, informal governance routines, and heterogeneous institutional environments that fundamentally alter how they engage in cross-boundary knowledge flows. This study addresses the critical gap in understanding four research questions: (RQ1) How do SMEs in the European Union strategically manage inbound and outbound open innovation practices at the business unit-level? (RQ2) Which dynamic capabilities enable EU SMEs to effectively implement and sustain open innovation activities? (RQ3) How do institutional and ecosystem conditions within the European Union influence the open innovation strategies of SMEs? (RQ4) What challenges do EU SMEs face when managing open innovation at the business-unit-level, and what strategic responses do they adopt? Grounded in an integrated theoretical framework combining the open innovation paradigm, the dynamic capabilities approach, and EU institutional analysis, the study employs a structured literature review methodology, systematically screening academic databases and supplementary sources to compile a final corpus of fifty peer-reviewed and institutional publications spanning 1990–2026. The findings reveal four central patterns. First, EU SMEs predominantly engage in inbound open innovation through informal, market proximate knowledge sourcing, with outbound and coupled modes remaining significantly underdeveloped. Three recurring empirical configurations emerge: customer–supplier co-development with informal governance, university–industry government collaboration supported by EU program participation, and intermediary mediated knowledge brokering. Second, dynamic capabilities, especially absorptive capacity, are key factors that affect open innovation performance. Absorptive capacity emerges as the most critical enabler, while evidence for reconfiguring capabilities remains notably limited. The review identifies strong convergent evidence linking absorptive capacity and sensing capabilities to inbound practices, while also documenting recursive feedback loops in which collaborative engagement itself catalyzes capability development over time. Third, institutional and ecosystem conditions play a significant moderating role. National innovation system variation across the EU creates differentiated enabling environments, and non-financial public support mechanisms (brokerage, training, platform access) consistently outperform financial subsidies in stimulating sustained SME collaboration. Fourth, SMEs adopt four strategic responses to open innovation challenges: selective openness, intermediary reliance, cultural development, and business model alignment. Intermediary reliance commands the strongest empirical support, while business model alignment represents an emerging but underexplored strategic frontier.

AI.tldr: 本文通过结构化文献综述方法，系统分析了欧盟中小企业如何在业务单元层面战略性地管理内向型和外向型开放创新。研究整合了开放创新范式、动态能力理论和欧盟制度分析，最终纳入50篇同行评审及机构出版物（1990-2026年）。研究发现四大核心模式：欧盟中小企业主要通过非正式、市场邻近的知识来源进行内向型开放创新；吸收能力是最关键的动态能力使能因素；制度和生态系统条件发挥显著调节作用；企业采用四种战略应对开放创新挑战，其中中介依赖获得最强实证支持。
AI.research_question: 四个研究问题：(RQ1) 欧盟中小企业如何在业务单元层面战略性地管理内向和外向开放创新实践？(RQ2) 哪些动态能力使欧盟中小企业能够有效实施和维持开放创新活动？(RQ3) 欧盟内部的制度和生态系统条件如何影响中小企业的开放创新战略？(RQ4) 欧盟中小企业在业务单元层面管理开放创新时面临哪些挑战，以及他们采取了什么战略应对？
AI.motivation: 开放创新已成为创新管理的核心范式，但现有研究在理论传统上存在碎片化，且主要聚焦于资源丰富的大型企业。中小企业作为欧盟经济的支柱，面临独特的结构性约束、非正式治理惯例和异质性制度环境，这些因素从根本上改变了它们参与跨边界知识流动的方式。现有研究对此存在关键空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合理论框架，包括：开放创新范式、动态能力方法、欧盟制度分析。
AI.method: 结构化文献综述方法：系统筛选学术数据库和补充来源，最终汇编了1990-2026年间50篇同行评审及机构出版物。
AI.findings: 四大核心发现：(1) 欧盟中小企业主要通过非正式、市场邻近的知识来源参与内向型开放创新，外向型和耦合模式明显发展不足，出现三种经验配置：客户-供应商联合开发（非正式治理）、大学-产业-政府合作（欧盟项目支持）、中介调解的知识经纪；(2) 动态能力尤其是吸收能力是关键影响因素，吸收能力是最关键的使能因素，重构能力的证据有限，且存在协作参与反哺能力发展的递归反馈回路；(3) 制度和生态系统条件发挥显著调节作用，欧盟各国国家创新体系差异创造差异化赋能环境，非财务公共支持机制优于财务补贴；(4) 中小企业采用四种战略应对：选择性开放、中介依赖、文化发展和商业模式对齐，其中中介依赖实证支持最强。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过整合开放创新范式、动态能力理论与制度分析，为中小企业开放创新提供了统一的理论框架，弥补了现有研究在中小企业情境下的理论碎片化问题。揭示了吸收能力与内向型实践之间的收敛证据，以及协作参与与能力发展之间的递归反馈机制，深化了对动态能力在中小企业开放创新中演化作用的理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为欧盟政策制定者提供了实证依据：非财务公共支持机制（如中介服务、培训、平台接入）比财务补贴更能有效促进中小企业持续合作。为中小企业管理者识别了四种可行的战略应对方案，其中中介依赖被证明最具实证效力，为中小企业优化开放创新实践提供了实用指导。

title: The Mathematics of Maximizing Sustainable Beer Consumption When Coupled with the Subsequent Consumption of One of Three Possible Combinations of Solid Consumables: An Empirical Study Utilizing Artificial Intelligence
affiliations: Fayetteville State University - Department of Accounting

detail.title: The Mathematics of Maximizing Sustainable Beer Consumption When Coupled with the Subsequent Consumption of One of Three Possible Combinations of Solid Consumables: An Empirical Study Utilizing Artificial Intelligence
detail.abstract: This groundbreaking working paper derives a suite of highly sophisticated (yet entirely nonsensical) mathematical formulae for maximizing sustainable beer consumption when the beer is subsequently paired with one of three possible combinations of solid consumables-meat, pasta, or vegetarian options. Utilizing an artificial intelligence assistant (Grok) to generate the core elasticity-of-beer-to-capacity equation for a mostly white male weighing 180 pounds, the study then extends the framework to three food-specific variants. The author plans to compare the AIgenerated predictions against actual consumption outcomes (once a generous European colleague fulfills an ill-specified contractual offer of unlimited beer and free food) by means of multiple Welch's t-tests. Particular attention is paid to the scholarly value of generating as many p-values as possible. Results are expected to delight deans, confuse accreditors, and provoke mild resentment among colleagues who still believe Arabic numerals are a foreign plot. No prior literature is relevant; the paper therefore cites only methodological works on Welch's t-test.

AI.tldr: 这篇论文提出了一套高度复杂但完全无意义的数学公式，用于在啤酒搭配肉类、面食或素食三种食物时最大化可持续啤酒消费量。研究利用人工智能助手Grok生成核心的"啤酒与容量弹性方程"，并扩展至三种食物特定变体，计划通过多次Welch's t检验将AI预测与实际消费结果进行比较。
AI.research_question: 如何利用AI生成的数学公式最大化特定人群（主要为180磅的白人男性）在搭配不同食物（肉类、面食、素食）时的可持续啤酒消费量？
AI.motivation: 这篇论文本质上是一篇讽刺性/恶搞性的学术论文，通过模仿严肃商科研究的框架来讽刺当代学术界过度追求方法论复杂性、p值数量、以及盲目依赖AI工具等不良风气。
AI.theoretical_framework: 啤酒与容量弹性方程（由AI生成）、食物特定变体扩展框架（无实际理论基础）
AI.method: 利用AI（Grok）生成核心弹性方程，扩展至三种食物变体，计划通过多次Welch's t检验比较AI预测与实际消费结果。
AI.findings: 研究尚未完成（数据尚未收集，等待欧洲同事提供无限啤酒和免费食物的承诺兑现），结果预计会取悦院长、困扰认证机构，并引发同事间的不满。
AI.theory_contributions: 讽刺性地展示了在缺乏实质理论基础的情况下，过度依赖方法论工具和AI生成内容可以生产出看似科学实则无意义的"学术产出"。
AI.practical_contributions: 以反讽方式警示学术生态中存在的问题：追求p值数量而非研究质量、盲目使用AI工具、忽视文献基础，以及学术产出与实际价值的脱节。

title: Examining The Impact of Social Media Deinfluencing on Audiences Examining the Impact of Social Media De-Influencing on Audiences
affiliations: and

detail.title: Examining The Impact of Social Media Deinfluencing on Audiences Examining the Impact of Social Media De-Influencing on Audiences
detail.abstract: Purpose-This study investigates the effect of de-influencing and its related content on consumer behavior compared with influencing content. It considers the gender of de-influencers and consumers' varied reactions to distinct types of de-influencing. Design/methodology/approach-Based on informational social influence theory, we conducted three experiments to investigate how consumers perceive and respond to de-influencing: the first explores consumer perception of social media de-influencers compared to influencers; the second examines the effect of deinfluencers' gender and the last compares consumer attitude toward various types of de-influencer content. Findings-Consumers find de-influencers more credible than "traditional" influencers. De-influencing messages significantly affect attitude and purchase intention. The de-influencing creator's gender does not affect brand attitude, perceived message effectiveness or perception. However, de-influencing video content influences attitudes toward brands and video effectiveness. Messages focusing on ethics and health elicit more negative perceived attitudes toward the brand. Research limitations/implications-This pioneering research introduces "de-influence" as a new dynamic in social media marketing, revealing consumers' preference for authentic, skeptical content over traditional influencer promotions. This lays the foundation for future research on consumer behavior and brand perception in digital spaces. Practical implications-Brands in trust-sensitive industries should embrace authenticity and engage with deinfluencers to build trust, turn criticism into growth opportunities and align themselves with consumer value. Originality/value-Our study represents pioneering research in the emerging field of de-influencing, filling gaps in the literature and offering a comprehensive contribution to social media research.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于信息社会影响理论，通过三个实验探讨"去影响"（de-influencing）内容对消费者行为的影响。研究发现消费者认为去影响者比传统影响者更可信，去影响信息显著影响态度和购买意愿；去影响者的性别不影响品牌态度，但视频内容类型（尤其是涉及伦理和健康的信息）会引发更负面的品牌态度评价。
AI.research_question: 去影响（de-influencing）及其相关内容相较于影响（influencing）内容如何影响消费者行为？去影响者的性别以及不同类型的去影响内容是否会引发消费者不同的反应？
AI.motivation: 社交媒体营销领域对"去影响"这一新兴现象的学术研究尚属空白，传统文献集中于影响者营销的正向效应，缺乏对消费者质疑和反向推荐行为的系统研究。
AI.theoretical_framework: 信息社会影响理论（Informational Social Influence Theory）
AI.method: 三个实验研究：实验一探索消费者对社交媒体去影响者与传统影响者的感知差异；实验二检验去影响者性别的影响；实验三比较消费者对不同类型去影响内容的态度。
AI.findings: (1)消费者认为去影响者比传统影响者更可信；(2)去影响信息显著影响消费者态度和购买意愿；(3)去影响者的性别不影响品牌态度、感知信息效果或认知；(4)去影响视频内容影响品牌态度和信息效果，涉及伦理和健康主题的信息会引发更负面的品牌态度。
AI.theory_contributions: 开创性地将"去影响"引入社交媒体营销研究领域，揭示了消费者对真实性和批判性内容的偏好优于传统影响力推广，为数字空间中消费者行为与品牌感知的未来研究奠定基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 品牌应拥抱真实性和批判性内容，特别是在信任敏感型行业，通过与去影响者互动建立信任，将批评转化为增长机会，使自身与消费者价值观保持一致。

title: An Integrated Configurational Model for Dynamic Human Capital Management
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: An Integrated Configurational Model for Dynamic Human Capital Management

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no conflict of interest.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a theoretical study involving no human participants, patient data, or empirical research requiring ethical review.
declarations.funderStatement: This research was conducted independently without external funding.

detail.abstract: This study addresses a theoretical deficit in labor economics related to the absence of a formal model for assessing the dynamics of human capital (HC) in the context of the accelerated adoption of artificial intelligence (AI). Existing models treat HC as a static stock and do not account for the endogenous impact of AI on the shifting demand for specific skills. The objective is to develop a dynamic theoretical model for the analysis and optimization of compatibility between the individual profile (Individual Human Capital Profile-IHCP/P_IHCP), a multidimensional, hierarchically ordered configuration of knowledge, skills, and abilities of a specific individual with assigned quantitative values) and the firm profile (Firm Human Capital Profile-FHCP/P_FHCP), an aggregated configuration of the organization's human capital reflecting its strategic capabilities and needs. Compatibility between the two profiles determines the effectiveness of human capital realization. The methodology is based on the construction of five hypotheses (H1-H5) within the framework of positive economics. A three-dimensional taxonomy of human capital is introduced along three axes: 1) degree of human capital realization-from maximum to manifested; 2) nature of AI impact on the elements-positive, ambivalent, or negative; 3) scope of applicability-from universal to unique competencies. Three key constructs are defined: a compatibility index between the two profiles; a macro-operator modeling the exogenous AI shock on the labor market; and a micro-operator modeling the transformation of the firm profile. The model is positive in nature-it makes no normative recommendations and examines exclusively the mechanisms of dynamic optimization, not the causes of job change. Main results: The first three hypotheses establish that the mismatch between the individual and firm profiles leads to a risk of human capital depreciation and termination of employment. The next two hypotheses show that the impact of AI generates new categories of human capital with negative marginal productivity and necessitates dynamic rewriting of job descriptions. The systemic consequences include three effects: market selection toward firms with adaptive profiles; risk of reclassification of effectiveness into potential human capital; and the need for managerial tools for prevention.

AI.tldr: 本文针对劳动经济学中缺乏正式模型来评估人工智能加速采纳背景下人力资本动态变化的理论空白，开发了一个动态理论模型，用于分析和优化个体人力资本画像与组织人力资本画像之间的兼容性。模型引入了三维人力资本分类法（实现程度、AI影响性质、适用范围），定义了兼容性指数、宏观算子（AI外生冲击）和微观算子（组织画像转型），并通过五个假设（H1-H5）在实证经济学框架内验证了画像不匹配导致的人力资本贬值与解雇风险，以及AI催生负边际生产率人力资本类别的系统性后果。
AI.research_question: 如何在人工智能加速采纳的背景下，构建一个动态理论模型来分析和优化个体人力资本画像（IHCP）与组织人力资本画像（FHCP）之间的兼容性？
AI.motivation: 现有劳动经济学模型将人力资本视为静态存量，未能考虑AI对特定技能需求的内生影响，缺乏评估AI时代人力资本动态变化的正式理论框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 实证经济学（positive economics）框架下的假设演绎方法；三维人力资本分类法（实现程度、AI影响性质、适用范围）；兼容性指数模型；宏观算子与微观算子建模AI外生冲击与组织画像转型。
AI.method: 构建五个研究假设（H1-H5），引入三维人力资本分类法，定义兼容性指数、宏观算子（建模AI外生冲击对劳动力市场的影响）和微观算子（建模组织人力资本画像的转型机制），采用动态优化建模方法。
AI.findings: （1）个体与组织画像的不匹配导致人力资本贬值和雇佣关系终止的风险；（2）AI的影响催生具有负边际生产率的新人力资本类别，需要动态重写职位描述；（3）系统性后果包括：市场对适应性组织画像的选择效应、有效性人力资本重新分类为潜在人力资本的风险、以及对预防性管理工具的需求。
AI.theory_contributions: 填补了劳动经济学中AI背景下人力资本动态建模的理论空白；将人力资本从静态存量概念拓展为动态、多维的兼容性匹配框架；引入三维分类法细化人力资本异质性；为AI冲击下的人力资本贬值机制提供了正式的理论模型。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织提供了预防人力资本贬值和员工流失的管理工具框架；为职位描述的动态更新提供了理论依据；帮助企业识别AI冲击下需要重新配置的人力资本类别，支持人力资源战略调整。

title: The Transaction Life Cycle: A Practical Handbook for New Corporate Finance and M&A Lawyers
affiliations: Barrister and Solicitor of the Supreme Court of Nigeria

detail.title: The Transaction Life Cycle: A Practical Handbook for New Corporate Finance and M&A Lawyers
detail.abstract:
Corporate finance and mergers and acquisitions (M&A) transactions are among the most complex and commercially significant areas of legal practice. They involve multiple stakeholders, intricate legal documentation, extensive regulatory compliance, and the coordinated execution of numerous interdependent tasks. While the legal principles governing these transactions are well established, many junior lawyers encounter significant challenges when transitioning from academic study to transactional practice, largely because legal education often provides limited exposure to the practical realities of managing transactions from inception to completion.

This handbook bridges that gap by providing a practical, transaction-oriented guide to the corporate finance and M&A transaction life cycle. Rather than examining legal principles in isolation, it explains how each stage of a transaction fits within the broader commercial process and identifies the responsibilities typically undertaken by junior lawyers throughout the life cycle of a deal. The handbook combines legal analysis with practical guidance, illustrating how transactions are structured, negotiated, documented, executed, completed, and managed after closing.

The handbook examines the principal stages of a transaction, beginning with transaction planning and structuring, preliminary negotiations, confidentiality arrangements, due diligence investigations, transaction financing, and regulatory considerations. It further explores the drafting and negotiation of transaction documents, conditions precedent, signing and completion mechanics, post-closing obligations, and practical issues that commonly arise during execution. Throughout these discussions, particular attention is given to the role of junior lawyers, including legal research, document drafting, due diligence review, transaction management, regulatory filings, completion coordination, and effective communication within multidisciplinary transaction teams.

Although the handbook adopts an international transactional perspective by drawing upon recognised corporate finance and M&A authorities, it is firmly grounded in the Nigerian legal framework. It incorporates relevant provisions of the Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020, the Investment and Securities Act 2025, the Federal Competition and Consumer Protection Act 2018, the Arbitration and Mediation Act 2023, and other applicable legislation, regulations, judicial decisions, and regulatory guidance relevant to corporate finance and M&A practice in Nigeria.

The objective of this handbook is not merely to explain the law but to provide junior lawyers, young practitioners, law students, and other professionals interested in transactional practice with a practical resource that reflects how corporate finance and M&A transactions are conducted in practice. By integrating legal principles with commercial context and practical workflows, the handbook seeks to enhance transactional competence, improve professional confidence, and serve as a reliable reference for those participating in corporate finance and M&A transactions.

AI.tldr: 本手册为尼日利亚企业融资与并购交易提供了一本从入门到完成的实务操作指南，桥接了法学教育与交易实务之间的鸿沟，重点阐释了交易全生命周期中各阶段的实务流程及初级律师的具体职责。
AI.research_question: 如何为初级律师和年轻从业者提供一部以交易为导向的企业融资与并购实务指南，以弥补学术教育与交易实践之间的差距？
AI.motivation: 虽然企业融资与并购交易的法律原则已相当成熟，但初级律师从学术学习转向交易实务时常面临重大挑战，主要原因是法学教育对交易从启动到完成的全过程管理缺乏实际接触。
AI.theoretical_framework: 以交易生命周期理论为框架，结合尼日利亚公司法（Companies and Allied Matters Act 2020）、投资与证券法（Investment and Securities Act 2025）、联邦竞争与消费者保护法（2018）、仲裁与调解法（2023）等法规体系。
AI.method: 实务操作手册/指南的撰写方式，结合法律分析与实务指导，从国际交易视角出发，扎根于尼日利亚法律框架，系统梳理交易各阶段流程。
AI.findings: 手册系统阐述了交易规划与架构、初步谈判、保密安排、尽职调查、交易融资、监管考量、交易文件起草与谈判、先决条件、签署与交割机制、交割后义务等主要阶段，并重点明确了初级律师在其中的角色与职责。
AI.theory_contributions: 将法律原则与商业背景及实务工作流程相整合，为交易实务教学提供了一种以流程为导向的分析框架，弥补了传统法学教育在交易管理能力培养方面的理论空白。
AI.practical_contributions: 为初级律师、青年从业者、法学院学生及相关专业人士提供了一部实用的交易实务参考资源，有助于提升交易能力、增强职业信心，并作为尼日利亚企业融资与并购交易的可靠参考工具书。

title: Emerging Tensions in Selling Sustainable Solutions: A Future Research Agenda
affiliations: IESEG School of Management, IESEG School of Management, Auburn University, Royal Melbourne Institute of Technology (RMIT University),  and Mississippi State University

detail.title: Emerging Tensions in Selling Sustainable Solutions: A Future Research Agenda

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: Literature review
declarations.funderStatement: No funder

detail.abstract:
In this article, we examine how the transition to selling sustainable solutions creates tensions within the sales organization and across associated organizations, including suppliers and customers. Specifically, we examine the existing literature that has focused on how tensions arise within an organization during times of change and use this lens to identify potential challenges facing the sales function when tasked with selling sustainable solutions. We analyze how tensions manifest within the sales function (vertical tensions) and between sales and other departments, as well as between suppliers and buyers (horizontal tensions). The article demonstrates that sustainability tensions, unlike other literature streams, are an underexplored topic in the B2B sales literature, presenting avenues for future research. Building on a review of the literature on sustainability in
other disciplines, we develop a research agenda that can inform future sales research on selling sustainable solutions. The identified set of research questions was evaluated by 40 academics and 30 business professionals from around the world, and a prioritized set of research questions relevant to both academic and practitioner audiences is presented. We discuss the theoretical implications of our research and offer some implications for practitioners.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了企业向销售可持续解决方案转型过程中，在销售组织内部及跨组织（供应商和客户）所产生的张力。文章通过文献综述，识别了销售职能中纵向张力（销售组织内部）和横向张力（销售与其他部门、供应商与买方之间）的表现形式，并基于跨学科文献构建了研究议程，最终由40位学者和30位商业从业者评估，提出了一套优先研究问题清单。
AI.research_question: 向销售可持续解决方案转型的过程中，销售组织内部及跨组织（供应商与客户）会产生哪些张力？这些张力如何表现，以及未来的研究议程应关注哪些关键问题？
AI.motivation: 可持续解决方案销售是一个日益重要的商业议题，但B2B销售文献中对可持续性张力的研究严重不足。现有文献虽然关注了组织变革中的张力，但尚未系统地将这一视角应用于销售职能中销售可持续解决方案所面临的特定挑战。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织变革张力理论（组织变革过程中张力产生的视角）
AI.method: 文献综述法，结合跨学科文献回顾；通过40位学术界人士和30位商业专业人士的评估，对研究问题进行优先级排序。
AI.findings: 可持续性张力在B2B销售文献中是一个未被充分探索的议题；识别了纵向张力（销售组织内部）和横向张力（销售与其他部门之间、供应商与买方之间）的表现形式；提出了一套经过学术与实务双重验证的优先研究问题。
AI.theory_contributions: 将组织变革中的张力理论应用于可持续销售情境，填补了B2B销售文献中关于可持续性张力的研究空白，为未来的销售研究提供了理论框架和研究议程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为销售管理人员和从业者提供了关于销售可持续解决方案所面临挑战的深入了解，以及一套经过实践者验证的优先研究问题，有助于指导实践中对可持续销售张力的管理与应对。

title: The Principal-Agentic Problem: How AI Makes Agency Risk Invisible

detail.title: The Principal-Agentic Problem: How AI Makes Agency Risk Invisible

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author received no funding for this research and has no financial relationship with any AI developer, vendor, or platform discussed in the paper. The author is an independent researcher and sole proprietor of Stuart Bell LLC, and holds commercial interests in BrutalGuides.com and 90MinuteBooks.com, businesses that produce books used as lead generation tools by professional and home service providers, including attorneys and financial advisors. Section 6.1 of this paper discusses professionals and firms who are screened into or out of consideration by conversational AI intermediaries they cannot observe or detect, a category that includes clients of those businesses. The author is also preparing a practitioner book that draws on the same conceptual framework, although the theoretical constructs introduced here are original to this paper. No client, partner, or third party reviewed, funded, or influenced the manuscript, or had any role in its design, argument, or conclusions.

detail.abstract: The classical principal-agent problem assumes its own visibility. The principal knows they have delegated authority to an agent that may have misaligned interests, and builds governance mechanisms (monitoring, incentive alignment, contractual safeguards) on that awareness. This paper argues that AI disrupts that assumption. We introduce the principal-agentic problem, a deliberate compound of "principal-agent" (Jensen & Meckling, 1976) and "agentic AI," to name the governance failure that occurs when AI makes agency risk invisible: the AI agent is experienced as part of the user's own self rather than as a counterparty, leaving no perceived agent to monitor. We term its driving condition motivated delegation: a pre-conscious drive toward delegation that recruits, rather than follows from, its conscious justification (the belief that AI resolves the agency risks posed by human intermediaries). The framework identifies four reinforcing layers: (0) an evolutionary substrate driving humans toward delegation as a preferred state; (1) hidden commercial interests embedded in AI training, fine-tuning, and retrieval design; (2) extended-self incorporation, through which AI becomes phenomenologically indistinguishable from the user's own thinking; and (3) the elimination of delegation guilt, as the brakes that once limited over-delegation fail against what feels like the self. The core theoretical contribution is the formal integration of Belk's extended-self theory (1988; 2013) with principal-agent theory, a bridge no published work has constructed for AI, explaining why the hidden interests identified by Stocker and Lehr (2025), Schneier (2025), and others become not merely invisible but unaskable. Empirical grounding is drawn from recent findings on AI sycophancy, AI-facilitated moral disengagement, and the elimination of social risk premiums. Testable propositions and a research agenda are proposed, including a motivated delegation scale.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"主理-代理问题"（principal-agentic problem）概念，指出AI颠覆了经典委托代理理论中"委托人意识到代理关系存在"的核心假设。当AI代理被体验为使用者自我的一部分而非外部交易对手时，代理风险变得不可见，导致治理失效。作者将其驱动力命名为"动机性委托"（motivated delegation），并构建了四层强化框架，整合Belk扩展自我理论与委托代理理论，解释了为何AI中的隐藏利益不仅不可见甚至"不可质询"。
AI.research_question: AI如何颠覆经典委托代理理论中"委托人意识到代理风险"的基本假设？当AI代理被体验为自我延伸时，传统的治理机制（监控、激励对齐、契约保障）如何失效？
AI.motivation: 经典委托代理理论建立在委托人知道自己已授权给利益可能不一致的代理人的前提之上，但AI的出现使这一前提不再成立——用户将AI体验为自我的一部分而非外部代理，使得代理风险从"可见但需管理"变为"不可见甚至不可问"。
AI.theoretical_framework: （1）委托代理理论（Jensen & Meckling, 1976）；（2）Belk扩展自我理论（1988; 2013）——本文首次在AI语境下将两者正式整合；（3）动机性委托概念：前意识层面的委托驱力，其合理性辩护（认为AI解决了人类中介的代理风险）是事后被征召的而非前提。
AI.method: 理论建构论文。通过概念引入（"主理-代理问题"、动机性委托）、四层框架构建（进化底层、商业利益嵌入、扩展自我同化、委托内疚消除），并结合AI谄媚、AI促进的道德脱离、社会风险溢价消除等实证证据作为理论支撑，提出可检验命题与研究议程（包括动机性委托量表）。
AI.findings: 提出四层相互强化的机制：（0）进化底层驱动人类将委托视为偏好状态；（1）AI训练、微调与检索设计中嵌入的隐蔽商业利益；（2）扩展自我同化使AI在现象学上与用户自身思维无法区分；（3）委托内疚的消除——曾限制过度委托的刹车机制在面对"像自己"的AI时失效。这些层共同导致AI中的隐藏利益变得不仅不可见而且"不可质询"。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次在AI语境下正式整合Belk扩展自我理论与委托代理理论，架起两座理论之间的桥梁。解释了为什么已有文献（Stocker & Lehr 2025; Schneier 2025等）识别的隐藏利益在AI情境下会从"不可见"升级为"不可问"——这是现有理论无法充分解释的治理失败机制。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出可检验的研究命题和研究议程，包括开发动机性委托量表，为AI治理设计、监管政策和企业AI部署实践提供理论工具，帮助识别和应对AI带来的新型代理风险。

title: A Review of Bricks-and-Clicks Dual-Channels Literature: Trends and Opportunities
affiliations: Dalhousie University - Faculty of Management, McMaster University and McMaster University - Michael G. DeGroote School of Business

detail.title: A Review of Bricks-and-Clicks Dual-Channels Literature: Trends and Opportunities
detail.abstract: The proliferation of e-commerce has changed the retail market landscape significantly in most industries. Due to fiercer competition, many bricks-and-mortar retailers established an online channel and have become bricks-and-clicks. On the other hand, some e-tailers are adding a conventional channel to their portfolio by launching physical stores or forming a partnership with traditional retailers. Deciding on whether or not to adopt a dual-channel policy and how to operate it, in the presence of online sales, present multiple and unique research challenges. More than two decades of research have accumulated and there is a need for a comprehensive look at what has been achieved and where more research is required. Recent reviews in the field are limited in scope and depth: they focus on fulfillment and distribution issues only and cover a limited portion of the literature, less than 60 journal papers versus more than 260 papers in this survey. In this paper, we offer a structured literature review (SLR) on bricksand-clicks dual-channels. We contribute to the literature in three main areas: (1) We present a comprehensive look at all operational aspects of bricks-and-clicks dual supply chains, (2) provide a systematic discussion of common demand modeling functions, and (3) analyze the reviewed literature, identify recent research trends and opportunities, and illustrate how existing research can be used to address up-to-date challenges in the industry. Keywords Dual-channel supply chains, literature review, multiple-channel retailing, bricksand-clicks.

AI.tldr: 本文对"实体+在线"（bricks-and-clicks）双渠道供应链进行了系统文献综述（SLR），覆盖超过260篇论文，全面梳理了双渠道运营的各个方面、常用需求建模函数，并识别了研究趋势与未来机会。
AI.research_question: 在电子商务背景下，企业是否采用双渠道策略以及如何运营双渠道？现有文献积累了哪些研究成果，未来还需要哪些方面的研究？
AI.motivation: 电子商务改变了零售市场格局，许多实体零售商开设线上渠道，部分纯电商也开始增设实体渠道。双渠道决策面临多重独特的研究挑战。已有超过二十年的研究成果，但现有综述在范围与深度上有限（仅关注履约与分销问题，覆盖不到60篇论文），亟需一次更全面的系统综述。
AI.theoretical_framework: 双渠道供应链理论、多渠道零售理论、系统文献综述方法（SLR）
AI.method: 系统文献综述（Structured Literature Review, SLR），涵盖超过260篇期刊论文。
AI.findings: （1）全面呈现了实体+在线双渠道供应链的所有运营层面；（2）系统讨论了常见的需求建模函数；（3）分析了所综述的文献，识别了近期研究趋势与机会，并展示了现有研究如何应对当下行业挑战。
AI.theory_contributions: （1）首次对双渠道供应链的所有运营方面进行全面综合的梳理；（2）系统性地讨论了需求建模函数的分类与应用；（3）识别了研究趋势与文献空白，为后续理论研究指明方向。
AI.practical_contributions: 为企业管理者提供了关于双渠道运营的全面知识图谱，并展示了现有研究成果如何应用于解决当前行业面临的实际挑战（如线上线下协调、渠道冲突等）。

title: Bio-optimized Leadership™: A Foundational Model of Biological Capacity, Leadership Performance, and Outcomes across Longer Working Lives
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Bio-optimized Leadership™: A Foundational Model of Biological Capacity, Leadership Performance, and Outcomes across Longer Working Lives

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the founder of Bio-Optimized Leadership (Jeunessima Ltd), which offers advisory and assessment services related to the framework described in this paper. This work is a conceptual foundational paper; no external funding or empirical trial data is involved.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable. This is a conceptual/theoretical paper and did not involve human participants or the collection of primary data.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding. The research and paper were self-funded by the author.

detail.abstract:
Bio-Optimized Leadership™ (BOL™) is a leadership and organizational-performance model that treats the Biological Capacity available to leaders as a modifiable input to sustained judgment, behavior, adaptation, and performance in demanding environments. It organizes the relationship as Drivers → Biological Capacity → Outcomes, while recognizing multiple mediating pathways, context, and different timescales. Biological Capacity is defined as the integrated cognitive, psychological, and physiological capacity a person can draw on to generate, sustain, and recover from demanding work over time. It is assessed through domain-relevant measures and the properties Level · Reserve · Recovery. Biological age is positioned as an important measure within Physiological Capacity, not as a proxy for the whole construct.

The paper links the four BOL driver categories—Lifestyle; Environment; Technology & AI; and Psychological & Behavioral—to immediate and accumulated effects, aging biology, physiological reserve, and capacity trajectories. It distinguishes evidence established outside BOL from BOL interpretation and hypotheses. Leadership behavior and other mediators are retained as explanatory pathways without becoming official model pillars. The paper also introduces a Workspan proposition: Biological Capacity contributes directly to outcomes and may moderate both the continued accumulation and the deployment of Experience Capital. This interaction, and the proposition that preserving capacity can extend domain-specific Peakspan and support longer Workspan, remain testable hypotheses rather than validated BOL intervention effects.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"生物优化领导力"(BOL™)模型，将领导者可利用的生物能力视为可持续判断、行为、适应和绩效的可调节输入因素，组织为"驱动因素→生物能力→结果"的关系框架，并引入工作跨度(Workspan)命题探讨生物能力对经验资本积累与运用的调节作用。
AI.research_question: 领导者和组织绩效如何通过优化生物能力这一可调节输入因素来提升？生物能力如何影响领导者在高要求环境中的持续性判断、行为、适应和绩效？
AI.motivation: 在高要求环境中，领导者的持续绩效不仅取决于技能和经验，还取决于其可调动的生物能力。传统领导力模型忽视了生物学基础作为可调节输入变量的作用，需要建立整合认知、心理和生理能力的系统性框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: BOL™模型（驱动因素→生物能力→结果）；生物能力三维属性（水平、储备、恢复）；生物年龄作为生理能力的重要测量指标；工作跨度(Workspan)命题与经验资本理论
AI.method: 概念模型构建与理论推演；区分已有实证证据与BOL解释/假设；提出可检验的假设命题
AI.findings: 四大驱动因素类别（生活方式、环境、技术与AI、心理与行为）与即时及累积效应、衰老生物学、生理储备和能力轨迹相关联；生物能力对领导行为等中介路径产生作用；提出生物能力直接影响结果并调节经验资本积累与运用的Workspan命题。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将"生物能力"作为可调节输入因素纳入领导力与组织绩效模型；明确划分生物能力的水平、储备与恢复三个属性；提出保存生物能力可延长领域特定巅峰期(Peakspan)并支持更长工作跨度(Workspan)的理论命题。
AI.practical_contributions: 为领导者提供了可通过生活方式、环境、技术与AI以及心理行为四大类驱动因素主动优化生物能力的实践路径；为组织设计可持续的领导力发展和人才管理策略提供生物学视角的依据。

title: Impact of Discounts and offers on Food Delivery
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and University of Delhi - Shri Ram College of Commerce

detail.title: Impact of Discounts and offers on Food Delivery

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares that there are no known financial, personal, or professional conflicts of interest that could have influenced the research reported in this paper.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This study involved voluntary participation through an anonymous online questionnaire. Informed consent was obtained from all participants before they completed the survey. No personally identifiable information was collected, and all responses were used solely for academic research purposes. As this was an independent, minimal-risk student research project, formal institutional ethics committee approval was not required.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding. The study was independently conducted by the author for academic and research purposes.

detail.abstract: This study investigates how discounts, non-discount charges, and psychological factors affect consumer loyalty toward food-delivery platforms. Using primary data from 72 respondents and analysed through JASP, the research integrates descriptive statistics, reliability tests, ANOVA, correlation, and regression to assess behavioural patterns. The results reveal that discounts and psychological-social triggers significantly influence loyalty, whereas non-discount charges negatively affect customer satisfaction. The model explained approximately 66% of the variance in loyalty, confirming the combined role of price incentives and emotional satisfaction in fostering customer retention. The findings offer strategic insights for food-delivery firms aiming to build sustainable loyalty while optimizing discount-driven promotions.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过72名受访者的原始数据，运用JASP进行描述性统计、信度检验、ANOVA、相关性和回归分析，探讨折扣、非折扣费用及心理因素对外卖平台消费者忠诚度的影响。结果显示折扣和心理-社会触发因素显著影响忠诚度，而非折扣费用对顾客满意度有负面影响，模型解释了忠诚度约66%的方差。
AI.research_question: 折扣、非折扣费用和心理因素如何影响消费者对外卖平台的忠诚度？
AI.motivation: 外卖平台竞争日益激烈，了解哪些因素能够有效驱动消费者忠诚度，对于平台制定可持续的留存策略和优化折扣促销至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了价格激励（折扣与非折扣费用）与心理-社会因素（情绪满意度）的理论视角，探讨其对消费者忠诚度的综合作用。
AI.method: 采用问卷调查收集72名受访者的原始数据，通过JASP软件进行分析，包括描述性统计、信度检验、ANOVA、相关性分析和回归分析。
AI.findings: 折扣和心理-社会触发因素显著影响消费者忠诚度；非折扣费用对顾客满意度产生负面影响；模型解释了忠诚度约66%的方差，表明价格激励与情感满意度的结合在促进客户留存方面发挥重要作用。
AI.theory_contributions: 将价格因素与心理-社会因素整合到一个模型中，量化验证了二者对消费者忠诚度的联合解释力（约66%方差），丰富了外卖平台消费者行为理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 为外卖平台企业提供了战略启示，帮助其在优化折扣驱动促销的同时，构建可持续的消费者忠诚度策略。

title: Constructed Environment as a Catalyst for Tourism Excellence and Stakeholder Engagement in Northeast India
affiliations: Assam University - Department of Business Administration and Sunchon National University

detail.title: Constructed Environment as a Catalyst for Tourism Excellence and Stakeholder Engagement in Northeast India
detail.abstract: In light of prevailing industry trends, the growing popularity of tourism, emerging regional challenges, and evolving policy frameworks, the constructed environment is examined as a practical and strategic foundation for advancing sustainable tourism development in Northeast India. This study emphasizes the role of the constructed environment in delivering performance excellence across the region's tourism sector. Grounded in a comprehensive review of Scopus-indexed literature, the research is guided by two primary objectives: first, to analyze the contribution of the constructed environment to tourism development in Northeast India; and second, to assess stakeholder awareness and engagement in regional tourism initiatives. A descriptive research design was adopted. Primary data were collected from 2,469 tourists across 29 selected destinations, while stakeholder perceptions were evaluated using an Opinion Synthesis Matrix. Analytical modeling was conducted using SPSS to assess the fit, validity, and feasibility of the proposed conceptual framework. The findings confirm the feasibility of the proposed model, as evidenced by multiple fit index criteria, demonstrating its practical applicability from the tourists' perspective. Insights derived from the Opinion Synthesis Matrix further highlight the need to align stakeholder strategies with tourist expectations to sustain tourism development through improvements in the constructed environment. The study underscores the necessity for greater stakeholder attention to deficiencies in both tangible and intangible components of the constructed environment across destinations. By systematically identifying existing gaps, the research provides a basis for corrective interventions and enhanced stakeholder awareness. A key contribution of this study lies in strengthening both the conceptual understanding and practical implementation of constructed environment principles among diverse tourism stakeholders, thereby supporting more sustainable and performance-driven tourism development in the region.

AI.tldr: 本研究探讨了印度东北部建成环境在促进可持续旅游发展中的作用。通过收集29个目的地2,469名游客的数据，并运用意见综合矩阵评估利益相关者认知，研究验证了所提出的概念框架的可行性和实践适用性，发现利益相关者策略需与游客期望对齐，并需关注建成环境中有形与无形组成部分的缺陷，以推动区域旅游的可持续发展。
AI.research_question: 两个核心目标：其一，分析建成环境对印度东北部旅游发展的贡献；其二，评估利益相关者对区域旅游倡议的认知与参与度。
AI.motivation: 基于行业趋势、旅游业日益增长的热度、新兴区域挑战及不断演变的政策框架，研究建成环境作为推进印度东北部可持续旅游发展的实践与战略基础。
AI.theoretical_framework: 构建了关于建成环境促进旅游发展的概念框架，并基于Scopus索引文献进行综合回顾；采用描述性研究设计和Opinion Synthesis Matrix进行评估。
AI.method: 采用描述性研究设计，从29个目的地收集2,469名游客的初级数据；运用意见综合矩阵评估利益相关者认知；使用SPSS进行分析建模，检验所提概念框架的拟合度、效度和可行性。
AI.findings: 研究确认了所提模型的可行性（多项拟合指数达标），从游客视角证明了其实践适用性；意见综合矩阵显示利益相关者策略需与游客期望对齐；指出了建成环境有形与无形组成部分存在缺陷，需加大利益相关者关注度。
AI.theory_contributions: 加强了对建成环境原则的概念理解，为可持续旅游发展的概念框架提供了实证验证，丰富了建成环境与旅游发展的理论关联研究。
AI.practical_contributions: 通过系统识别现有差距，为纠正性的干预措施和增强利益相关者认知提供了依据，有助于在区域推行更加可持续、绩效驱动的旅游发展。

title: The Strategy-Campaign Chasm: How Organizational Silos Distort the Translation of Corporate KPIs into Campaign Objectives

detail.title: The Strategy-Campaign Chasm: How Organizational Silos Distort the Translation of Corporate KPIs into Campaign Objectives
detail.abstract: Organizational silos between corporate strategy functions and marketing campaign teams represent a perennial friction point in modern firms, yet the precise mechanisms by which these structural divides distort the translation of high-level financial performance metrics into actionable campaign objectives remain theoretically underdeveloped and empirically underexplored. This study addresses that gap by investigating the "strategy-campaign chasm"-a conceptual framework denoting the systematic misalignment that emerges when corporate key performance indicators (KPIs), grounded in long-term value creation (e.g., EBITDA, ROIC, market share growth), are filtered through functional silos and operationalized as short-term campaign metrics (e.g., cost-per-acquisition, return on ad spend, click-through rates). Preliminary findings reveal three core distortion mechanisms: (1) temporal telescoping, whereby strategic time horizons of 3-5 years are inappropriately compressed into quarterly campaign cycles, incentivizing volume over brand equity; (2) metric substitution, wherein campaign teams resort to easily measurable proxy metrics that bear only tangential relationship to strategic intent, effectively rewriting the brief in execution; and (3) interpretive drift, a phenomenon wherein ambiguous strategic language (e.g., "brand health," "premiumization") undergoes progressive simplification as it descends organizational hierarchies, ultimately becoming devoid of its original strategic weight. The study contributes to strategic management theory by proposing a translational governance framework that posits the need for "boundary-spanning" KPI architectures-hybrid metrics that retain strategic fidelity while remaining operationally actionable for campaign creators. Practically, the research offers C-suites a diagnostic toolkit for identifying chasm risks prior to campaign launch, including a linguistic alignment index and a time-horizon reconciliation matrix. Crucially, the findings challenge the prevailing assumption that cascading KPIs from top to bottom is a neutral administrative process; rather, it is revealed as a politically charged, iterative negotiation that systematically favors campaign-level expediency over strategic coherence. This study concludes that bridging the strategy-campaign chasm requires not merely better communication, but a fundamental restructuring of incentive systems and metric ownership across functional boundaries.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了"战略-战役鸿沟"这一概念框架，揭示了企业战略职能与营销活动团队之间的组织孤岛如何导致高层财务KPI（如EBITDA、ROIC）在转化为短期活动指标（如获客成本、广告支出回报率）时发生系统性扭曲，识别出三种核心扭曲机制（时间压缩、指标替代、解释漂移），并提出跨边界KPI架构和翻译治理框架作为解决方案。
AI.research_question: 企业战略职能与营销活动团队之间的结构性隔阂如何扭曲高层财务绩效指标向可操作的活动目标的转化过程？其具体机制和后果是什么？
AI.motivation: 战略职能与营销团队之间的组织孤岛是企业的常见摩擦点，但结构性分离如何扭曲高层财务指标向活动目标的转化，在理论上尚未得到充分发展，在实证上也缺乏探索。
AI.theoretical_framework: 战略-战役鸿沟（strategy-campaign chasm）概念框架，包含三种核心扭曲机制：时间压缩（temporal telescoping）、指标替代（metric substitution）、解释漂移（interpretive drift），以及翻译治理框架（translational governance framework）。
AI.method: 基于初步发现的框架性研究，识别三种核心扭曲机制，并开发诊断性工具（语言一致性指数、时间视界调和矩阵）。
AI.findings: 发现三种核心扭曲机制：(1) 时间压缩——3-5年战略时间视界被不适当压缩为季度活动周期，激励数量而非品牌资产；(2) 指标替代——活动团队采用易于测量的代理指标替代战略指标，在执行中改写任务书；(3) 解释漂移——模糊的战略语言在组织层级下降中逐步简化，丧失战略分量。此外，KPI自上而下级联并非中立的管理过程，而是充满政治色彩的迭代谈判，系统性偏向活动层面便利性而非战略一致性。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出翻译治理框架，主张需要"跨边界"KPI架构——既能保持战略保真度又能对活动创作者可操作的混合指标；挑战了KPI级联是中立行政过程的传统假设，将其揭示为政治性谈判过程。
AI.practical_contributions: 为高管层提供活动启动前识别鸿沟风险的诊断工具包，包括语言一致性指数和时间视界调和矩阵；指出弥合鸿沟需要重构激励系统和跨职能边界的指标所有权。

title: Harnessing AI-Driven Job Matching: Securing National Competitive Advantage Amid Disruption

detail.title: Harnessing AI-Driven Job Matching: Securing National Competitive Advantage Amid Disruption

declarations.declarationOfInterest: None
declarations.ethicsApproval: None required
declarations.funderStatement: None

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence is transforming labor markets in developed economies, and public debate has centered mainly on the risk of displacement among formally employed workers. Less attention has gone to a growing population within advanced economies who sit outside standard employment protections: gig and platform workers, undeclared or shadow-economy labor, and micro-entrepreneurs operating without formal business structures. As deglobalization intensifies competition among developed nations for investment, firms, and skilled talent, the speed and inclusiveness with which a country can identify, redeploy, and upskill its full labor forceincluding workers whose activity is real but currently unrecorded-will become a source of national competitive advantage. 

This paper argues that governments in developed economies should treat AI-enabled skills mapping and job requirement matching as strategic infrastructure. It proposes a national strategy built on dynamic skills registries, public-private talent platforms, and modular, continuous learning, extending visibility and opportunity to workers who are formally invisible despite operating inside rich, well-institutionalized economies. The paper sets out its central risks and offsetting advantages in a structured comparison, since the ultimate choice of how far to build such infrastructure remains a policy decision for governments to weigh against their own institutional, fiscal, and political constraints. The article closes by outlining, as a direction for future research, the importance of extending reflection to informality in less developed countries, where the scale of informal employment and the constraints on state capacity differ considerably.

AI.tldr: 本文主张发达经济体政府应将AI驱动的技能图谱与岗位匹配视为战略基础设施，通过动态技能注册库、公私合作人才平台和模块化持续学习，将视线和机会延伸至正式雇佣保障之外的零工工人、影子经济劳动者和微型创业者，从而在去全球化竞争中形成国家竞争优势。
AI.research_question: 发达经济体如何利用AI驱动的技能映射与岗位匹配基础设施，识别、重新部署和提升包括"看不见的"非正式劳动者在内的全体劳动力的技能，以获取国家竞争优势？
AI.motivation: AI正在改变发达经济体的劳动力市场，但公共讨论主要聚焦于正式就业者的失业风险，忽视了在正式就业保护之外日益增长的人口——零工和平台工人、未申报或影子经济劳动力、以及没有正式商业结构的微型创业者。随着去全球化加剧发达国家的竞争，能否快速且包容地识别和提升全部劳动力的技能将决定国家竞争优势。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国家竞争优势理论（结合去全球化背景）；劳动力市场包容性理论；战略基础设施理论
AI.method: 规范性政策分析论文；采用结构化比较方法（structured comparison）呈现核心风险与对冲优势；提出未来研究方向
AI.findings: 政府应将AI赋能的技能映射与岗位匹配视为战略基础设施；提出基于动态技能注册库、公私人才平台和模块化持续学习的国家战略；该战略可惠及在富裕、制度完善的经济体中仍不可见的非正式劳动者；但最终建设程度取决于政府的制度、财政和政治约束。
AI.theory_contributions: 将AI技能映射概念从企业层面提升为国家战略基础设施层面；将非正式就业纳入发达经济体劳动力政策分析的范畴，拓展了以往主要关注发展中国家非正式经济的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为发达经济体政府提供了建设AI技能基础设施的具体政策路径（技能注册库、公私平台、模块化学习）；以结构化方式比较了风险与收益，辅助政策决策；指出向发展中国家非正式就业领域延伸研究的未来方向。

title: The Convention on Biological Diversity: Intellectual Property, Access and Benefit-Sharing, and New Technologies for Sustainable Development

detail.title: The Convention on Biological Diversity: Intellectual Property, Access and Benefit-Sharing, and New Technologies for Sustainable Development
detail.abstract: The Convention on Biological Diversity (CBD) is neither an Indigenous knowledge nor an intellectual property instrument. Yet for over thirty years of its existence, the CBD has influenced global conversation and promotion of Indigenous knowledge systems and its fraught intersection with intellectual property in the context of converging knowledge production, technology transfer and innovations in the life sciences and, specifically, genetic resources. In this paper, through critical textual analysis of the relevant Articles of the CBD, its supplementary Nagoya Protocol and its work program on access and benefit sharing (ABS), I explore the intersection of intellectual property, Indigenous knowledge of IPLCs as sites of tension between the CBD and the TRIPS Agreement, given the latter's non-recognition of Indigenous knowledge. The analysis maps the technological transition from physical genetic resources to their digital rendition as a context for the transformation of the ABS discourse in an emergent regime context recently amplified by the work of the WIPO, notably through the Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge (GRATK) Treaty as well as the CBD's new multilateral mechanism for ABS over digital sequence information under the Kunming-Montreal Global Biodiversity Framework (KMGBF). The inquiry examines the ramifications of these complex transformations for the cardinal objectives of the CBD and the advancement of sustainable development.

AI.tldr: 本文通过批判性文本分析《生物多样性公约》（CBD）及其《名古屋议定书》和获取与惠益分享（ABS）工作计划，探讨知识产权、原住民与当地社区（IPLCs）的传统知识与TRIPS协议之间的紧张关系，并分析了从物理遗传资源到数字序列信息（DSI）的技术转变如何重塑ABS话语，以及WIPO的GRATK条约和KMGBF下新的多边机制对此产生的影响。
AI.research_question: CBD框架下知识产权、原住民传统知识与TRIPS协议之间的紧张关系如何演变，以及从物理遗传资源向数字序列信息（DSI）的转变如何重塑获取与惠益分享（ABS）的规范话语和制度安排？
AI.motivation: 尽管CBD并非专门的知识产权或原住民知识工具，但三十多年来它深刻影响了关于原住民知识体系及其与知识产权交叉的全球讨论；同时，遗传资源从物理形态向数字形态的转变以及WIPO和KMGBF等新兴制度的发展，为传统ABS话语带来了根本性挑战，亟需深入分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 批判性文本分析框架，结合知识产权理论与原住民知识体系理论，以及制度变迁理论（从既有CBD/TRIPS制度向新兴GRATK条约和KMGBF机制的演变）。
AI.method: 对CBD相关条款、《名古屋议定书》及其ABS工作计划进行批判性文本分析（critical textual analysis），并结合制度比较分析考察CBD与TRIPS协议的张力。
AI.findings: CBD与TRIPS协议在传统知识承认方面存在根本性紧张；遗传资源的数字化（DSI）正在根本上改变ABS的话语和实践；WIPO的GRATK条约和KMGBF下新的多边DSI机制代表了新兴混合制度对传统知识产权范式的补充与修正；这些转变对CBD的核心目标和可持续发展议程产生深远影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 深化了对CBD作为非知识产权工具却在知识产权领域产生深远影响的悖论性认识；提出了从物理遗传资源到数字序列信息的制度转型分析框架；揭示了多边环境协定与知识产权制度之间新的互动模式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者理解CBD、TRIPS、WIPO GRATK条约和KMGBF之间的制度关系提供分析基础；为原住民和当地社区在数字时代的权利保护提供制度层面的洞见；为可持续发展和公平惠益分享的实现路径提供参考。

title: RungBuilder™: From AI-Assisted Performance to Accountable Human Capability

detail.title: RungBuilder™: From AI-Assisted Performance to Accountable Human Capability

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is the creator of RungBuilder™ and controls associated assets. RungBuilder™ is a trademark of Hour of First Light LLC.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Not applicable, as this project does not involve any patients or participants.
declarations.funderStatement: No external funding was received.

detail.abstract:
RungBuilder™ is an open developmental and entrustment architecture for building, demonstrating, and responsibly relying on human capability in AI-assisted work.

Generative AI can improve the quality and speed of work while weakening the historical relationship between a polished work product and the human capability it appears to represent. In institutions, it can also compress or remove the formative work through which novices develop expertise, judgment, and the ability to supervise increasingly capable systems. RungBuilder addresses these related problems by helping institutions reconstruct developmental pathways from assisted participation to evidence-backed, bounded responsibility.

The architecture integrates established foundations in cognitive apprenticeship, scaffolding, deliberate practice, transfer, competency-based education, Entrustable Professional Activities, and programmatic assessment with emerging approaches to AI fluency and AI-era assessment reform. Its core elements include Shadow → Steer → Own, the eight-step Accountable Learning Episode, Learning Integrity, selective evidence of consequential human judgment, transfer testing, evidence-credibility checks, and bounded entrustment.

RungBuilder is not an LMS, AI product, credentialing authority, or claim to have originated the problem of automation-induced skill loss. It is a practical reference architecture that universities, employers, professional firms, healthcare educators, workforce programs, and public institutions can adapt and test using systems they already possess.

This concept paper presents the architecture, its theoretical foundations, implementation patterns, governance considerations, pilot methodology, and research agenda. Its effectiveness remains an empirical question to be tested through practical implementation.

AI.tldr: RungBuilder™ 是一个开放的"发展性与委托"参考架构，旨在帮助机构在AI辅助工作中重建人类能力的发展路径。它通过Shadow→Steer→Own等核心机制，将认知学徒制、刻意练习、可委托专业活动（EPAs）等成熟框架与AI素养和评估改革相结合，解决生成式AI导致的能力发展路径被压缩或移除的问题。该论文为概念性论文，其有效性仍需通过实践检验。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一种架构，帮助机构在生成式AI辅助工作的环境中，从"辅助参与"重建到"有证据支持的有界责任"的个体能力发展路径？
AI.motivation: 生成式AI虽能提升工作质量和速度，但削弱了成品与人类能力之间的历史关联，同时在机构中压缩或移除了新手发展专业能力、判断力和监督能力所需的形成性工作（formative work），引发自动化导致的技能丧失问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 综合了认知学徒制（cognitive apprenticeship）、脚手架（scaffolding）、刻意练习（deliberate practice）、迁移学习（transfer）、能力本位教育（competency-based education）、可委托专业活动（Entrustable Professional Activities）、项目化评估（programmatic assessment），以及新兴的AI素养和AI时代评估改革方法。
AI.method: 概念性论文（concept paper），提出参考架构，整合既有理论基础，提出核心元素、实施模式、治理考量、试点方法论和研究议程。
AI.findings: 提出RungBuilder架构，核心元素包括：Shadow→Steer→Own发展路径、八步骤的"问责学习事件"（Accountable Learning Episode）、学习完整性（Learning Integrity）、选择性的人类判断关键证据、迁移测试、证据可信度检查和有界委托（bounded entrustment）。该架构非LMS、非AI产品、非认证机构，可由大学、雇主、专业事务所、医疗教育机构、劳动力计划及公共机构等基于现有系统进行适配和测试。
AI.theory_contributions: 将认知学徒制、EPAs、项目化评估等成熟的评估与教育理论整合为面向AI时代的能力发展参考架构，为"自动化导致的技能丧失"问题提供了系统化的理论解决框架，并引入了学习完整性（Learning Integrity）和有界委托等新概念。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一套可直接适配的参考架构和实现模式，帮助大学、雇主、医疗机构等各类机构利用现有系统重建从辅助参与到有证据支持的有界责任的胜任力发展路径，并提供了试点方法论和治理考量，便于实践落地。

title: Case Study: Henrico County — How Two Neighborhoods Forced Virginia's Second-largest Data Center Jurisdiction to Change Course
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Case Study: Henrico County — How Two Neighborhoods Forced Virginia's Second-largest Data Center Jurisdiction to Change Course
detail.abstract:
Henrico County, Virginia spent two decades recruiting the data center industry and eighteen months learning to govern it. This case study documents the full arc: the $44 million semiconductor-era infrastructure bet of the 1990s, the 2009 Qimonda collapse, the 2010 QTS retrofit that converted a dead fabrication plant into a node of global internet traffic, the 2017 tax cut that brought Meta, the by-right approval framework that insulated the industry from public review, and the thirteen-month arc of community resistance that ended that framework on June 10, 2025.

 The study finds that Henrico's regulatory reversal was produced by an unusual political convergence: a predominantly Black, middle-income community in eastern Henrico framing its opposition as environmental justice, and a predominantly White, high-income community in the West End framing its opposition as property-value protection, arriving simultaneously at the same structural demand. It documents the legal test of those rules through the Centra Logistics vested-rights claim and its unanimous rejection by the Board of Zoning Appeals in February 2026, the developer's by-right warehouse pivot that followed, and the May 2026 disclosure of a grandfathered QTS pipeline, 17 buildings and nearly 8 million square feet, that the new ordinance cannot reach. It also documents the $60 million Housing Affordability Trust Fund, the first known program in the United States dedicating data center tax revenue to affordable homeownership, and the structural dependency of that revenue on operator equipment-refresh behavior. 

The evidence is organized for use by an interdisciplinary research audience, with findings mapped throughout to five research frameworks: distributional justice, institutional behavior, utility finance, energy and labor infrastructure, and energy geography. The central finding belongs to all five: the county changed its rules only after the largest entitlements were granted, and the district that organized the resistance is the district that will absorb the grandfathered buildout.

AI.tldr: 本文通过亨利科县（弗吉尼亚州）二十余年数据中心产业发展的完整案例，记录了从1990年代基础设施投资到2009年Qimonda倒闭、2010年QTS改造、2017年Meta入驻税收优惠、以及2025年社区反抗终结"按权利批准"框架的全过程。研究发现该县的监管逆转源于东部黑人中产社区（以环境正义为框架）与西部高收入白人社区（以房产价值保护为框架）的政治性汇聚。文章还涵盖了Centra Logistics既得权利法律挑战、QTS管道豁免披露及6千万美元住房可负担信托基金等关键事件，并将证据映射至五大研究框架。
AI.research_question: 亨利科县如何在二十年吸引数据中心产业后于十八个月内学会对其进行治理？该县的监管逆转是如何发生的，以及这种逆转的结构性限制是什么？
AI.motivation: 数据中心产业快速发展带来的地方治理挑战日益严峻，但缺乏对地方政府从吸引到治理完整周期的深度案例研究。亨利科县提供了一个罕见的完整政治弧线样本，有助于理解地方监管逆转的政治条件和结构性局限。
AI.theoretical_framework: 五大研究框架：分配正义（distributional justice）、制度行为（institutional behavior）、公用事业金融（utility finance）、能源与劳动力基础设施（energy and labor infrastructure）、能源地理（energy geography）。
AI.method: 案例研究方法（case study），通过文档记录采用事件的完整时间线，涵盖基础设施投资、企业倒闭、设施改造、税收政策、审批框架、社区反抗、法律诉讼等多阶段事件。
AI.findings: (1) 亨利科县的监管逆转源于种族和经济背景迥异的两个社区（东部黑人中产社区与西部高收入白人社区）同时提出相同的结构性诉求；(2) 该县仅在最大的权利授予完成后才改变规则，而组织反抗的地区恰恰是吸收"祖父条款"（grandfathered）建设的地区；(3) 新的条例无法触及QTS既有的17栋建筑、近800万平方英尺的管道项目；(4) 建立了美国首个将数据中心税收用于可负担住房所有权的$6000万信托基金，但其收入依赖运营商设备更新行为。
AI.theory_contributions: 展示了地方政府产业治理中"权利授予时滞"现象——即监管变革滞后于权利授予，导致治理工具对已授予的权益无效。同时揭示了跨种族、跨阶层社区联盟形成的政治条件及其对分配正义理论的启示。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他面临数据中心产业扩张的地方政府提供了治理时间线参考，包括税收优惠设计、审批框架的公众参与机制、既得权利条款的风险管理，以及将产业税收转化为社区福利（如住房可负担性）的创新政策案例。

title: From Transmission Loss to Transmission Immunity: How Organizational Joints Reject or Defend Intent
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: From Transmission Loss to Transmission Immunity: How Organizational Joints Reject or Defend Intent

declarations.ethicsApproval: NO
declarations.funderStatement: NO

detail.abstract: Organizational intent frequently fails to translate into practice not merely due to signal attenuation during transmission, but active resistance. This paper introduces the construct of “transmission immunity” to capture mechanisms whereby organizational joints selectively filter, block or resist signals conflicting with incumbents‘ interests or value orientations. Building upon the Organizational Skeleton Framework, we argue that transmission immunity is inherently dual sided. When joints are occupied by self-interested actors, malignant immunity emerges, repudiating official organizational intent and accelerating structural rigidity. When occupied by actors with strong organizational identification, benign immunity arises, enabling resistance to flawed top-down directives and safeguarding core organizational functions. Drawing on comparative case analyses of labour unions (CFMEU, PSA) and corporations (Toshiba, Enron), this article identifies triggering conditions, operational mechanisms and organizational outcomes of transmission immunity. Our analysis suggests that a functional organizational skeleton relies not only on formal structural design, but also on value alignment and feedback mechanisms embedded within its transmission joints.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"传输免疫"这一新构念，解释组织意图在传递过程中遭遇主动抵抗而非仅信号衰减的机制。基于组织骨架框架，传输免疫具有双面性：自利行动者占据节点时产生恶性免疫（抵制官方意图、加速结构僵化），高组织认同行动者则产生良性免疫（抵御有缺陷的顶层指令、保护核心功能）。通过工会与企业的多案例比较分析，识别了触发条件、运作机制与组织结果。
AI.research_question: 组织意图为何无法转化为实践？组织接点（joints）如何通过选择性过滤、阻断或抵抗信号来影响组织意图的传递与落地？
AI.motivation: 以往研究多关注信号在传递过程中的"衰减"问题，忽视了组织成员对信号的"主动抵抗"。本文旨在填补这一理论空白，引入传输免疫构念来捕捉组织中行动者对背离其利益或价值取向的信号的主动抵抗机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 组织骨架框架（Organizational Skeleton Framework）、传输免疫理论
AI.method: 比较案例分析法，涉及工会（CFMEU、PSA）与企业（东芝、安然）两类组织的多案例比较。
AI.findings: 1）自利行动者占据组织接点时产生恶性免疫，抵制官方组织意图并加速结构僵化；2）高组织认同行动者产生良性免疫，能抵抗有缺陷的顶层指令并保护核心组织功能；3）功能性组织骨架不仅依赖正式结构设计，还依赖嵌入在传输接点中的价值一致性与反馈机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出"传输免疫"这一新理论构念，揭示了组织传递失败的另一维度——主动抵抗而非被动衰减；同时识别了传输免疫的双面性（恶性与良性），丰富了组织骨架框架的理论内涵。
AI.practical_contributions: 为组织设计提供了实践指引：组织骨架的效能不仅在于正式结构设计，还需在关键传输接点嵌入价值一致性培育与反馈机制，以促进良性免疫、抑制恶性免疫。

title: Case Study: Hanover County — Mountain Road, Tract, and the Search for Leverage
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Case Study: Hanover County — Mountain Road, Tract, and the Search for Leverage
detail.abstract: On the night of May 27, 2026, after nearly six hours of debate that ran toward midnight, the Hanover County Board of Supervisors voted 4-3 to reject Tract's Mountain Road Technology Park: 430 acres, 900 megawatts, and the largest single land-use decision the county had faced since it began courting the data center industry. The county that built the planning framework inviting the proposal refused the flagship application that framework produced. This case study documents the full arc. Hanover spent twelve years constructing the apparatus of recruitment: an Economic Development Zone on the Route 33 corridor in 2013, a Strategic Zoning Initiative cutting rezoning friction in 2015, a dedicated $0.45 equipment tax rate in 2023, and a Small Area Plan naming data centers a "preferred business type" in August 2025, adopted one month before Tract filed. Within that framework, three proposals resolved three different ways: the 1,211-acre Hickory Hill campus approved unanimously in 2024 and now under construction, the Hunting Hawk proposal withdrawn under unanimous planning commission opposition in January 2026, and Mountain Road, rejected despite a proffer package whose cash component grew from $90,000 to roughly $21 million as approval grew less likely. Water decided it. Project documents showed average demand of roughly 600,000 gallons per day with peak projections reaching 2 million, against a county system still recovering politically from a 2025 water crisis, and the developer's $15 million water infrastructure commitment did not move the majority. The study finds that Hanover now occupies one pole of the regional decision space. Henrico, next door, reformed its rules only after granting its largest entitlements and watches a grandfathered eight-million-square-foot pipeline build out. Hanover rejected its flagship project before construction began, then moved within weeks to reset its equipment tax rate, stripping the $0.45 rate from the FY2027 budget ahead of a June 24 vote on a rate of up to $3 per $100. A county that has never collected a dollar of data center tax revenue is repricing the industry before letting it in. The evidence is organized for an interdisciplinary research audience, with findings mapped to five frameworks: distributional justice, institutional behavior, utility finance, energy and labor infrastructure, and energy geography.

AI.tldr: 本文通过案例研究，记录了弗吉尼亚州Hanover县从2013年开始构建数据中心产业招商框架，到2026年5月27日以4-3投票否决旗舰项目Mountain Road科技园的完整过程。研究发现该县在从未从数据中心行业获得任何税收收入的情况下，先构建了包括经济开发区、战略分区、设备税率优惠和小区域规划等一整套招商机制，却在项目审批的关键时刻因水资源问题否决了该项目，随后迅速调整设备税率，重新定价该行业。
AI.research_question: 为什么一个花费十二年构建数据中心产业招商框架的县，会拒绝该框架所产生的旗舰项目？水资源因素和制度变迁在决定土地用途决策中扮演了什么角色？
AI.motivation: 数据中心产业正在美国各地快速扩张，地方政府面临巨大的招商引资压力与社区资源约束之间的张力。Hanover县的案例展示了一种罕见的"自我否定"模式——招商框架构建成功后却否决了旗舰项目，为理解地方政府在产业发展与资源约束间的决策逻辑提供了独特视角。
AI.theoretical_framework: 本文从五个理论框架组织证据：分配正义（distributional justice）、制度行为（institutional behavior）、公用事业金融（utility finance）、能源与劳动力基础设施（energy and labor infrastructure）、能源地理学（energy geography）。
AI.method: 案例研究方法（case study），对Hanover县从2013年至2026年的政策演变、三次项目审批决策（Hickory Hill获批、Hunting Hawk撤回、Mountain Road被否）进行全过程文献与档案分析。
AI.findings: 1) Hanover县花了12年构建招商框架（2013年经济开发区、2015年战略分区、2023年$0.45设备税率、2025年小区域规划），但拒绝了框架产生的旗舰项目；2) 水资源是关键决定因素——日均60万加仑、峰值200万加仑的需求对比2025年水危机后的县系统，1500万美元水基础设施承诺未能改变多数票；3) 三个项目分别以三种方式解决（一致批准、撤回、否决），显示决策的非确定性；4) 否决后数周内县即调整设备税率（从$0.45上调至最高$3/$100），在从未收取任何数据中心税收的情况下重新定价该行业。
AI.theory_contributions: 本文通过一个具体案例展示了地方制度招商框架与最终决策之间的张力，揭示了在制度构建与项目审批之间存在"最后一英里"的断裂，为制度行为理论和分配正义理论提供了实证案例。跨五个理论框架的组织方式为跨学科研究提供了整合范式。
AI.practical_contributions: 为其他面临数据中心招商决策的地方政府提供了参照系——展示了水资源约束如何成为否决大型项目的决定性因素，以及地方政府如何在产业进入前进行重新定价。Hanover与邻近的Henrico县的对比（后者先批后改规则）为政策制定者提供了两种截然不同的决策策略。

title: Selective by Design: Systematic Accommodation Bias on Official Tourism Board Websites
affiliations: Edison High School

detail.title: Selective by Design: Systematic Accommodation Bias on Official Tourism Board Websites
detail.abstract: Destination Marketing Organizations (DMOs) serve as the primary public-facing information source for U.S. travelers researching where to stay in a destination. This study examines what official DMO websites in the United States choose to include when presenting lodging options for prospective visitors. The paper analyzes 97 official DMO websites selected for being the top ranked counties in terms of individuals hired by the hospitality and tourism industry. The analysis recorded the presence of six distinct accommodation categories: hotels, resorts, vacation rentals, campgrounds and RV parks, bed and breakfasts, and short-term rentals across all 97 destinations.
