detail.title: Case Study: Orange County and the Town of Orange — Convergence at Two Scales: One Industry, Two Governments, and the Entitlement Neither Can Reach
detail.abstract: In the spring of 2026, two governments whose chambers sit blocks apart in the same small town regulated the same industry in the same season, with different instruments, on different timelines, and in partially different directions. The Town of Orange, population roughly 5,000, moved first: on February 17, 2026, its five-member council removed data centers as a by-right use in its commercial core and put a Special Use Permit gate on every district where the use survives. Orange County, population roughly 36,000, followed: on April 28, 2026, its Board of Supervisors voted 5-0 to strike "data center" from the by-right use table of its industrial district and to confine the use, by definition, to a floating Technology District that exists on no parcel of land in the county. The same county that closed the by-right door had opened the Technology District four months earlier, keeps a data center equipment tax rate less than half its machinery-and-tools rate, and spent the same spring filing four resolutions, two sets of federal comments, and a five-county joint motion against the 765-kilovolt transmission line that the industry's regional growth is pulling through its farmland. None of this reaches the largest land-use decision the county ever made. The 2,602-acre Wilderness Crossing rezoning of April 2023, with its 732 acres allocated to data centers and its projected 1,500 megawatts of load, predates every rule described above and sits in litigation whose venue, as of the evidence snapshot, neither the circuit court nor the Court of Appeals has resolved. The town's ordinances never reached it either; the site lies fifteen miles east of town limits. Version 2.1 of this case study documented convergence: a mega-rezoning, a transmission corridor, a state-adjudicated water constraint, documented contamination, and litigation on two fronts, all moving through different channels with no single resolving decision point. Version 3.0 keeps convergence as the spine and adds the structure v2.1 could not see: the county and the town are separate governments with separate zoning powers and separate water utilities, and in early 2026 they began governing the same wave at two scales. The nested-jurisdiction record assembled here exists nowhere else in this series. The evidence is organized for an interdisciplinary research audience, with findings mapped to five frameworks: distributional justice, institutional behavior, utility finance, energy and labor infrastructure, and energy geography. This version is a pre-field dossier for October 2026 fieldwork; its gaps are catalogued as deliverables, not apologies.

AI.tldr: 本研究以弗吉尼亚州Orange镇与Orange县为案例，分析2026年春季两级政府在同一季节、同一行业（数据中心）上采取不同规制工具、不同时间表及部分相反方向的治理行为。该案例研究3.0版以"嵌套管辖区"为核心结构，整合了mega-rezoning、输电走廊、水资源约束、污染及双重诉讼等多线程事件，为跨学科研究提供现场前档案。
AI.research_question: 当同一个行业浪潮同时冲击同一区域内的两级地方政府（镇与县）时，它们如何在不同的管辖权尺度上以不同工具、不同时间表和部分相反的方向进行规制？这种嵌套管辖权的治理行为如何形成、互动并产生何种后果？
AI.motivation: 版本2.1记录了巨型再分区、输电走廊、水资源约束、污染和双重诉讼等多线程汇聚的现象，但未能揭示其背后的结构。版本3.0发现关键结构事实：镇与县是拥有独立分区权力和独立水务公用事业的分离政府，2026年初开始在两个尺度上治理同一行业浪潮，这一嵌套管辖区记录是系列中独有的。
AI.theoretical_framework: 论文将证据映射到五个理论框架：（1）分配正义（distributional justice）；（2）制度行为（institutional behavior）；（3）公用事业财务（utility finance）；（4）能源与劳动基础设施（energy and labor infrastructure）；（5）能源地理（energy geography）。
AI.method: 本文为案例研究（第3.0版），采用嵌套管辖权档案分析（nested-jurisdiction record assembly），整合两级政府的法规文本（特别使用许可、浮动技术区定义）、税收政策、诉讼文件（联邦评论、五县联合动议）、再分区决议等证据，并作为2026年10月田野调查的pre-field dossier。
AI.findings: （1）Orange镇于2026年2月17日移除数据中心作为商业核心区by-right用途，并对保留该用途的区域设置特别使用许可门槛；（2）Orange县于4月28日以5-0投票将数据中心从工业区by-right用途表中删除，并用定义将其限制在不对应任何实际地块的浮动技术区；（3）县级行为存在内在矛盾：关闭by-right大门的同时保留低税率（数据中心设备税率不到机械与工具税率一半），并通过四份决议、两套联邦评论和五县联合动议反对765千伏输电线路；（4）2023年4月的2,602英亩Wilderness Crossing再分区（含732英亩数据中心、预计1,500兆瓦负荷）先于所有上述规则，且处于管辖权悬而未决的诉讼中。
AI.theory_contributions: 该案例为嵌套管辖权（nested jurisdiction）下的多尺度治理提供了实证素材，揭示了同一行业在同一区域被两级独立政府以部分冲突方式治理的制度逻辑，丰富了分配正义、制度行为、公用事业财务、能源与劳动基础设施及能源地理五个框架的交叉理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为2026年10月田野调查提供系统性现场前档案（pre-field dossier），将证据缺口目录化为交付物而非缺憾；为研究数据中心的区域治理、输电网建设与地方土地利用冲突的跨学科学者提供可复用的证据组织框架。

title: AI in Virginia Higher Education: Public-Source Reference Guide for 30 Four-Year Institutions
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: AI in Virginia Higher Education: Public-Source Reference Guide for 30 Four-Year Institutions
detail.abstract: A 311-page public-source reference guide compiling publicly available information on how Virginia's four-year colleges and universities are addressing generative artificial intelligence in governance, teaching, academic integrity, research ethics, tool provisioning, and strategic planning. Coverage spans 30 institutions across three groups: 6 public R1 research universities, 9 other public universities, and 15 private universities and colleges, with an evidence snapshot of March 2026. Each institutional entry follows the same ten-part structure: governance architecture, policy infrastructure, teaching posture, tool ecosystem, academic integrity, research ethics, library signals, strategic investment, executive signaling, and an evidence archive of all cited URLs. Research was conducted in two passes between February and March 2026. The first pass surveyed each institution using targeted web searches. The second pass conducted a deeper sweep across 13 mandatory source categories per institution, including academic catalogs, student and faculty handbooks, IT services pages, teaching center archives, library research guides, research office pages, campus news archives from 2023 to 2026, strategic plans, presidential and provost office statements, graduate school policies, and school-level policies. All content is sourced from public institutional websites and official announcements. No internal documents, interviews, non-public data, or behind-authentication materials were used. The guide is designed as a practical lookup tool for provosts, chief information officers, teaching center directors, and faculty governance leaders. It is not a best-practices guide, ranking, or scorecard. It does not evaluate institutional effectiveness, compare institutions, or speculate beyond what public sources state. This guide is one of several companion reference documents produced from a broader study of 53 American universities and forms part of the underlying institutional profiling work for the related working paper on how those universities governed AI.

AI.tldr: 这是一份311页的公共来源参考指南，系统汇编了弗吉尼亚州30所四年制大学在生成式人工智能治理方面的公开信息，涵盖治理架构、政策、教学、学术诚信、研究伦理、工具配置和战略规划等十个维度，作为面向高校管理者的实用查询工具。
AI.research_question: 弗吉尼亚州30所四年制高校如何在治理、教学、学术诚信、研究伦理、工具配置和战略规划方面应对生成式人工智能？
AI.motivation: 为高校管理者（教务长、首席信息官、教学中心主任、教师治理领导者）提供一个系统化的公共信息来源查询工具，帮助他们了解各校在生成式人工智能方面的应对现状，而不做评价或排名。
AI.theoretical_framework: 该文档并非理论论文，而是参考指南，其框架基于十个分析维度：治理架构、政策基础设施、教学姿态、工具生态系统、学术诚信、研究伦理、图书馆信号、战略投资、行政信号和证据档案。
AI.method: 两轮研究方法：第一轮通过定向网络搜索调查每所院校；第二轮对每所院校进行13个强制来源类别的深度扫描，包括学术目录、学生和教师手册、IT服务页面、教学中心档案、图书馆研究指南、研究办公室页面、2023-2026年校园新闻档案、战略计划、校长和教务长办公室声明、研究生院政策及院系政策。所有内容均来自公开机构网站和官方公告。
AI.findings: 覆盖30所院校，分为三组：6所公立R1研究型大学、9所其他公立大学和15所私立大学。每所院校均按统一的十部分结构呈现，并附有所有引用URL的证据档案。
AI.theory_contributions: 该指南本身并非理论贡献型论文，但它为一项涵盖53所美国大学的更广泛研究提供了机构画像基础，是后续关于大学如何治理AI的工作论文的配套参考文档。
AI.practical_contributions: 面向教务长、首席信息官、教学中心主任和教师治理领导者的实用查询工具，提供可验证的公共来源信息；明确不做最佳实践指南、排名或评分卡，不评估机构效能或进行比较。

reference: 44 Alternatives to the High Cost of Litigation (forthcoming 2026).
title: Don't Be a Zombie. Use Your Own AI Centaur System
affiliations: University of Missouri School of Law

detail.title: Don't Be a Zombie. Use Your Own AI Centaur System

publicationDetails.detailsText: 44 Alternatives to the High Cost of Litigation (forthcoming 2026).

detail.abstract:
Artificial intelligence (AI) is becoming increasingly integrated into professional practice, creating opportunities to improve professional work as well as risks of over-reliance.

This article describes AI “centaur” systems, which combine complementary human and AI capabilities while humans remain responsible for making decisions.  Working together thoughtfully, humans and AI can produce better results than either one could produce independently.  Operating in centaur mode involves regularly considering when to use AI, what tasks to ask it to perform, and how it can strengthen professional judgment.  The article contrasts “centaur mode” with “zombie mode,” in which people rely on AI without exercising the appropriate judgment for particular tasks.

The article describes how professionals can incorporate AI into their existing practice systems, consciously decide what roles AI should play, and refine their approaches as their experience and AI capabilities develop.  This becomes especially important as AI becomes increasingly agentic and can plan and execute tasks with greater autonomy.

The article illustrates these ideas with the author’s own centaur system, including a personalized AI collaboration tool he uses in writing and other professional activities.  This example illustrates the broader point that the value of AI depends substantially on how professionals choose to use it.  Thoughtful use in centaur mode can strengthen professional judgment, while passive reliance in zombie mode can weaken it.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"半人马模式"（centaur mode）的概念，即人类与AI互补协作、人类保持决策责任的AI使用方式，并与"僵尸模式"（zombie mode）形成对比，后者指人类不加判断地依赖AI。文章通过作者自身的个性化AI协作工具实例，说明深思熟虑地使用AI可以增强专业判断力，而被动依赖则会削弱它。
AI.research_question: 专业人士应如何将AI整合到工作实践中，以增强而非削弱专业判断力？以及在AI日益具备自主性（agentic）的背景下，人类应如何负责任地使用AI？
AI.motivation: AI正日益融入专业实践，既带来改进专业工作的机遇，也存在过度依赖的风险。理解如何平衡人类与AI能力变得至关重要，特别是在AI变得更加自主的背景下。
AI.theoretical_framework: "半人马模式"（centaur mode）vs."僵尸模式"（zombie mode）：前者强调人类与AI能力互补、人类承担决策责任；后者指不加判断地依赖AI输出。文章还探讨了专业判断（professional judgment）在AI协作中的核心地位。
AI.method: 概念性/论述性文章，结合作者自身作为案例的实践反思，描述其个性化AI协作工具在写作等专业活动中的使用经验。
AI.findings: 在"半人马模式"下，专业人员需定期思考何时使用AI、要求AI执行哪些任务、以及AI如何强化专业判断。随着AI日益自主化（agentic），这种深思熟虑的使用方式变得尤为重要。AI的价值主要取决于专业人员如何选择使用它：深思熟虑的"半人马模式"可强化专业判断，而被动依赖的"僵尸模式"会削弱判断力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出并系统阐述了"半人马模式"与"僵尸模式"这对概念框架，为理解人类与AI的协作关系提供了新的理论视角，强调了人类决策责任与主动使用AI在AI协作中的核心地位。
AI.practical_contributions: 为专业人员提供了将AI融入现有实践体系的具体框架：如何有意识地决定AI的角色、如何随着经验积累和AI能力发展不断优化使用方式，并以作者本人的实践为例提供了可参考的应用示范。

title: Case Study: Mecklenburg County — Boydton, South Hill, and What Fifteen Years of Data Centers Actually Bought
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: Case Study: Mecklenburg County — Boydton, South Hill, and What Fifteen Years of Data Centers Actually Bought
detail.abstract: Every other report in this series documents a Virginia county deciding on promises. Mecklenburg County is the only jurisdiction in the commonwealth where the promises are old enough to audit. Microsoft announced its Boydton data center on August 27, 2010, with a pledge of up to $499 million and 50 jobs. Fifteen years later the company owns eleven of the county's twelve data center sites across roughly 3,762 acres, has announced just under $2 billion in investment through public statements that stopped in 2019, and employs, together with its vendors, about 700 people in a county of 30,000. This case study assembles the fifteen-year actual: the year-by-year fiscal record, the employment ledger, the community outcomes in a town that shrank from 431 to 302 residents while the world's cloud grew around it, and the expansion now under way at the Hillcrest site beside South Hill, where the buildout has moved from the county's remotest corner to the edge of its commercial center. The audit returns a split verdict. The fiscal promise was kept and then exceeded: data center taxes now supply between 35 and 40 percent of the county's general fund revenue, financed a $154 million school complex and three new elementary schools without debt, and drove the real estate tax rate to 31 cents, which the county calls the lowest county or city rate in Virginia. The labor promise was kept only in its smallest print: headline job numbers were announcement sums, the original design called for two Microsoft employees and a contract operator, and the verified series never separates badge from vendor. The community promise was never really made, and the record shows why that mattered: Boydton's population fell 30 percent across Microsoft's first decade, the town's flagship business impact in 2016 was lunch tables at a gas station, and the company's most consequential local legacy beyond the budget may be the 37 graves of a Black farming family's cemetery, excavated and relocated to make way for the third expansion after the county and company worked to keep the site off the National Register. The study documents two structural findings the rest of the portfolio can test projections against. First, the revenue is real, large, and structurally fragile: it rests on a $0.66 equipment rate, an equipment-refresh cycle the county cannot see into, a sales tax exemption the General Assembly was still fighting over at this writing, and a single corporate counterparty. The revenue's history is also younger than the campus: under the original deal the county rebated 82.5 percent of Microsoft's personal property tax back to the company, more than $275 million in documented payments across fiscal 2019 through 2024 alone, until a May 2024 restructuring retired the rebate and the general fund finally captured the buildout at a flat rate. Second, the silence is the phenomenon. Fifteen years of approvals produced no rezoning fight, no organized opposition until 2024, and a local politics in which the only tax debates are about how much to cut. The report explains that silence through remoteness, poverty, the co-op and tobacco-country institutional landscape, and a recruitment that preceded the industry's contested era, rather than treating it as consent. This report is built to be the portfolio's translation key.

AI.tldr: 本文是对弗吉尼亚州梅克伦堡县微软博伊德顿数据中心十五年（2010-2025）的案例审计报告。报告通过逐年财政记录、就业账本和社区结果，评估了微软承诺的履行情况，得出"分裂判决"：财政承诺超额兑现（数据中心税收占县普通基金收入35-40%），就业承诺仅以最小文字兑现，社区承诺从未真正做出。报告还识别出两个结构性发现：收入的真实、庞大但结构性脆弱，以及十五年间无反对声音这一"沉默现象"。
AI.research_question: 微软在梅克伦堡县的数据中心项目十五年间的实际结果如何？其财政、就业和社区承诺的履行情况如何？
AI.motivation: 这是该系列报告中唯一一个承诺历史足够长到可以进行审计的县。作者试图通过十五年的真实账目，检验大型科技公司对农村地区承诺的实际兑现情况，并建立一套可供其他县对照检验的评估框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于企业选址承诺与地方经济发展的分析框架，通过对财政承诺、就业承诺、社区承诺三个维度进行对照审计。
AI.method: 单一案例纵向研究（case study），通过汇编十五年的逐年财政记录、就业数据、社区人口统计、董事会记录等一手资料进行审计式分析。
AI.findings: 第一，财政承诺被兑现并超额完成：数据中心税收占县普通基金收入35-40%，资助了1.54亿美元的学校综合体和三所新小学且无债务，房地产税率降至31美分。第二，就业承诺仅在最小范围兑现：头条就业数字是公告性数字，原始设计仅需2名微软员工和1名合同运营商，验证序列从未区分徽章员工与供应商。第三，社区承诺从未真正做出：博伊德顿人口在微软第一个十年下降30%，从431人降至302人。第四，收入真实但结构性脆弱：依赖0.66美元设备税率、县无法预见的设备刷新周期、州议会仍在争论的销售税豁免，以及单一企业对手方。第五，原始的82.5%税收退还安排令县在2019-2024财年退还超过2.75亿美元，直到2024年5月重组才取消。第六，十五年间无重新分区斗争、无有组织反对，称为"沉默现象"。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了两个可供系列中其他案例检验的结构性发现：收入的真实性、规模与结构性脆弱性并存；以及"沉默即现象"——将缺乏反对解释为偏远、贫困、机构环境所致，而非等同为同意。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和其他辖区提供了可对照检验的企业承诺审计框架："翻译钥匙"；揭示了税收退还机制对地方政府财政的长期影响；记录了数据设施扩建对农村社区（含黑人家庭墓地迁移）的实际影响，可供后续决策参考。

title: aCase Study: Goochland County — The Overlay, the Lawsuit, and the Template
affiliations: Independent Researcher

detail.title: aCase Study: Goochland County — The Overlay, the Lawsuit, and the Template
detail.abstract: Every county documented in this series so far decided data centers project by project. Goochland County tried something different. On November 6, 2025, after a public hearing at Goochland High School that ran past midnight, the Board of Supervisors voted 4-1 to adopt a Technology Overlay District and a companion Technology Zone: roughly 4,400 acres pre-zoned for data centers and related uses along Route 288 from Interstate 64 to Patterson Avenue, with by-right approval in most of the district, financial incentives layered on top, and a use table that includes small modular nuclear reactors by conditional use permit. No speaker at the hearing supported it. Twenty-eight days later, four residents sued, alleging the county adopted the ordinance on defective notice and changed it materially the night of the vote. The county has budgeted $250,000 to defend it. On May 26, 2026, the circuit court rejected the county's attempt to file all 8,500 pages of its adoption record and ordered a pared-down filing. Meanwhile the corridor is moving. On June 10, 2026, Tract, the developer Hanover rejected two weeks earlier, filed the district's first application: a twelve-building data center campus on roughly 900 acres. And the instrument is spreading. New Kent County is drafting its own version, the third iteration of a template Louisa County invented in 2023. This case study treats the overlay itself as the protagonist: an institutional instrument with a design history, an adoption story, a legal test, and a replication path. The legal test is the part that matters most for the series. The plaintiffs do not argue that data centers are bad. They argue the county broke the rules adopting the district, and the question their suit poses is whether pre-entitlement by ordinance moves faster than the democratic and judicial checks built to answer it. The evidence so far says yes: the first campus application is in the pipeline on an administrative clock while the ordinance it depends on awaits a hearing on a docket clock. The study adds a fifth position to the series' institutional spectrum. Henrico reformed after entitling. Hanover refused case by case. Chesterfield contracted its leverage away. Prince William's governance was captured, then corrected. Goochland pre-entitled by ordinance, wholesale, and is being tested in court on process rather than substance.

AI.tldr: 本文以Goochland县2025年通过的技术叠加区（Technology Overlay District）为案例主角，研究地方政府如何通过预先区划（pre-entitlement by ordinance）批量批准数据中心开发，并探讨这一制度工具在民主程序、司法审查与行政效率之间的张力。该案面临居民诉讼挑战程序合法性，同时该制度正在向其他县复制扩散。
AI.research_question: 地方政府通过预先区划条例批量授权数据中心开发（pre-entitlement by ordinance），是否比民主程序和司法审查的制衡机制跑得更快？这一制度工具的扩散路径及其引发的法律争议揭示了什么？
AI.motivation: 既有案例系列中各县均采取逐项目审批方式，而Goochland县首创通过预先区划条例整体批约4400英亩用地，开创了新的制度模式。该模式在听证无人支持、随后被起诉的情况下仍持续推进，且正被其他县复制，有必要对其进行深入剖析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 制度设计理论：以"制度工具作为主角"的视角，分析预先区划（pre-entitlement）这一制度工具的"设计历史、采纳故事、法律检验和复制路径"四个维度。该系列还建立了制度谱系（institutional spectrum），涵盖改革、拒绝、契约弱化、治理俘获与纠正、预先批量化五种模式。
AI.method: 案例研究法（Case Study），属于作者"Every county documented"系列研究的一部分。该研究追踪Goochland县技术叠加区的完整过程：2025年11月6日听证与投票、2025年12月居民起诉、2026年5月法院驳回县方8500页记录提交、2026年6月首份开发申请提交，以及制度向New Kent县的扩散。
AI.findings: 1）Goochland县在听证无人支持的情况下仍以4-1票通过预先区划条例，将约4400英亩预划为数据中心用地；2）条例通过28天后即遭居民起诉，指控通知缺陷和投票当晚实质性变更；3）法院已驳回县方8500页的提交记录，要求缩减提交；4）首个开发申请（Tract公司的12栋数据中心园区，约900英亩）已进入行政审批流程，而其所依赖的条例仍在司法审查中——行政时钟跑在了司法时钟前面；5）该制度正在扩散，New Kent县已在起草第三个迭代版本。
AI.theory_contributions: 为机构制度谱系新增第五种模式——"预先批量化"（pre-entitle by ordinance, wholesale），与已有四种模式（改革、拒绝、契约弱化、俘获-纠正）并列。揭示了预先区划条例作为"制度化工具"如何将决策从逐案的政治审议转移到批量行政程序中，并对民主问责与司法审查构成时间不对称的挑战。
AI.practical_contributions: 1）为地方政府提供了预先区划条例这一政策工具的完整案例记录，包括采纳过程、法律风险和扩散路径；2）揭示了预先批量化模式面临的具体法律风险（通知缺陷、实质性变更、程序合法性）及行政与司法时间赛跑的现实问题；3）为其他正在考虑采用类似工具的县（如New Kent县）提供参照，提示程序合法性关注可能超越实体内容争议成为主要挑战。
